Method: 提出RaPO，包含两个核心组件：(1) Retention Reward——将轨迹级分布漂移转化为连续奖励信号，优先强化保留知识的rollout；(2) Cross-Task Advantage Normalization (CTAN)——跨任务边界的指数移动平均奖励统计量，稳定持续学习优化过程。

Result: 在五种视觉持续学习设置中，RaPO显著降低灾难性遗忘，同时保持强可塑性，达到领先性能。

Conclusion: 本文首次系统探索RFT在视觉持续学习中的应用，RaPO有效缓解了遗忘问题，为未来研究提供了新见解。

Abstract: Recent studies suggest that Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RFT) is inherently more resilient to catastrophic forgetting than Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT). However, whether RFT (e.g., GRPO) can effectively overcome forgetting in challenging visual continual learning settings, such as class-incremental learning (CIL) and domain-incremental learning (DIL), remains an open problem. Through a pilot study, we confirm that while RFT consistently outperforms SFT, it still suffers from non-negligible forgetting. We empirically trace this bottleneck to Trajectory-level Drift Agnosticism: among candidate rollouts achieving identical task rewards, the KL divergence from the preceding-task policy varies substantially, which strongly correlates with catastrophic forgetting across sequential tasks. Motivated by this insight, we propose Retention-aware Policy Optimization (RaPO), a simple yet effective RFT method that explicitly mitigates forgetting through trajectory-level reward shaping. Specifically, RaPO comprises two core components: (1) Retention Reward that converts trajectory-level distribution drift into a continuous reward signal, preferentially reinforcing knowledge-preserving rollouts within each group; (2) Cross-Task Advantage Normalization (CTAN), which maintains a persistent exponential moving average of reward statistics across task boundaries to stabilize the optimization progress during continual learning. Leveraging the free-form textual generalization of MLLMs, we comprehensively evaluate RaPO across five visual continual learning settings. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RaPO achieves leading performance, substantially reducing catastrophic forgetting while preserving strong plasticity. To the best of our knowledge, this work represents the first systematic exploration of RFT in visual continual learning, offering insights that we hope will inspire future research.

</details>


### [184] [Attention Itself Could Retrieve.RetrieveVGGT: Training-Free Long Context Streaming 3D Reconstruction via Query-Key Similarity Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09644)
*Zichen Zou,Xiaosong Jia,Zuxuan Wu,Yu-Gang Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RetrieveVGGT通过将上下文构建转化为检索问题，在不额外训练的情况下，为VGGT 3D重建模型实现了固定内存开销的高效流式处理，性能超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VGGT的全局注意力二次复杂度限制了长序列应用，StreamVGGT虽引入因果注意力但KV缓存随帧数线性增长导致内存溢出和质量下降，亟需一种可控内存的高效流式3D重建方案。

Method: 提出训练无关的RetrieveVGGT框架：1) 将上下文构建视为检索问题，每步检索固定数量的相关帧；2) 利用VGGT第一层全局注意力中的查询-键相似度作为相关性指标；3) 提出Segment Sampling以覆盖不同相关片段，避免聚焦单一高相似区域；4) 设计带姿态感知的空间记忆机制，按相机位姿组织历史帧以实现位置感知检索。

Result: 在多项实验中达到最先进性能，超越StreamVGGT、TTT3R和InfiniteVGGT，同时内存消耗不随序列长度增长而保持恒定。

Conclusion: 通过检索式上下文构建和姿态感知空间记忆，实现了高效、可控内存的3D重建流式处理，验证了相似度指标的有效性和采样策略的优越性。

Abstract: Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT) advances 3D reconstruction via scalable Transformer architecture, but the quadratic complexity of global attention prevents long context application. StreamVGGT enables streaming with causal attention, yet its KV cache grows linearly with frames, causing memory overflow and quality degradation. We present RetrieveVGGT, a training-free framework, which formulates context construction for VGGT as a retrieval problem. By retrieving a fixed number of relevant frames at each step, VGGT maintains a controllable memory budget, which is close to its training context length. Interestingly, we find that the similarity between current frame queries and cached history frame keys at the first global attention layer of VGGT is already a strong indicator of relevance, eliminating the need for additional learned scoring. To enhance information diversity similar to a recommender system, we propose Segment Sampling so that the retrieval spans distinct relevant segments rather than a single high-similarity region. We design a pose-aware spatial memory mechanism that organizes history frames according to their already estimated camera poses, enabling location-aware retrieval. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RetrieveVGGT achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming StreamVGGT, TTT3R, and InfiniteVGGT while maintaining constant memory usage regardless of sequence length. Code is available at https://github.com/zzctmd/RetrieveVGGT.

</details>


### [185] [BEA-GS: BEyond RAdiance Supervision in 3DGS for Precise Object Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09662)
*Alessio Mazzucchelli,Maria Naranjo-Almeida,Jorge Bustos-Sanchez,Mariella Dimiccoli,Francesc Moreno-Noguer,Jordi Sanchez-Riera,Adrian Penate-Sanchez*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种通过两个新损失函数优化3D高斯几何体，实现物体提取时近乎完美边界分割的方法，在12种SOTA方法、4个数据集、6个指标上表现最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有高斯泼溅技术在进行3D语义表示时未优化底层3D几何结构，导致物体级编辑或资产提取困难。尽管COBGS、Trace3D、ObjectGS等方法已尝试修改场景几何以表示语义，但仍存在边界不精确的问题。

Method: 提出两个新损失函数：1) 边界损失（通过光栅化传播梯度，修改可见高斯的几何体以尊重语义边界）；2) 非可见损失（不经过光栅化直接传播梯度到高斯参数，调整提取后出现的非可见高斯的几何体）。

Result: 与12种SOTA方法在4个数据集上使用6个指标进行详尽比较，该方法在边界分割方面取得了总体最优结果。

Conclusion: 通过两种互补的损失函数分别优化可见和非可见高斯体的几何结构，实现了物体提取中近乎完美的边界效果，显著优于现有方法。

Abstract: Most Gaussian Splatting techniques that provide a 3D semantic representation of the scene do not optimize the underlying 3D geometry, making object-level editing or asset extraction challenging. Recent methods, such as COBGS, Trace3D, ObjectGS, acknowledge this limitation and propose approaches that modify the scene's geometry to represent the underlying semantics. We advance this concept further by proposing a novel solution that provides near perfect boundaries in object extraction. We do so by introducing two new losses in the optimization that take care of: 1) a loss that modifies the geometry of visible Gaussians to respect semantic boundaries, and 2) a loss that adjusts the geometry of non-visible Gaussians that appear once the object is extracted. Our first loss propagates gradients directly through the rasterization, allowing for seamless integration within the optimization of the Gaussian parameters. The second loss also propagates gradients to Gaussian parameters but does so without passing through the rasterization, enabling modification of the scene's geometry even when little transmittance reaches a Gaussian (partial or non-visible). Exhaustive comparisons with 12 state of the art methods across 4 datasets, using six metrics, demonstrate that our approach produces overall the best boundary segmentation to date.

</details>


### [186] [Rethinking Evaluation of Multiple Sclerosis (MS) Lesion Segmentation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09666)
*Abdul Basit,Ashir Rashid,Muhammad Abdullah Hanif,Muhammad Shafique*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文指出当前多发性硬化（MS）病灶分割模型主要依赖Dice分数评估，忽略了病变级检测性能、对临床复杂病例的量化等关键指标。作者提出重新思考评估方法，引入"问题指纹"概念明确神经科医生的临床需求，并基于两个公开数据集对现有模型进行多维度分析，以验证其实际部署可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习模型在MS病灶分割评估中过度依赖Dice分数，未能充分衡量病变级检测能力、临床复杂案例以及疾病监测关键场景下的模型表现，导致模型难以在真实医院环境中可靠部署。

Method: 1）提出"问题指纹"概念，系统梳理神经科医生在MRI扫描中关注的病灶特征及所需评估指标；2）在两个开源数据集上，使用多维度指标（超越Dice分数）对现有最优模型进行性能分析。

Result: 通过引入更丰富的评估指标，揭示了现有模型在病变级检测和临床关键场景下的性能短板，证明了依赖单一Dice分数评估的不充分性。

Conclusion: MS病灶分割模型的评估体系需要根本性反思，应纳入临床相关的多维度指标，以提升模型在真实医院部署中的实用性和可靠性。

Abstract: Multiple Sclerosis (MS) is a chronic autoimmune disease that can significantly reduce the quality of life of a patient. Existing treatment options can only help slow down the progression of the disease. Therefore, early detection and precise monitoring of disease progression are important. Deep learning offers state-of-the-art models for detecting and segmenting MS lesions in brain MRI scans. However, most of these models are evaluated using the Dice score, without accounting for lesion-wise detection and segmentation performance or other metrics that quantify model performance in cases that are complex or confusing for human annotators, or in cases that are essential for disease detection and progression monitoring. In this paper, we highlight the need to rethink the evaluation of MS lesion segmentation models. In this context, we first present problem fingerprinting in detail to highlight what neurologists look for in brain MRI scans for MS detection and progression monitoring, and which metrics are required to properly quantify model performance in these contexts. Additionally, we present an analysis of state-of-the-art models on two open-source datasets using these metrics to highlight their usability for real-world deployment in hospitals.

</details>


### [187] [S2P-Net: A Spectral-Spatial Polar Network for Rotation-Invariant Object Recognition in Low-Data Regimes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09667)
*Albert Heruth*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: S2P-Net是一种紧凑型深度学习架构，能在不依赖数据增强的情况下实现数学上保证的旋转不变性，并与CNN进行了对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经网络（如CNN）缺乏对旋转不变性的数学保证，通常依赖数据增强来近似处理旋转变化，作者希望通过设计一种紧凑架构从根本上解决这一问题。

Method: 提出S2P-Net（光谱-空间极坐标网络），通过极坐标变换等光谱-空间设计，在数学上保证了网络对旋转输入的输出不变性。

Result: 与其他CNN架构相比，S2P-Net在旋转不变性任务上表现更优，且无需数据增强。

Conclusion: S2P-Net通过紧凑的架构设计实现了数学上可保证的旋转不变性，为处理旋转变化问题提供了新的高效思路。

Abstract: We present S2P-Net (Spectral-Spatial Polar Network), a compact deep learning architecture that achieves mathematically guaranteed rotation invariance without data augmentation. In this Paper, we also made a comparison to other neural network architectures (CNN`s). Have a look at the results and feel free to contact me for any questions. This is my first paper:) Made by Hackbert

</details>


### [188] [VFM-SDM: A vision foundation model-based framework for training-free, marker-free, and calibration-free structural displacement measurement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09677)
*Qingyu Xian,Hao Cheng,Berend Jan van der Zwaag,Rolands Kromanis,Ozlem Durmaz Incel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出VFM-SDM框架，基于视觉基础模型实现结构位移测量，无需任务特定训练或现场准备，通过结合VFM推断的相机参数估计与点跟踪进行三角化重建，在实桥多模态数据集上验证了良好的精度与一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统位移测量方法依赖接触式传感器或视觉方法中的任务特定模型训练、标记安装、手动标定等，部署成本高且受限。本文旨在开发一种无需现场准备和任务特定训练、可自动部署的视觉位移测量方法。

Method: 基于视觉基础模型(VFM)推断相机参数和点跟踪，结合三角化重建多方向结构位移；引入结构几何约束抑制物理上不合理的偏差，提升估计一致性；构建多模态现场数据集与统一基准测试协议。

Result: 在实桥现场数据上，竖向和横向位移测量的振幅误差(NRMSE_range)分别为0.11/0.12，相关系数0.86/0.88，峰值振幅误差(RPPAE)为0.01/0.02，表现稳健。

Conclusion: VFM-SDM实现了自动化、可扩展的非接触位移监测，无需任务特定训练和现场准备，为数字孪生和数据驱动的建造工作流中的结构响应测量奠定了基础。

Abstract: Reliable displacement measurement is fundamental for structural health monitoring and digital engineering workflows, as it provides direct structural response information. Vision-based measurement has emerged as a promising approach for low-cost, non-contact displacement monitoring. However, its deployment often remains constrained by task-specific model training or on-site preparation, such as marker installation or manual camera calibration. This study presents a Vision Foundation Model-based framework for Structural Displacement Measurement (VFM-SDM) that integrates VFM-inferred camera parameter estimation and point tracking to reconstruct multi-directional structural displacements via triangulation without task-specific training or on-site preparation, enabling efficient non-contact deployment in real-world applications. Structural geometry constraints are incorporated to suppress physically implausible deviations and improve estimation consistency. A multi-modal field dataset collected from an in-service pedestrian bridge is introduced alongside a unified benchmarking protocol to support reproducible evaluation. Representative results show low amplitude errors (NRMSE$_{\text{range}}$: 0.11/0.12), strong temporal agreement (correlation coefficient: 0.86/0.88), and small peak-to-peak amplitude errors (RPPAE: 0.01/0.02) for vertical and lateral displacements, indicating robust performance under real-world conditions. The proposed framework advances automated, scalable displacement monitoring and lays the groundwork for VFM-enabled structural response measurements in digital twin and data-centric construction workflows.

</details>


### [189] [DeepTumorVQA: A Hierarchical 3D CT Benchmark for Stage-Wise Evaluation of Medical VLMs and Tool-Augmented Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09679)
*Yixiong Chen,Wenjie Xiao,Pedro R. A. S. Bassi,Boyan Wang,Liang He,Xinze Zhou,Sezgin Er,Ibrahim Ethem Hamamci,Zongwei Zhou,Alan Yuille*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DeepTumorVQA是一个分层次、多阶段的医学视觉问答基准，将3D CT肿瘤诊断分解为识别、测量、视觉推理和医学推理四个阶段，包含476K问题和工具交互环境，发现定量测量是主要瓶颈，而工具增强可显著缓解问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学VQA基准仅使用单一准确率评分，无法揭示模型在何处以及为何失败，缺乏对多阶段诊断推理过程的细粒度评估能力。

Method: 构建层次化基准，将3D CT肿瘤诊断推理分解为识别、测量、视觉推理、医学推理四个可独立评分的阶段；提供直接推理模式和工具交互环境（包括分割模型、测量程序、医学知识模块）；收集476K问题涵盖42个临床亚型、9262个3D CT卷。

Result: 可靠定量测量是主要瓶颈，导致后续视觉和医学推理困难；工具增强显著缓解该问题；当工具可用时，利用医学知识和工具进行推理成为新挑战；真实工具使用轨迹可监督智能体减少错误。

Conclusion: 从识别到测量再到视觉和医学推理的逐阶段进展为未来医学VLM和AI智能体研究提供了具体路线图。

Abstract: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) and AI agents have made significant progress in learning to analyze and reason about clinical images. However, existing medical visual question answering (VQA) benchmarks collapse model capabilities into a single accuracy score, obscuring where and why models fail. We propose DeepTumorVQA, a hierarchical benchmark that follows the multi-stage evidence chain in tumor diagnosis and decomposes 3D CT reasoning into four stages: recognition, measurement, visual reasoning, and medical reasoning. Higher-level questions remain independently scorable, while their ground-truth evidence chains are defined over lower-level primitives. The benchmark contains 476K questions across 42 clinical subtypes on 9,262 3D CT volumes. In addition to a direct reasoning mode for VLMs, DeepTumorVQA provides tool-interaction environments for agent evaluation, where a model can call external tools, including segmentation models, measurement programs, and medical knowledge modules, before answering the question. Evaluating over 30 model configurations, we find that reliable quantitative measurement is the primary bottleneck, making later-stage visual and medical reasoning harder for VLMs, while tool augmentation substantially mitigates this issue. When tools are available, leveraging medical knowledge and tools to reason about medical images becomes a new challenge. We further show that ground-truth step-by-step tool-use traces from DeepTumorVQA can supervise agents and reduce tool-use and reasoning failures. This stage-wise progression from recognition to measurement to visual and medical reasoning provides a concrete roadmap for future medical VLM and AI agent studies. All data and code are released at https://github.com/Schuture/DeepTumorVQA.

</details>


### [190] [Forcing-KV: Hybrid KV Cache Compression for Efficient Autoregressive Video Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09681)
*Yicheng Ji,Zhizhou Zhong,Jun Zhang,Qin Yang,XiTai Jin,Ying Qin,Wenhan Luo,Shuiyang Mao,Wei Liu,Huan Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Forcing-KV，一种针对自回归视频扩散模型的分层KV缓存压缩策略，通过区分静态头（关注帧间转换与帧内保真度）和动态头（关注帧间运动与一致性），分别进行结构化静态剪枝和基于片段相似性的动态剪枝，在H200 GPU上实现29 FPS的生成速度、30%缓存内存缩减，最高达2.82倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自回归视频扩散模型因历史帧间冗余的KV缓存导致注意力计算复杂度和内存开销巨大，限制了可扩展性。

Method: 基于对注意力头功能特化的实证观察，将注意力头分为静态头（关注跨自回归块的转换和帧内保真度）和动态头（关注帧间运动与一致性），对静态头采用结构化静态剪枝，对动态头采用基于片段相似性的动态剪枝。

Result: 在单张NVIDIA H200 GPU上达到29 FPS的生成速度，缓存内存减少30%，在LongLive和Self Forcing上分别实现1.35倍和1.50倍加速（480P），在1080P分辨率下扩展至2.82倍加速。

Conclusion: 通过分而治之的混合KV压缩策略，在保持生成质量的同时显著提升了自回归视频扩散模型的推理效率。

Abstract: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models adopt a streaming generation framework, enabling long-horizon video generation with real-time responsiveness, as exemplified by the Self Forcing training paradigm. However, existing AR video diffusion models still suffer from significant attention complexity and severe memory overhead due to the redundant key-value (KV) caches across historical frames, which limits scalability. In this paper, we tackle this challenge by introducing KV cache compression into autoregressive video diffusion. We observe that attention heads in mainstream AR diffusion models exhibit markedly distinct attention patterns and functional roles that remain stable across samples and denoising steps. Building on our empirical study of head-wise functional specialization, we divide the attention heads into two categories: static heads, which focus on transitions across autoregressive chunks and intra-frame fidelity, and dynamic heads, which govern inter-frame motion and consistency. We then propose Forcing-KV, a hybrid KV cache compression strategy that performs structured static pruning for static heads and dynamic pruning based on segment-wise similarity for dynamic heads. While maintaining output quality, our method achieves a generation speed of over 29 frames per second on a single NVIDIA H200 GPU along with 30% cache memory reduction, delivering up to 1.35x and 1.50x speedups on LongLive and Self Forcing at 480P resolution, and further scaling to 2.82x speedup at 1080P resolution. Code and demo videos are provided at https://zju-jiyicheng.github.io/Forcing-KV-Page.

</details>


### [191] [Spatial-Frequency Gated Swin Transformer for Remote Sensing Single-Image Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09687)
*Md Aminur Hossain,Parekh Valkesh,Ayush V. Patel,Yogesh Jethani,Sanjay K. Singh,Biplab Banerjee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SFG-SwinSR，通过在Swin2SR的FFN中引入空间-频率门控机制（SFG-FFN），分离低频结构和高频细节，提升遥感图像超分辨率重建质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Swin Transformer超分模型的FFN仍然是通用的通道混合模块，无法区分低频结构内容与高频残差细节，限制了遥感图像细节重建能力。

Method: 用轻量级空间-频率门控前馈网络（SFG-FFN）替换Swin2SR中的标准FFN，包含深度模糊分支估计低频、减法提取高频残差、空间分支精炼、瓶颈门控自适应注入细节。

Result: 在SpaceNet上PSNR达45.19 dB，SSIM达0.9852，优于基线方法，有效增强高频细节。

Conclusion: 在Transformer FFN中引入空间-频率变换能有效改善遥感超分辨率的细节重建质量。

Abstract: Remote Sensing (RS) single-image super-resolution aims to reconstruct high-resolution imagery from low-resolution observations while preserving fine spatial structures. Recent Swin Transformer-based models, including Swin2SR, provide strong spatial context modeling throughshifted-window self-attention, but their feed-forward networks remain generic channel-mixing modules and do not separate low-frequency structural content from high-frequency residual detail. To address this limitation, we propose SFG-SwinSR, a Spatial-Frequency Gated Swin Transformer for single-image super-resolution in remote sensing. SFG-SwinSR modifies the original Swin2SR attention block by replacing each transformer block's standard feed-forward network with a lightweight Spatial-Frequency Gated Feed-Forward Network (SFG-FFN). The module estimates low-frequency content via a depthwise-blur branch, extracts high-frequency residuals by subtraction, refines them with a lightweight spatial branch, and adaptively injects detail through a bottleneck gate. Experiments on SpaceNet and SEN2VENμS show that SFG-SwinSR improves reconstruction quality under the evaluated settings. On SpaceNet, it achieves 45.19 dB PSNR and 0.9852 SSIM, indicating effective enhancement of high-frequency details. This demonstrates that spatial-frequency transformation within the transformer feed-forward network improves detail reconstruction in RS super-resolution.

</details>


### [192] [ConFixGS: Learning to Fix Feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Confidence-Aware Diffusion Priors in Driving Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09688)
*Rui Song,Tianhui Cai,Markus Gross,Xingcheng Zhou,Zewei Zhou,Zhiyu Huang,Olaf Wysocki,Jiaqi Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ConFixGS是一种即插即用方法，通过置信度感知的扩散先验来修复前馈3D高斯泼溅在稀疏视角驾驶场景中的重建问题，在Waymo、nuScenes和KITTI数据集上PSNR提升最高达3.68dB，FID降低近一半。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前馈3DGS在轨迹稀疏的驾驶场景中表现不佳，现有修复方法主要针对优化型3DGS，扩散修复也局限于观测视角附近的迭代优化，前馈3DGS的修复问题尚未被充分探索。

Method: 从预训练的前馈模型出发，生成扩散增强的局部伪目标，通过重投影交叉验证在支持视图间进行校验，生成稠密置信度图来引导细化过程，增强可靠细节同时抑制幻觉或不一致的证据。

Result: 在Waymo、nuScenes和KITTI数据集上，ConFixGS显著提升了挑战性的新视角合成质量，PSNR提升最高达3.68 dB，FID降低近一半。

Conclusion: 置信度感知的生成先验与支持视图一致性融合是实现鲁棒前馈3D驾驶场景重建的关键原则。

Abstract: Feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) often struggles in trajectory-based sparse-view driving scenes. Existing Gaussian repair methods mainly target optimization-based 3DGS, while diffusion-based repair is typically restricted to iterative refinement near observed viewpoints, leaving feedforward 3DGS repair underexplored. We propose ConFixGS, a plug-and-play method that learns to fix feedforward 3DGS with confidence-aware diffusion priors. Starting from a pretrained feedforward model, ConFixGS generates diffusion-enhanced local pseudo-targets and validates them through reprojection-based cross-checking against support views. The resulting dense confidence maps guide refinement, enhancing reliable details while suppressing hallucinated or inconsistent evidence. On Waymo, nuScenes, and KITTI, ConFixGS improves challenging novel view synthesis, with PSNR gains of up to 3.68 dB and FID reduced by nearly half. Our results highlight confidence-aware fusion of generative priors and support-view consistency as a key principle for robust feedforward 3D driving scene reconstruction.

</details>


### [193] [Do multimodal models imagine electric sheep?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09693)
*Santhosh Kumar Ramakrishnan,Carl Vondrick,Raja Giryes,Philipp Krähenbühl,Vladlen Koltun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文发现大多模态模型在解决空间谜题时会自发形成"心理意象"（mental imagery），通过监督模型预测动作序列，模型激活中编码了中间状态的视觉信息。在此基础上，将少量视觉token（每步16个）融入思维链，可将平均求解率从83%提升至89%，尤其在推理密集型任务上效果显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究大多模态模型（VLMs）在解决空间推理任务时是否能够自发形成内部视觉世界模型（mental imagery），以及如何利用这种内隐的视觉表征来提升推理性能。

Method: 对Qwen3.5 VLM在12种视觉推理任务（七巧板、拼图、推箱子、3D心理旋转、rush hour等）上进行微调，监督模型预测开环动作序列。通过分析模型每步动作后的激活状态，发现其编码了中间状态的视觉信息。进一步提出两种方法锐化并利用这些心理图像，其中一种是将每步16个视觉token融入思维链（CoT）。

Result: 模型激活确实编码了中间状态的视觉信息，表明不完美的视觉世界模型作为学习正确动作的副产品自发形成。将每步16个视觉token融入CoT后，平均求解率从83%提升至89%，在拼图和3D心理旋转等推理密集型任务上提升尤为明显。

Conclusion: 大多模态模型可以在没有显式视觉监督的情况下，通过学习动作选择自发形成内部视觉世界模型；注入少量视觉token到思维链中能有效利用这种心理意象，显著提升空间推理能力。

Abstract: Yes. We find that large multimodal models develop mental imagery when solving spatial puzzles, and they do imagine sheep when solving sheep puzzles. We fine-tune a Qwen3.5 VLM to solve twelve diverse visual reasoning tasks -- including tangram, jigsaw, sokoban, 3D mental rotation, and rush hour -- that require understanding geometry, spatial relationships, and the consequences of actions. By supervising the model to predict the open-loop sequence of actions to solve a puzzle from an initial state, we show that the model's activations after each action encode meaningful visual information about the intermediate state. This finding suggests that an imperfect visual world model begins to form as a byproduct of learning to select correct actions, in the absence of any explicit visual supervision. Building on this observation, we propose two ways to sharpen and use the mental images formed by the model. We find that integrating as few as sixteen visual tokens per step into the chain of thought improves the average solve rate from 83% to 89%, with particularly strong gains on reasoning-heavy tasks such as jigsaw and 3D mental rotation.

</details>


### [194] [Discriminative Span as a Predictor of Synthetic Data Utility via Classifier Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09697)
*Radhika Amar Desai,Modigari Narendra*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种几何驱动的指标，利用预训练基础模型的嵌入空间，通过线性分类器权重向量在合成数据差异向量张成子空间上的投影误差，无需训练即可预测合成数据对下游二分类模型性能的效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在医学影像、工业检测等真实视觉应用中，正样本极度稀缺，常用图像变换生成合成正样本，但缺乏有效方法评估合成数据能否真正提升下游模型性能。

Method: 在预训练基础模型的嵌入空间中，用样本间差异向量表示数据集，计算线性分类器权重向量在这些差异向量张成子空间上的相对投影误差；投影误差低则合成数据捕获了任务相关方向，效用高。

Result: 在多个数据集和不同架构上，该指标与使用真实负样本+合成正样本训练的CNN的下游分类性能呈现强相关。

Conclusion: 该几何驱动指标可作为数据稀缺场景下评估合成数据质量的实用且信息丰富的工具。

Abstract: In many real-world computer vision applications, including medical imaging and industrial inspection, binary classification tasks are characterized by a severe scarcity of positive samples. A widely adopted solution is to generate synthetic positive data using image-to-image transformations applied to negative samples. However, a fundamental challenge remains: how can we reliably assess whether such synthetic data will improve downstream model performance? In this work, we propose a geometry-driven metric that predicts the utility of synthetic data without requiring model training. Our approach operates in the embedding space of a pre-trained foundation model and represents the dataset through difference vectors between samples. We evaluate whether the weight vector of a linear classifier can be expressed within the subspace spanned by these variations by measuring the relative projection error. Intuitively, if the variations induced by synthetic data capture task-relevant directions, their span can approximate the classifier, resulting in low projection error. Conversely, poor synthetic data fails to span these directions, leading to higher error. Across multiple datasets and architectures, we show that this metric exhibits strong correlation with downstream classification performance of CNNs trained on mixtures of real negative and synthetic positive data. These findings suggest that the proposed metric serves as a practical and informative tool for evaluating synthetic data quality in data-scarce settings.

</details>


### [195] [DriveFuture: Future-Aware Latent World Models for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09701)
*Yufeng Hong,Xiaotian Zhou,Yingyan Li,Xiangpo Zhou,Lin Liu,Yadan Luo,Shaoqing Xu,Lei Yang,Ziying Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DriveFuture是一种面向自动驾驶的未来感知潜在世界建模框架，通过将当前潜状态建模显式地以未来世界状态为条件，实现规划导向的前瞻性。该框架在NAVSIM基准测试上取得了SOTA性能，并排名第一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有潜在世界模型将未来潜状态视为预测目标或辅助信号，而非直接用于调节轨迹规划，导致当前特征与未来特征在潜空间中的纠缠。本文旨在通过学习显式的规划导向前瞻性来解决这一问题。

Method: 训练时，模型从当前潜状态和自车动作预测未来潜状态，再通过交叉注意力机制与真实未来潜状态进行精炼，得到未来感知潜状态；该状态作为扩散轨迹规划器的显式条件。推理时，用预测的未来潜状态替代真实的未来状态作为条件。

Result: 在NAVSIM-v2 navhard上达到55.5 EPDMS，navtest上达到89.9 EPDMS；NAVSIM-v1 navtest上达到90.7 PDMS。截至2026年4月，在NAVSIM-v2 navhard排行榜排名第一。

Conclusion: 潜在世界建模的关键不仅在于模拟未来状态，更在于将未来状态作为当前决策的条件。显式的未来条件化比隐式地预测未来更有效。

Abstract: Existing latent world models for autonomous driving have opened a promising path toward future-aware driving intelligence. However, they typically treat future latent states as prediction targets or auxiliary signals, rather than directly conditioning trajectory planning. This can entangle current and future features in latent space. In this work, we propose DriveFuture, a future-aware latent world modeling framework for autonomous driving that explicitly learns planning-oriented foresight by conditioning the current latent state modeling process on future world states. Specifically, during training, the model first predicts future latent world states from the current latent state and ego action, and then refines the prediction against the ground-truth future latent state via cross-attention. The resulting future-aware latent serves as an explicit condition for a diffusion-based trajectory planner. During inference, DriveFuture conditions on the predicted future latent state instead of the ground-truth future state. DriveFuture achieves SOTA performance on the public NAVSIM benchmarks, reaching \textbf{55.5} EPDMS on NAVSIM-v2 {\textcolor{blue}{\textit{navhard}}}, \textbf{89.9} EPDMS on NAVSIM-v2 {\textcolor{blue}{\textit{navtest}}}, and \textbf{90.7} PDMS on NAVSIM-v1 {\textcolor{blue}{\textit{navtest}}}, respectively. These results suggest that the key to latent world modeling lies not merely in simulating future states, but more importantly in conditioning current decision-making on future states. Notably, as of April 2026, DriveFuture ranks \textbf{1st} on the \href{https://huggingface.co/spaces/AGC2025/e2e-driving-navhard}{NAVSIM-v2 {\textcolor{blue}{\textit{navhard}}}} leaderboard and achieves SOTA performance on \href{https://huggingface.co/spaces/AGC2024-P/e2e-driving-navtest}{NAVSIM-v1 {\textcolor{blue}{\textit{navtest}}}}.

</details>


### [196] [MOTOR-Bench: A Real-world Dataset and Multi-agent Framework for Zero-shot Human Mental State Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09703)
*Xiaoyu Yuan,Niklas Heikkala,Tiina Törmänen,Hanna Järvenoja,Guoying Zhao,Haoyu Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MOTOR-Bench基准和MOTOR-dataset数据集（1440个多模态视频片段，基于协作学习场景），并针对现有方法在理解人类心理状态方面的不足，设计了MOTOR-MAS多智能体推理框架，在行为、认知和情感三维标签预测上显著超越现有模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前研究多聚焦于预测孤立的心理状态标签，缺乏对复杂人际交互的结构化标注；现有模型在从可观察行为推理深层心理状态方面表现有限。

Method: 构建MOTOR-dataset（1440个多模态协作学习视频，由教育专家基于自我调节学习理论标注）；提出MOTOR-MAS多智能体推理框架，通过结构化智能体协调机制推断显式行为、内部认知和心理情感。

Result: MOTOR-MAS在行为、认知、情感三维标签上Macro-F1超越最佳单模型15.93分；在内部认知预测上超越通用多智能体基准10.2分。

Conclusion: 现有方法在结构化心理状态推理上仍有局限，MOTOR-MAS证明了多智能体协调机制能有效提升从行为到深层心理状态的推理能力。

Abstract: Understanding human mental states from natural behavior is crucial for intelligent systems in the real world. However, most current research focuses on predicting isolated mental state labels, lacking structured annotations of complex interpersonal interactions. To support structured analysis, we introduce MOTOR-Bench, a carefully-designed benchmark with a real-world dataset MOTOR-dataset, containing 1,440 multimodal video clips in collaborative learning scenarios, reflecting key real-world data challenges including natural class imbalance, visual noise, and domain-specific language. Each sample is labeled by educational experts based on self-regulated learning theory. We further evaluate several state-of-the-art multimodal large language models and multi-agent systems in a zero-shot setting on our MOTOR-Bench. However, their performance on this task remains limited, suggesting that existing methods still struggle with structured reasoning from observable behavior to deeper mental states. To address this challenge, we propose a reasoning multi-agent framework, named MOTOR-MAS. It coordinates multiple agents through a structured agent coordination mechanism to infer explicit behaviors, internal cognitions, and psychological emotions. Experimental results show that our MOTOR-MAS outperforms the best single-model benchmark by 15.93 points in Macro-F1 scores for the three labels of behavior, cognition, and emotion, and outperforms the general multi-agent benchmark by 10.2 points in internal cognition prediction.

</details>


### [197] [Distilling 3D Spatial Reasoning into a Lightweight Vision-Language Model with CoT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09719)
*Alaa Asfour,Christopher Indris,Leihan Chen,Tejas Vyas,Guanghui Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出知识蒸馏框架，将7B参数的3D视觉语言模型压缩为2.29B的学生模型，推理延迟降低8.7倍、模型大小减少3倍。创新性地引入"隐式思维链"（Hidden CoT）机制，通过可学习的潜变量令牌在答案生成前进行内部推理，在ScanNet和3D-FRONT数据集上达到68-72%的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模3D视觉语言模型（如LLaVA-3D）虽然具备强大的空间推理能力，但由于计算成本过高，难以在资源受限平台上部署。

Method: 采用知识蒸馏框架，使用VGGT作为视觉编码器，结合多任务蒸馏流水线和不确定性感知的损失权重分配。核心创新是"隐式思维链"（Hidden CoT）——在答案生成前插入可学习的潜变量令牌作为内部草稿板，无需外部思维链数据即可增强推理能力。

Result: 学生模型推理延迟降低8.7倍，模型大小减少3倍，保留教师模型54-72%的性能。在ScanNet和3D-FRONT上，临近和接触类任务准确率达68-72%。

Conclusion: 提出的框架有效实现了3D VLMs的轻量化部署，首次在蒸馏后的3D VLMs中使用潜变量草稿板推理，为资源受限平台上的3D场景问答提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Large-scale 3D vision-language models (VLMs) like LLaVA-3D offer strong spatial reasoning but are difficult to deploy due to high computational costs. We propose a knowledge distillation framework that transfers spatial reasoning from a 7B teacher to a 2.29B student model. Our approach achieves 8.7x lower inference latency and a 3x reduction in model size while retaining 54-72% of the teacher's performance. The framework utilizes VGGT as the vision encoder and a multi-task distillation pipeline with uncertainty-aware loss weighting. To improve reasoning without chain-of-thought (CoT) data, we introduce "Hidden CoT": learnable latent tokens that serve as an internal scratchpad before answer generation. This is the first use of latent scratchpad reasoning in distilled 3D VLMs. The student model jointly performs spatial description, depth estimation, and object detection. Experiments on ScanNet and 3D-FRONT show strong spatial understanding, reaching 68-72% accuracy on proximity and contact tasks. Our framework enables efficient 3D scene QA on resource-constrained platforms.

</details>


### [198] [On-Policy Distillation with Best-of-N Teacher Rollout Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09725)
*Ke Zhang,Yunjie Tian,DongDi Zhao,Yijiang Li,Yuanye Liu,Vishal M Patel,Di Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BRTS是一种Best-of-N Rollout Teacher Selection框架，通过从多个教师轨迹中挑选最佳轨迹（优先正确性，其次与学生对齐）进行知识蒸馏，解决了标准on-policy distillation中教师监督信号高方差的问题，在AIME 2024/2025和AMC 2023上显著提升了推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准on-policy distillation（OPD）中，教师监督基于学生生成的噪声上下文且通常只采样一次教师轨迹，导致监督信号方差高（轨迹可能错误、信息不足或与学生推理行为不匹配），限制了蒸馏效果。

Method: BRTS框架：1）采样少量教师轨迹（Best-of-N）；2）按优先级选择辅助轨迹：先确保正确性，再选择与学生当前行为最对齐的轨迹；3）当无条件教师采样失败时，引入ground-truth-conditioned恢复步骤生成自然推导；4）选中的轨迹用于在OPD循环内提供可靠的教师上下文监督，并增加辅助损失。

Result: 在AIME 2024、AIME 2025和AMC 2023基准上，BRTS优于标准OPD，且在更难的推理数据集上提升最大。

Conclusion: BRTS通过多轨迹采样和智能选择策略，有效降低了OPD中教师监督的方差，为推理任务的知识蒸馏提供了一种更稳健、更高效的改进方案。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD), which supervises a student on its own sampled trajectories, has emerged as a data-efficient post-training method for improving reasoning while avoiding the reward dependence of reinforcement learning and the catastrophic forgetting often observed in standard supervised fine-tuning. However, standard OPD typically computes teacher supervision under noisy student-generated contexts and often relies on a single stochastic teacher rollout per prompt. As a result, the supervision signal can be high-variance: the sampled teacher trajectory can be incorrect, uninformative, or poorly matched to the student's current reasoning behavior. To address this limitation, we propose BRTS, a Best-of-N Rollout Teacher Selection framework for on-policy distillation. BRTS augments standard student-context OPD with a teacher-context supervision branch constructed from the curated teacher trajectory. Rather than distilling from the first sampled teacher rollout, BRTS samples a small pool of teacher trajectories and selects the auxiliary trajectory using a simple priority rule: correctness first, student alignment second. When multiple correct teacher trajectories are available, BRTS chooses the one most aligned with the student's current behavior; when unconditioned teacher samples fail on harder prompts, it invokes a ground-truth-conditioned recovery step to elicit a natural derivation. The selected trajectory is then used to provide reliable teacher-context supervision inside the OPD loop, augmented with an auxiliary loss on the teacher trajectory. Experiments on AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and AMC 2023 show that BRTS improves over standard OPD on challenging reasoning benchmarks, with the largest gains on harder datasets. Our code is available at https://github.com/BWGZK-keke/BRTS.

</details>


### [199] [Fetal Brain Imaging: A Composite Neural Network Approach for Keyframe Detection in Ultrasound Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09750)
*Aleksander Zamojski,Kacper Jarczak,Radoslaw Roszczyk*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合CNN和RNN的复合神经网络，用于从超声视频中检测胎儿脑部关键帧，以提升产前诊断效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有超声视频分析依赖人工筛选关键帧，耗时且主观性强，亟需自动化方法提升检测效率与准确性，支持胎儿脑部疾病的早期诊断。

Method: 构建CNN-RNN复合网络：CNN提取单帧空间特征，RNN捕捉帧间时序依赖关系，实现从超声视频序列中自动识别关键帧。

Result: 模型能够提升胎儿脑部超声分析的效率与准确性，有助于更早地检测、诊断和规划治疗方案。

Conclusion: 该CNN-RNN结合的方法为超声视频关键帧检测提供了有效方案，有望在产前超声诊断中发挥实际价值。

Abstract: This article presents a novel approach to keyframe detection in ultrasound videos, with a particular focus on fetal brain imaging. The proposed model is a composite neural network architecture that combines a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) with a Recurrent Neural Network (RNN). The CNN extracts spatial features from individual video frames, while the RNN captures temporal dependencies between consecutive frames within each video sequence.
  The proposed model may improve the efficiency and accuracy of fetal brain ultrasound analysis, thereby supporting earlier detection, diagnosis, and treatment planning for selected fetal brain conditions.

</details>


### [200] [DRIVE-C: A Controlled Corruption Dataset for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09774)
*Shiva Aher*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DRIVE-C是一个用于评估自动驾驶视觉感知鲁棒性的受控退化数据集，包含10个干净视频片段和600个退化片段，涵盖12种相机退化类型和5个严重级别，支持鲁棒性基准测试、退化感知建模、不确定性估计、OOD检测和传感器健康监测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶数据集缺乏系统性的、可复现的相机退化模拟，难以全面评估视觉感知系统在实际环境中的鲁棒性。作者旨在构建一个结构化的受控退化测试平台。

Method: 从真实驾驶视频中收集干净片段，通过局部人脸和车牌模糊进行匿名化，然后应用物理启发的合成退化方法生成12种相机退化类型、5个严重级别的共600个退化片段，并提供像素级对齐的干净/退化视频对、元数据和GSHI标注。

Result: 构建了包含10个干净片段和600个退化片段的DRIVE-C数据集，覆盖白天/夜间、城市/乡村/高速/停车场等多种场景，所有退化参数完全可复现。

Conclusion: DRIVE-C为自动驾驶视觉感知的鲁棒性研究提供了结构化的受控测试平台，支持多项可靠性研究方向，有助于推动ADAS系统的感知可靠性提升。

Abstract: DRIVE-C is a controlled corruption dataset designed to evaluate visual perception robustness in autonomous driving systems. It is built from real-world forward-facing driving videos collected across daytime, nighttime, urban, rural, freeway, and parking environments. Clean clips are anonymized via localized face and license plate blurring, then transformed with physics-inspired synthetic degradations. The dataset contains 10 clean clips and 600 corrupted clips spanning 12 camera degradation types across five severity levels, with per-clip metadata and Global Sensor Health Index (GSHI) annotations. DRIVE-C supports robustness benchmarking, degradation-aware modeling, uncertainty estimation, out-of-distribution (OOD) detection, and sensor health monitoring for Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS). By providing pixel-aligned clean and degraded video clips with fully reproducible corruption parameters, DRIVE-C offers a structured testbed for studying perception reliability under controlled camera degradation.

</details>


### [201] [CrossVL: Complexity-Aware Feature Routing and Paired Curriculum for Cross-View Vision-Language Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09802)
*Zhipeng Liu,Chunbo Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CrossVL框架，通过复杂度感知路径聚合(CPA)和成对课程学习(PCL)解决地面与航拍视角下视觉语言模型检测性能下降问题，在MAVREC上提升Florence-2的航拍mAP 2.37%，缩小视角性能差距至6.65pp，方差降低3.3倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在跨视角场景（地面vs航拍）下因视角高度、尺度、空间布局差异导致检测性能严重下降，固定的VLM融合机制无法处理视角间的复杂度差异（地面密集遮挡vs航拍稀疏全局）。

Method: 提出CrossVL框架，包含两个核心模块：1) 复杂度感知路径聚合(CPA)：从多模态统计量估计场景复杂度，通过多条路径路由视觉特征获得视角特定表示；2) 成对课程学习(PCL)：利用同步地面-航拍对的语义一致性提供稳定早期监督，逐步过渡到随机采样训练。

Result: 在MAVREC上，Florence-2的航拍mAP从58.66%提升至61.03%，地面-航拍性能差距从8.63pp降至6.65pp，随机种子间方差降低3.3倍。

Conclusion: CPA提供了稳定的复杂度感知特征聚合，PCL增强了优化动态，协同的架构和训练适应策略是实现鲁棒跨视角VLM检测的关键。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) enable text-guided object detection but degrade severely under cross-view scenarios where ground and aerial viewpoints differ in altitude, scale, and spatial layout. These geometric changes introduce systematic complexity variations between viewpoints, e.g., ground view images contain dense and highly occluded structures, while aerial images are sparse and globally organized. Fixed VLM fusion mechanisms cannot handle this discrepancy. We propose CrossVL, a framework combining Complexity-Aware Pathway Aggregation (CPA) and Paired Curriculum Learning (PCL) for enhanced cross-view detection for VLM. CPA estimates scene complexity from multimodal statistics and routes visual features through multiple pathways to obtain view-specific representations. PCL leverages semantic consistency of synchronized ground-aerial pairs to provide stable early supervision and then gradually shifts toward randomized sampling. On MAVREC, CrossVL improves Florence-2's aerial mAP from 58.66% to 61.03% and reduces the ground-aerial performance gap from 8.63pp to 6.65pp, while also achieving a 3.3x reduction in variance across random seeds. CPA provides stable complexity-aware feature aggregation, and PCL enhances optimization dynamics. Together, they demonstrate that coordinated architectural and training adaptations are crucial for robust cross-view VLM detection.

</details>


### [202] [Fashion Florence: Fine-Tuning Florence-2 for Structured Fashion Attribute Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09827)
*Anushree Berlia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Fashion Florence，一个基于Florence-2并用LoRA微调的视觉语言模型，用于从服装图像中提取结构化时尚属性（类别、颜色、材质、风格、场合），输出JSON格式。在iMaterialist数据集上训练，以0.77B参数实现94.6%类别准确率、63.0%材质准确率，优于GPT-4o-mini和Gemini 2.5 Flash，并已部署为Hugging Face Space并集成到开源推荐系统Loom中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有通用大模型（如GPT-4o-mini、Gemini）在细粒度时尚属性提取任务上精度不足且输出格式不可控，无法直接用于下游推荐系统。需要一种轻量、高精度、输出结构化的专用模型。

Method: 基于Florence-2视觉语言模型，使用LoRA（r=16, alpha=32）微调所有解码器线性层；从iMaterialist Fashion数据集（228标签）通过规则工程压缩为6类别、16颜色、19风格的标签体系；在3,688张图片上训练3个epoch。

Result: 测试集461张图片上：类别准确率94.6%，材质准确率63.0%，优于GPT-4o-mini（89.3%/43.3%）和Gemini 2.5 Flash（87.4%）。JSON有效输出率99.8%，风格标签F1为0.753（vs Gemini 0.612, GPT-4o-mini 0.398）。模型仅0.77B参数，可在单GPU上零边际成本推理。

Conclusion: 通过LoRA微调Florence-2，可在极低参数量下实现比通用大模型更优的时尚属性提取性能，且输出格式高度可控，适合实际生产环境部署。

Abstract: We present Fashion Florence, a Florence-2 vision-language model fine-tuned with LoRA to extract structured fashion attributes from clothing images. Given a single photograph, the model generates a JSON object containing category, color, material, style tags, and occasion tags, structured output suitable for direct programmatic consumption by downstream recommendation and retrieval systems. Fine-tuning data is derived from the iMaterialist Fashion dataset (228 labels), where we collapse fine-grained annotations into a compact 6-category, 16-color, 19-style schema via rule-based label engineering. We apply LoRA (r=16, alpha=32) to all decoder linear layers, training for 3 epochs on 3,688 examples. On a held-out test set of 461 images, Fashion Florence achieves 94.6% category accuracy and 63.0% material accuracy, compared to 89.3% / 43.3% for GPT-4o-mini and 87.4% for Gemini 2.5 Flash. Fashion Florence produces valid JSON in 99.8% of outputs while running at 0.77B parameters on a single GPU at zero marginal inference cost. Style tag F1 reaches 0.753 vs. 0.612 (Gemini) and 0.398 (GPT-4o-mini). The model is deployed as a Hugging Face Space and integrated into Loom, an open-source outfit recommendation system.

</details>


### [203] [Probing Routing-Conditional Calibration in Attention-Residual Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09850)
*Wenhao Liang,Lin Yue,Wei Emma Zhang,Miao Xu,Mingyu Guo,Olaf Maennel,Weitong Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究注意力残差（AR）Transformer中，路由追踪信息能否在置信度之外提供稳定的后验校准信号。通过匹配置信度的诊断套件、置换检验、以及多种控制实验，发现路由摘要信息并不能稳定改善校准，表观提升经容量匹配和置换检验控制后即消失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后验校准方法通常仅基于logits或softmax置信度，但越来越多的路由增强架构同时输出样本级路由追踪信息，并声称这些信息蕴含与校准相关的不确定性。作者希望验证：路由追踪信息是否确实能为后验校准提供置信度之外的稳定证据。

Method: 在Attention-Residual (AR) Transformer上构建匹配置信度的诊断套件：(1) 按路由派生状态对样本分层，比较子组差距与组内路由置换零假设；(2) 设计仅辅助特征不同的后验探针（如AR-CondCal的2-D Nadaraya-Watson探针、全向量MLP）；(3) 引入容量匹配、带宽敏感性、置换检验等控制实验。

Result: 标量路由摘要不提供稳定的路由条件校准证据：加权差距小或对种子敏感，30次组内置换检验仅1次在α=0.05下拒绝条件零假设（且不稳定）。AR-CondCal落在置信度仅限和预测熵对照的种子方差带内，未能可靠改善最差路由三分位ECE。全向量MLP的表观提升在加入容量匹配的置信度仅限MLP控制后消失，且打乱的路由配置也能达到类似性能。

Conclusion: 在AR设置中，路由感知校准的表观提升不可直接解读为内部状态校准，必须通过匹配置信度、带宽、容量和置换检验等控制来排除常见混淆因素。

Abstract: Post-hoc calibration is usually evaluated as a function of logits or softmax confidence alone, even as routing-augmented architectures increasingly accompany predictions with sample-specific internal routing traces and pair them with claims of calibration-relevant uncertainty. We ask a basic question: do these traces provide stable routing-specific evidence for post-hoc calibration beyond confidence? We study this in Attention-Residual transformers (Kimi Team, 2026) through a matched-confidence diagnostic suite that stratifies examples by routing-derived state, compares subgroup gaps against within-bin routing-permutation nulls, and evaluates matched post-hoc probes differing only in their auxiliary feature. Across our completed AR runs, scalar routing summaries do not provide stable evidence of routing-conditional miscalibration: weighted gaps remain small or seed-sensitive, and only $1$ of $30$ within-bin permutation tests rejects the conditional-null at $α=0.05$ (only on one seed; not stable across seeds in that cell). AR-CondCal, a minimal $2$-D Nadaraya--Watson probe on confidence and routing-depth variance, lies within the seed-variance band of matched confidence-only and predictive-entropy controls and does not reliably improve worst-routing-tertile ECE; bandwidth-sensitivity checks (Scott multiples, CV-NLL, global-ECE oracle) do not change this. A full-vector MLP over $(c, H_1, \ldots, H_L)$ can appear to improve over a linear confidence baseline, but the apparent gain disappears once a capacity-matched confidence-only MLP is included as a control, and shuffled routing profiles achieve comparable performance. Apparent routing-aware calibration gains in this AR setting should not be read as internal-state calibration until matched-confidence, bandwidth, capacity, and permutation controls rule out common confounds.

</details>


### [204] [MoPO: Incorporating Motion Prior for Occluded Human Mesh Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09856)
*Tao Tang,Hong Liu,Xinshun Wang,Wanruo Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MoPO通过结合运动先验（历史姿态序列）来处理遮挡情况下的人体网格恢复问题，提出运动去遮挡模块和运动感知融合细化模块，在遮挡和标准基准上均达到SOTA，显著提升了准确性和时间一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的人体网格恢复方法在遮挡场景下鲁棒性不足，由于缺乏被遮挡身体部位的充分空间特征，常产生不准确的姿态和严重的运动抖动。

Method: 1) 运动去遮挡模块：包含时空遮挡检测器检测关节可见性，以及轻量运动预测器基于历史姿态补全被遮挡关节位置；2) 运动感知融合与细化模块：将补全的关节序列与图像特征融合以估计人体形状和初始姿态，并通过逆运动学进一步细化最终人体姿态，提供无遮挡的运动先验。

Result: 在遮挡专用和标准基准上均达到SOTA性能，显著提升了遮挡情况下人体网格恢复的准确性和时间一致性。

Conclusion: 利用运动先验（姿态序列）可以有效补偿被遮挡的图像特征，是提升遮挡鲁棒性的有效途径。

Abstract: Although recent studies have made remarkable progress in human mesh recovery, they still exhibit limited robustness to occlusions and often produce inaccurate poses and severe motion jitter due to the insufficient spatial features for occluded body parts. Inspired by the rapid advancements in human motion prediction, we discover that compared to occluded image features, pose sequence inherently contains reliable motion prior for estimating occluded body parts. In this paper, we incorporate Motion Prior for Occluded human mesh recovery, called MoPO. Our MoPO mainly consists of two components: 1) The motion de-occlusion module, where we propose a spatial-temporal occlusion detector to detect joint visibility, and then we propose a lightweight motion predictor to complete the occluded body parts by predicting the most plausible joint positions based on history poses. 2) The motion-aware fusion and refinement module, which fuses the completed joint sequence with image features to estimate human shape and initial human pose. Moreover, the completed joint sequence is further used to refine the final human pose through inverse kinematics, which provides the occlusion-free motion prior for regressing human poses. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MoPO achieves state-of-the-art performance on both occlusion-specific and standard benchmarks, significantly enhancing the accuracy and temporal consistency of occluded human mesh recovery. Our code and demo can be found in the supplementary material.

</details>


### [205] [Clip-level Uncertainty and Temporal-aware Active Learning for End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09858)
*Riku Inoue,Shogo Sato,Kazuhiko Murasaki,Tomoyasu Shimada,Toshihiko Nishimura,Ryuichi Tanida*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CUTAL，一种面向端到端MOT模型的片段级主动学习方法，通过多帧不确定性度量与时间多样性采样，在50%标注数据下达到全监督性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主动学习方法在帧级别操作，与现代端到端跟踪器依赖多帧片段的推理和训练结构不匹配，存在结构性错位。

Method: 提出片段级主动学习方法CUTAL：设计基于多帧预测的不确定性指标以捕捉帧间对应歧义，并引入时间多样性约束来选择信息丰富且不冗余的片段子集。

Result: 在MeMOTR和SambaMOTR上，相同标注预算下CUTAL优于基线方法；使用50%标注数据即可达到全监督性能。

Conclusion: 片段级主动学习比帧级方法更适配端到端MOT模型，能显著降低标注成本而不牺牲性能。

Abstract: Multi-Object Tracking (MOT) in dynamic environments relies on robust temporal reasoning to maintain consistent object identities over time. Transformer-based end-to-end MOT models achieve strong performance by explicitly modeling temporal dependencies, yet training them requires extensive bounding-box and identity annotations. Given the high labeling cost and strong redundancy in videos, Active Learning (AL) is an effective approach to improve annotation efficiency. However, existing AL methods for MOT primarily operate at the frame level, which is structurally misaligned with modern end-to-end trackers whose inference and training rely on multi-frame clips. To bridge this gap, we formulate clip-level active learning and propose Clip-level Uncertainty and Temporal-aware Active Learning (CUTAL). In contrast to frame-based approaches, CUTAL scores each clip using uncertainty metrics derived from multi-frame predictions to capture inter-frame correspondence ambiguities, while enforcing temporal diversity to select an informative and non-redundant subset. Experiments show that CUTAL achieves stronger overall performance than baselines at the same label budgets across MeMOTR and SambaMOTR. Notably, CUTAL achieves performance comparable to full supervision for MeMOTR on both datasets using only 50% of the labeled training data.

</details>


### [206] [Learning to Align Generative Appearance Priors for Fine-grained Image Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09859)
*Shijie Wang,Yadan Luo,Zijian Wang,Xin Yu,Zi Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GAPan提出了一种生成式外观先验对齐网络，利用归一化流将检索特征映射到潜在密度空间，通过可逆建模保留外观细节，并利用类条件高斯先验生成外观感知锚点，从而改善细粒度图像检索在未见类别上的泛化性能，在多个基准上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有细粒度图像检索依赖可见类别监督，导致模型偏向已见类别的语义信息，而非跨类别泛化的外观特征，限制了未见类别的检索性能。

Method: 1）利用归一化流（可逆密度模型）将实例特征映射到潜在密度空间；2）对每个已见类别建模类条件高斯先验，通过精确似然估计优化；3）从先验高密度区域采样，逆映射回特征空间生成外观感知锚点；4）利用这些锚点指导先验驱动对齐目标，对齐检索嵌入与类别外观分布。

Result: 在细粒度和粗粒度基准数据集上均取得了最先进的检索性能。

Conclusion: 通过将检索目标从类别预测转向外观建模，GAPan有效提升了模型对未见类别的泛化能力，验证了生成式外观先验在细粒度检索中的有效性。

Abstract: Fine-grained image retrieval (FGIR) typically relies on supervision from seen categories to learn discriminative embeddings for retrieving unseen categories. However, such supervision often biases retrieval models toward the semantics of seen categories rather than the underlying appearance characteristics that generalize across categories, thereby limiting retrieval performance on unseen categories. To tackle this, we propose GAPan, a Generative Appearance Prior alignment network that reformulates the learning objective from category prediction toward appearance modeling. Technically, GAPan treats retrieval features with an invertible density model based on normalizing flows. In the forward direction, the flow maps all instance features into a latent density space, where each seen category is modeled by a class-conditional Gaussian prior and optimized via exact likelihood estimation. This formulation preserves richer appearance details by leveraging the invertible property of the flows. In the reverse direction, samples from the high-density regions of these learned priors are mapped back to the feature space to produce appearance-aware anchors that reflect intra-category variation. These anchors supervise a prior-driven alignment objective that aligns retrieval embeddings with category-specific appearance distributions, thereby improving generalization to unseen categories. Evaluations demonstrate that our GAPan achieves state-of-the-art performance on both widely-used fine- and coarse-grained benchmarks.

</details>


### [207] [DA-SegFormer: Damage-Aware Semantic Segmentation for Fine-Grained Disaster Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09864)
*Kevin Zhu,William Tang,Raphael Hay Tene,Zesheng Liu,Nhut Le,Maryam Rahnemoonfar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DA-SegFormer通过类感知采样、OHEM与Dice Loss结合以及高分辨率推理，在灾害损伤分割任务上提升2.55% mIoU，尤其对Minor和Major Damage类别分别提升11.7%和21.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机灾害影像中细粒度损伤识别面临纹理退化与类别极端不平衡的挑战，现有方法难以区分轻微与严重屋顶损伤。

Method: 基于SegFormer架构，提出类感知采样策略保证罕见类别曝光，结合OHEM与Dice Loss动态聚焦少数类，并采用保留纹理细节的推理协议。

Result: 在RescueNet数据集上达到74.61% mIoU，超出基线2.55%，Minor Damage提升11.7%，Major Damage提升21.3%。

Conclusion: DA-SegFormer有效提升了灾害损伤细粒度分割的准确性，特别在关键损伤类别上取得了显著增益。

Abstract: Rapid and accurate damage assessment following natural disasters is critical for effective emergency response. However, identifying fine-grained damage levels (e.g., distinguishing minor from major roof damage) in UAV imagery remains challenging due to the degradation of texture cues during resizing and extreme class imbalance. We propose DA-SegFormer, a damage-aware adaptation of the SegFormer architecture optimized for high-resolution disaster imagery. Our method introduces a Class-Aware Sampling strategy to guarantee exposure to rare damage features, and it integrates Online Hard Example Mining (OHEM) with Dice Loss to dynamically focus on underrepresented classes. In addition, we employ a resolution-preserving inference protocol that maintains native texture details. Evaluated on the RescueNet dataset, DA-SegFormer achieves 74.61\% mIoU, outperforming the baseline by 2.55\%. Notably, our improvements yield double-digit gains in critical damage classes: Minor Damage (+11.7%) and Major Damage (+21.3%).

</details>


### [208] [EgoMemReason: A Memory-Driven Reasoning Benchmark for Long-Horizon Egocentric Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09874)
*Ziyang Wang,Yue Zhang,Shoubin Yu,Ce Zhang,Zengqi Zhao,Jaehong Yoon,Hyunji Lee,Gedas Bertasius,Mohit Bansal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了EgoMemReason基准，用于评估视觉模型在长达一周的自我中心视频上的记忆驱动推理能力，包含实体记忆、事件记忆和行为记忆三种类型共500个问题。最佳模型仅达到39.6%的准确率，表明长时程记忆推理仍是未解决的挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的周级视频基准主要面向感知和识别任务（如时刻定位、全局摘要），缺乏需要跨多天整合证据进行推理的评估。为填补这一空白，作者提出了EgoMemReason。

Method: 构建包含500个问题的基准，涵盖三种互补的记忆类型（实体记忆、事件记忆、行为记忆）和六个核心挑战，平均每个问题需要5.1个视频片段作为证据，回溯25.9小时的记忆。在17种方法（包括MLLMs和智能体框架）上进行了评估。

Result: 最佳模型整体准确率仅39.6%，三种记忆类型的失败原因各不相同，且随着证据跨越的时间范围变长，性能显著下降。

Conclusion: 长时程记忆驱动的视觉推理仍远未解决，EgoMemReason为评估和推进长上下文、记忆感知的多模态系统奠定了坚实基础。

Abstract: Next-generation visual assistants, such as smart glasses, embodied agents, and always-on life-logging systems, must reason over an entire day or more of continuous visual experience. In ultra-long video settings, relevant information is sparsely distributed across hours or days, making memory a fundamental challenge: models must accumulate information over time, recall prior states, track temporal order, and abstract recurring patterns. However, existing week-long video benchmarks are primarily designed for perception and recognition, such as moment localization or global summarization, rather than reasoning that requires integrating evidence across multiple days. To address this gap, we introduce EgoMemReason, a comprehensive benchmark that systematically evaluates week-long egocentric video understanding through memory-driven reasoning. EgoMemReason evaluates three complementary memory types: entity memory, tracking how object states evolve and change across days; event memory, recalling and ordering activities separated by hours or days; and behavior memory, abstracting recurring patterns from sparse, repeated observations over the whole week period. EgoMemReason comprises 500 questions across three memory types and six core challenges, with an average of 5.1 video segments of evidence per question and 25.9 hours of memory backtracking. We evaluate EgoMemReason on 17 methods across MLLMs and agentic frameworks, revealing that even the best model achieves only 39.6% overall accuracy. Further analysis shows that the three memory types fail for distinct reasons and that performance degrades as evidence spans longer temporal horizons, revealing that long-horizon memory remains far from solved. We believe EgoMemReason establishes a strong foundation for evaluating and advancing long-context, memory-aware multimodal systems.

</details>


### [209] [The Cartesian Shortcut: Re-evaluate Vision Reasoning in Polar Coordinate Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09883)
*Xia Hu,Zhenrui Yue,Brian Potetz,Howard Zhou,Leonidas Guibas,Chun-Ta Lu,Zhicheng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文指出当前多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在视觉推理基准上的高分并非源于真正的视觉理解，而是利用了基于正交网格布局的“笛卡尔捷径”。为此，作者提出Polaris-Bench基准，将任务转换为极坐标空间，打破正交先验。实验表明，前沿模型在笛卡尔布局上准确率可达70-83%，但在极坐标等价任务上骤降至31-39%，揭示了MLLMs缺乏拓扑不变的视觉推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉推理基准存在系统性漏洞：任务普遍基于正交网格布局，模型可通过文本坐标推理而非真正视觉理解来“作弊”，导致高分不代表真实能力。需要设计能消除这一捷径的评估方法。

Method: 提出Polaris-Bench，将53个视觉推理任务从笛卡尔坐标系转换为极坐标系，保持逻辑约束和任务语义不变，同时保留对应的笛卡尔版本作为参考，系统性地破坏模型依赖的正交先验。

Result: 14个SOTA MLLMs在笛卡尔布局上表现70-83%，在极坐标等价任务上骤降至31-39%，即使逻辑完全等价，性能退化依然存在，且推理能力提升在极坐标下消失。

Conclusion: 当前MLLMs缺乏拓扑不变的视觉推理能力，对坐标系统的变化高度敏感，视觉理解能力被严重高估，亟需更鲁棒的评估范式。

Abstract: As current Multimodal Large Language Models rapidly saturate canonical visual reasoning benchmarks, a key question emerges: do these strong scores genuinely reflect robust visual understanding? We identify a pervasive vulnerability, the \textbf{Cartesian Shortcut}: visual reasoning benchmarks prevalently build on orthogonal grid-based layouts that can be readily discretized into explicit textual coordinates. Models systematically exploit this property, heavily leveraging text-based deductive reasoning to assist visual problem-solving. To systematically dismantle this shortcut, we introduce \textbf{Polaris-Bench}, which re-formulates 53 visual reasoning tasks in Polar coordinate space with paired Cartesian counterparts as reference, while preserving consistent logical constraints and task semantics -- thus fundamentally breaking the orthogonal prior that models exploit. Comprehensive evaluation across $14$ state-of-the-art MLLMs reveals that frontier models achieving $70$--$83\%$ on Cartesian layouts collapse to $31$--$39\%$ on Polar equivalents, with degradation persisting even under complete logical equivalence. Moreover, reasoning gains observed on Cartesian layouts are severely diminished on Polar equivalents. These findings expose a critical deficiency in current MLLMs: the lack of topology-invariant visual reasoning.

</details>


### [210] [Hyperbolic Distillation: Geometry-Guided Cross-Modal Transfer for Robust 3D Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09899)
*Kanglin Ning,Wenrui Li,Houde Quan,Qifan Li,Xingtao Wang,Xiaopeng Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出HGC-Det，一种基于双曲约束的跨模态知识蒸馏方法，用于多模态3D目标检测，通过SGVO、HFT和FAGO三个核心组件解决模态异质性、空间错位和表征危机问题，在室内外数据集上实现了检测精度与计算成本的良好平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有跨模态知识蒸馏方法在3D感知任务中受限于模态异质性、空间错位以及多模态表征危机，导致蒸馏效率低下。本文旨在解决这些局限性。

Method: 提出HGC-Det框架，包含图像分支和点云分支。点云分支由三个核心组件构成：1) 2D语义引导的体素优化组件(SGVO)，利用图像语义优化3D空间表征；2) 双曲几何约束的跨模态特征迁移组件(HFT)，利用双曲空间几何特性缓解高维图像与低维点云特征融合中的语义损失；3) 特征聚合几何优化组件(FAGO)，补偿SGVO引入的空间特征退化。

Result: 在室内数据集(SUN RGB-D, ARKitScenes)和室外数据集(KITTI, nuScenes)上的大量实验表明，该方法在检测精度与计算成本之间实现了更好的平衡。

Conclusion: HGC-Det通过双曲空间约束有效缓解了跨模态蒸馏中的语义损失与空间错位问题，在多个基准数据集上取得优异性能。

Abstract: Cross-modal knowledge distillation has emerged as an effective strategy for integrating point cloud and image features in 3D perception tasks. However, the modality heterogeneity, spatial misalignment, and the representation crisis of multiple modalities often limit the efficient of these cross-modal distillation methods. To address these limitations in existing approaches, we propose a hyperbolic constrained cross-modal distillation method for multimodal 3D object detection (HGC-Det). The proposed HGC-Det framework includes an image branch and a point cloud branch to extract semantic features from two different modalities. The point cloud branch comprises three core components: a 2D semantic-guided voxel optimization component (SGVO), a hyperbolic geometry constrained cross-modal feature transfer component (HFT), and a feature aggregation-based geometry optimization component (FAGO). Specifically, the SGVO component adaptively refines the spatial representation of the 3D branch by leveraging semantic cues from the image branch, thereby mitigating the issue of inadequate representation fusion. The HFT component exploits the intrinsic geometric properties of hyperbolic space to alleviate semantic loss during the fusion of high-dimensional image features and low-dimensional point cloud features. Finally, the FAGO compensates for potential spatial feature degradation introduced by the 2D semantic-guided voxel optimization component. Extensive experiments on indoor datasets (SUN RGB-D, ARKitScenes) and outdoor datasets (KITTI, nuScenes) demonstrate that our method achieves a better trade-off between detection accuracy and computational cost.

</details>


### [211] [Adversarial Attacks Against MLLMs via Progressive Resolution Processing and Adaptive Feature Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09902)
*Haobo Wang,Xiaorong Ma,Weiqi Luo,Xiaojun Jia,Jiwu Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PRAF-Attack，通过渐进式分辨率处理和自适应特征对齐策略，提升针对多模态大语言模型的黑盒迁移攻击的迁移性和鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有迁移攻击依赖代理编码器的最终全局特征和固定原始分辨率目标裁剪，导致迁移性和鲁棒性有限，难以应对安全关键场景（如自动驾驶、医疗诊断）中的黑盒MLLM威胁。

Method: 1. 渐进式分辨率处理策略：从粗到细逐步优化，多尺度利用目标信息；2. 自适应特征对齐：通过梯度一致性选择代理集成模型中的可迁移中间层特征；3. 自适应补丁级优化：通过高效补丁过滤保留高相关局部区域。

Result: 在6个开源MLLM和6个闭源商业API上，与7个最先进基线相比，PRAF-Attack在迁移攻击成功率上持续取得更优效果。

Conclusion: PRAF-Attack有效提升了黑盒MLLM迁移攻击的迁移性，为理解与增强多模态模型鲁棒性提供了新思路。

Abstract: Adversarial perturbations can mislead Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) recognize a benign image as a specific target object, posing serious risks in safety-critical scenarios such as autonomous driving and medical diagnosis. This makes transfer-based targeted attacks crucial for understanding and improving black-box MLLM robustness. Existing transfer-based targeted attack methods typically rely on the final global features of the surrogate encoder and anchor optimization to original-resolution target crops, leading to their limited transferability and robustness. To address these challenges, we propose Progressive Resolution Processing and Adaptive Feature Alignment (PRAF-Attack), a targeted transfer-based attack framework that integrates multi-scale global semantic guidance with robust intermediate-layer local alignment. Unlike prior methods that align only the surrogate encoder's final layer, we design an adaptive feature alignment strategy that leverages intermediate representations to enhance transferability. Specifically, we introduce an adaptive intermediate layer selection mechanism to identify transferable hierarchical features across surrogate ensembles via gradient consistency, along with an adaptive patch-level optimization strategy that preserves highly correlated local regions through efficient patch filtering. To overcome the reliance on fixed original-resolution target crops, we propose a progressive resolution processing strategy that gradually refines optimization from coarse to fine, enabling the attack to better exploit target information at multiple scales and achieve stronger transferability. We evaluate PRAF-Attack on a diverse suite of black-box MLLMs, including six open-source models and six closed-source commercial APIs. Compared with seven state-of-the-art targeted attack baselines, the proposed PRAF-Attack consistently achieves superior transferability.

</details>


### [212] [TOC-Bench: A Temporal Object Consistency Benchmark for Video Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09904)
*Junzhe Chen,Siyuan Meng,Yuxi Chen,Man Zhao,Xiaojie Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出TOC-Bench基准，专门评估视频大语言模型在时间维度上保持物体一致性（身份、状态、连续性）的能力，发现现有模型尽管在通用视频理解上表现优异，但在事件计数、排序、身份推理和幻觉验证方面存在显著缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频理解基准主要关注事件识别或粗粒度时序推理，忽视了模型在物体被遮挡、消失、再现、状态变化及跨物体交互时能否保持时间一致性这一关键能力，导致对模型时序推理能力的评估存在高估。

Method: 构建TOC-Bench，采用物体轨迹追踪标注，提出三层时间必要性过滤协议（去除60.7%候选QA对），保留17,900个时间依赖项覆盖10个诊断维度，最终构建1,951个视频上的2,323个高质量人工验证QA对。

Result: 代表性Video-LLMs在TOC-Bench上表现不佳，在事件计数、事件排序、身份敏感推理和幻觉验证四个维度存在显著弱点，尽管它们在通用视频理解基准上表现强劲。

Conclusion: 时间物体一致性仍是Video-LLMs面临的主要挑战，现有模型远未解决该问题，需要专门的诊断基准来揭示和推动该方向的研究。

Abstract: Video large language models (Video-LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in general video understanding, yet their ability to maintain temporal object consistency remains insufficiently explored. Existing benchmarks primarily focus on event recognition, action understanding, or coarse temporal reasoning, but rarely evaluate whether a model can consistently preserve the identity, state, and temporal continuity of the same object across occlusion, disappearance, reappearance, state transitions, and cross-object interactions. As a result, current evaluations may overestimate temporal reasoning ability while overlooking failures in object-centric temporal coherence. To address this issue, we introduce TOC-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark specifically designed to evaluate temporal object consistency in Video-LLMs. TOC-Bench is explicitly object-track grounded, where each queried subject is associated with a per frame object trajectory and structured temporal event timeline. To ensure that benchmark items depend on temporally ordered visual evidence rather than language priors, single-frame shortcuts, or unordered frame cues, we propose a three-layer temporal-necessity filtering protocol that removes 60.7% of candidate QA pairs and retains 17,900 temporally dependent items spanning 10 diagnostic dimensions. From this filtered pool, we further construct a human-verified benchmark containing 2,323 high-quality QA pairs over 1,951 videos. Experiments on representative Video-LLMs show that temporal object consistency remains a major unsolved challenge. Current models exhibit substantial weaknesses in event counting, event ordering, identity-sensitive reasoning, and hallucination-aware verification, despite strong performance on general video understanding benchmarks.

</details>


### [213] [Frequency Adapter with SAM for Generalized Medical Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09925)
*Phuoc-Nguyen Bui,Van-Nguyen Pham,Duc-Tai Le,Junghyun Bum,Hyunseung Choo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FSAM框架，结合SAM、LoRA和频率适配器，通过提取域不变高频特征实现医学图像分割的域泛化，在眼底和前列腺数据集上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有域泛化方法依赖显式特征对齐或对抗训练，未能充分利用基础模型；SAM虽泛化能力强，但现有方法仅在空间域操作，忽略了影响模型鲁棒性的频域差异。

Method: FSAM框架集成LoRA高效微调和频率适配器，在SAM基础上引入频域表示，提取域不变高频特征，缓解频域相关的域偏移。

Result: 在眼底和前列腺数据集上，FSAM在域泛化性能上优于传统DG方法和基于SAM的DG方法。

Conclusion: 频域信息对医学图像分割的域泛化至关重要，结合SAM与频域适配可有效提升跨域分割鲁棒性。

Abstract: Medical image segmentation is a critical task in computer-aided diagnosis and treatment planning. However, deep learning models often struggle to generalize across datasets due to domain shifts arising from variations in imaging protocols, scanner types, and patient populations. Traditional domain generalization (DG) methods utilize causal feature learning, adversarial consistency, and style augmentation to improve segmentation robustness. While effective, these approaches rely on explicit feature alignment, adversarial objectives, or handcrafted augmentations, which may not fully exploit the capabilities of foundation models. Recently, the Segment Anything Model (SAM) has demonstrated strong generalization capabilities in segmentation tasks. SAM-based DG methods attempt to improve medical image segmentation. However, these approaches primarily operate in the spatial domain and overlook frequency-based discrepancies that significantly affect model robustness. In this work, we propose Frequency-based Domain Generalization with SAM (FSAM), a novel framework that integrates Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) for efficient fine-tuning and a frequency adapter to incorporate frequency-domain representations for single-source domain generalization. FSAM enhances SAM's segmentation robustness by extracting domain-invariant high-frequency features, mitigating frequency-related domain shifts. Experimental results on fundus and prostate datasets demonstrate that FSAM outperforms existing traditional DG and SAM-based DG approaches in domain generalization. Codes and pre-trained models will be made available on GitHub.

</details>


### [214] [Evidence-based Decision Modeling for Synthetic Face Detection with Uncertainty-driven Active Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09935)
*Qingchao Jiang,Zhenxuan Hou,Zhiying Zhu,Zhenxing Qian,Xinpeng Zhang,Zaiwang Gu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出EMSFD方法，利用狄利克雷分布建模类证据，将模型不确定性显式融入预测过程，并结合不确定性驱动的主动学习减少标注成本，在合成人脸检测任务上相比SOTA提升15%准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有合成人脸检测方法过度依赖Softmax激活函数，导致对未知OOD图像产生过度自信且不可靠的预测，同时需要大量高质量标注数据，限制了实际应用。

Method: EMSFD采用狄利克雷分布对类别证据进行建模，将模型不确定性显式融入预测过程；训练时利用估计的不确定性从无标签池中优先选择信息量更大的样本进行标注，通过不确定性驱动的主动学习降低标注成本并提升泛化能力。

Result: 相比现有SOTA基线，EMSFD在合成人脸检测任务上准确率提升15%，展现出更优的检测性能和泛化能力。

Conclusion: EMSFD通过证据建模与不确定性驱动的主动学习，增强了合成人脸检测的可解释性、可靠性和泛化性，有效解决了过度自信和数据标注成本高的问题。

Abstract: With the rapid development of deep generative models, forged facial images are massively exploited for illegal activities. Although existing synthetic face detection methods have achieved significant progress, they suffer from the inherent limitation of overconfidence due to their reliance on the Softmax activation function. Thus, these methods often lead to unreliable predictions when encountering unknown Out-of-Distribution (OOD) images, and cannot ascertain the model's uncertainty in its prediction. Meanwhile, most existing methods require massive high-quality annotated data, which greatly limits their practicability across diverse scenarios. To address these limitations, we propose EMSFD (Evidence-based decision Modeling for Synthetic Face Detection with uncertainty-driven active learning), an approach designed to enhance detection reliability and generalizability. Specifically, EMSFD models class evidence using the Dirichlet distribution and explicitly incorporates model uncertainty into the prediction process. Furthermore, during training, the estimated uncertainty is exploited to prioritize more informative samples from the unlabeled pool for annotation, thereby reducing labeling cost and improving model generalization. Extensive experimental evaluations demonstrate that our method enhances the interpretability of synthetic face detection. Meanwhile, our method yields a 15\% increase in accuracy compared to existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) baselines, which demonstrates the superior detection performance and generalizability of our approach. Our code is available at: https://github.com/hzx111621/EMSFD.

</details>


### [215] [Urban-ImageNet: A Large-Scale Multi-Modal Dataset and Evaluation Framework for Urban Space Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09936)
*Yiwei Ou,Chung Ching Cheung,Jun Yang Ang,Xiaobin Ren,Ronggui Sun,Guansong Gao,Kaiqi Zhao,Manfredo Manfredini*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Urban-ImageNet是一个基于社交媒体图像的大规模多模态城市空间感知数据集，包含来自2019-2025年中国24个城市61个地点的200多万张微博图像及文本。该数据集基于HUSIC分类框架定义了10类城市空间分类体系，支持场景语义分类、跨模态图文检索和实例分割三项任务，为评估AI系统对城市空间的感知能力提供了理论驱动的统一基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有计算机视觉数据集将城市图像视为通用场景数据，忽略了城市研究中至关重要的空间、社会和功能区分。缺乏一个基于城市理论、能够评估AI模型是否真正理解城市空间差异（如激活与非激活公共空间、室内外环境等）的基准。

Method: 数据集包含200万+微博图文数据，覆盖24个中国城市61个地点。提出HUSIC框架，定义10类城市空间分类体系（如激活/非激活公共空间、室内/室外、住宿、消费内容、人像、非空间内容等）。设计三项标准化任务：场景分类、跨模态检索、实例分割，并提供1K/10K/100K/2M多尺度子集。

Result: 实验表明，监督场景分类性能较好，但跨模态检索和实例级城市物体分割更具挑战性。数据量从1K增至100K时模型性能呈现规律性变化。

Conclusion: Urban-ImageNet为评估AI系统理解当代城市空间的能力提供了一个理论驱动、多城市、多模态、多尺度的统一基准，揭示了现有模型在城市空间感知任务中的能力边界。

Abstract: We present Urban-ImageNet, a large-scale multi-modal dataset and evaluation benchmark for urban space perception from user-generated social media imagery. The corpus contains over 2 Million public social media images and paired textual posts collected from Weibo across 61 urban sites in 24 Chinese cities across 2019-2025, with controlled benchmark subsets at 1K, 10K, and 100K scale and a full 2M corpus for large-scale training and evaluation. Urban-ImageNet is organized by HUSIC, a Hierarchical Urban Space Image Classification framework that defines a 10-class taxonomy grounded in urban theory. The taxonomy is designed to distinguish activated and non-activated public spaces, exterior and interior urban environments, accommodation spaces, consumption content, portraits, and non-spatial social-media content. Rather than treating urban imagery as generic scene data, Urban-ImageNet evaluates whether machine perception models can capture spatial, social, and functional distinctions that are central to urban studies. The benchmark supports three tasks within one standardized library: (T1) urban scene semantic classification, (T2) cross-modal image-text retrieval, and (T3) instance segmentation. Our experiments evaluate representative vision, vision-language, and segmentation models, revealing strong performance on supervised scene classification but more challenging behavior in cross-modal retrieval and instance-level urban object segmentation. A multi-scale study further examines how model performance changes as balanced training data increases from 1K, 10K to 100K images. Urban-ImageNet provides a unified, theory-grounded, multi-city benchmark for evaluating how AI systems perceive and interpret contemporary urban spaces across modalities, scales, and task formulations. Dataset and benchmark are available at: huggingface.co/datasets/Yiwei-Ou/Urban-ImageNet and github.com/yiasun/dataset-2.

</details>


### [216] [SDTalk: Structured Facial Priors and Dual-Branch Motion Fields for Generalizable Gaussian Talking Head Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09956)
*Peng Jia,Zhen Xiao,Jia Li,Xueliang Liu,Zhenzhen Hu,Lingyun Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SDTalk是一个基于3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）的一次性说话头合成框架，无需个性化训练即可泛化到未见身份，通过两阶段训练策略实现完整头部重建和精细面部动态建模，在视觉质量和推理效率上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于重建和渲染的方法通常依赖身份特定模型，限制了跨身份泛化能力。作者旨在解决这一问题，实现高质量、实时且无需个性化训练的一次性说话头合成。

Method: 提出SDTalk框架，包含两个模块和两阶段训练策略。第一阶段：将结构化面部先验融入重建模块，分别预测可见区域和遮挡区域的3DGS参数，实现单张图像的完整头部重建。第二阶段：引入双分支运动场，分别建模粗粒度和细粒度面部动态，提升细节保真度和唇部同步效果。

Result: 实验表明SDTalk在视觉质量和推理效率方面均优于现有方法。

Conclusion: SDTalk通过3DGS框架和两阶段策略，成功实现了一次性、跨身份泛化的高质量说话头合成，无需个性化训练或微调，同时保持了高推理效率。

Abstract: High-quality, real-time talking head synthesis remains a fundamental challenge in computer vision. Existing reconstruction- and rendering-based methods typically rely on identity-specific models, limiting cross-identity generalization. To address this issue, we propose SDTalk, a one-shot 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-based framework that generalizes to unseen identities without personalized training or fine-tuning. Our framework comprises two modules with a two-stage training strategy. In the first stage, we incorporate structured facial priors into the reconstruction module and separately predict 3DGS parameters for visible and occluded regions, enabling complete head reconstruction from a single image. In the second stage, we introduce a dual-branch motion field to model coarse and fine facial dynamics, improving detail fidelity and lip synchronization. Experiments demonstrate that SDTalk surpasses existing methods in both visual quality and inference efficiency.

</details>


### [217] [Learning to Perceive "Where": Spatial Pretext Tasks for Robust Self-Supervised Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09963)
*Yang Shen,Yusen Cai,Weronika Hryniewska-Guzik,Qing Lin,Mengmi Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Spatial Prediction (SP)，一种空间感知的预文本回归任务，通过预测同一图像中局部视图间的相对位置和尺度来学习物体部件的空间结构，可即插即用于多种自监督学习框架，在图像识别、语义分割、深度估计等任务上取得一致提升，并增强了空间推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自监督学习方法主要学习物体不变性表征，但忽略了物体部件间的空间结构和关系，限制了模型对视觉场景组成结构的理解能力。

Method: 提出 Spatial Prediction (SP) 预文本回归任务，预测同一图像中一对解耦局部视图之间的相对位置和尺度，在连续几何空间中建模部件间关系，可作为即插即用模块集成到多种SSL框架中。

Result: 在图像识别、细粒度分类、语义分割、深度估计上取得一致提升；在分布外鲁棒性上有显著增益；在新提出的位置/尺度预测任务和拼图理解任务上表现优异。

Conclusion: 显式建模空间信息为自监督学习提供了有效的归纳偏置，能够学习到更具结构性的表征，提升泛化能力。

Abstract: Existing self-supervised learning (SSL) methods primarily learn object-invariant representations but often neglect the spatial structure and relationships among object parts. To address this limitation, we introduce Spatial Prediction (SP), a spatially aware pretext regression task that predicts the relative position and scale between a pair of disentangled local views from the same image. By modeling part-to-part relationships in a continuous geometric space, SP encourages representations to capture fine-grained spatial dependencies beyond invariant categorical semantics, thereby learning the compositional structure of visual scenes. SP is implemented as a decoupled plug-in and can be seamlessly integrated into diverse SSL frameworks. Extensive experiments show consistent improvements across image recognition, fine-grained classification, semantic segmentation, and depth estimation, as well as substantial gains in out-of-distribution robustness for object recognition. To evaluate spatial reasoning, we introduce (1) a position and scale prediction task on image patch pairs and (2) a jigsaw understanding task requiring patch reordering and recognition after reconstruction. Strong performance on these tasks indicates improved spatial structure and geometric awareness. Overall, explicitly modeling spatial information provides an effective inductive bias for SSL, leading to more structured representations and better generalization. Code and models will be released.

</details>


### [218] [Towards Generalist Game Players: An Investigation of Foundation Models in the Game Multiverse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09965)
*Kuan Zhang,Dongchen Liu,Qiyue Zhao,Tianyu Xin,Yue Su,Haisheng Wang,Han Yin,Hongbo Ma,Peize Li,Tianjun Gu,Xiangnan Wu,Xinran Zhang,Yongxuan Li,Zirong Chen,Yiming Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出从单游戏精通到多宇宙创造者的五级路线图，将游戏视为AGI训练的终极场域，并分析了数据集、模型、工具、基准四大支柱如何突破五大根本权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类能从单一的物理世界泛化到无数规则各异的游戏宇宙，这种"全现实适应能力"是通用智能的标志。作者希望为AI从专用玩家迈向通用创造者提供统一视角和系统路径。

Method: 论文从历史演进视角将游戏AI发展划分为四个时代（符号/强化学习 → 大模型通用玩家 → 未来创造者阶段），提出"四大支柱"（数据集、模型、工具、基准）分析框架，并揭示五大根本权衡，构建五级路线图。

Result: 识别出制约游戏通用AI系统的五大基本权衡（如泛化vs特化、探索vs利用等），并给出了从单游戏精通到多宇宙创造者的五级进化路线图。

Conclusion: 游戏多宇宙是通向AGI的关键训练场，通过打破现有权衡并沿着五级路线图前进，最终可实现能够同时创造和进化于理论游戏多宇宙的全能通用智能体。

Abstract: The real world unfolds along a single set of physics laws, yet human intelligence demonstrates a remarkable capacity to generalize experiences from this singular physical existence into a multiverse of games, each governed by entirely different rules, aesthetics, physics, and objectives. This omni-reality adaptability is a hallmark of general intelligence. As Artificial Intelligence progresses towards Artificial General Intelligence, the multiverse of games has evolved from mere entertainment into the ultimate ground for training and evaluating AGI. The pursuit of this generality has unfolded across four eras: from environment-specific symbolic and reinforcement learning agents, to current large foundation models acting as generalist players, and toward a future creator stage where agent both creates new game worlds and continually evolves within them. We trace the full lifecycle of a generalist game player along four interdependent pillars: Dataset, Model, Harness, and Benchmark. Every advance across these pillars can be read as an attempt to break one of five fundamental trade-offs that currently bound the whole system. Building on this end-to-end view, we chart a five-level roadmap, progressing from single-game mastery to the ultimate creator stage in which the agent simultaneously creates and evolves within theoretical game multiverse. Taken together, our work offers a unified lens onto a rapidly shifting field,and a principled path toward the omnipotent generalist agent capable of seamlessly mastering any challenge within the multiverse of games, thereby paving the way for AGI.

</details>


### [219] [OZ-TAL: Online Zero-Shot Temporal Action Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09976)
