*Chaolei Han,Hongsong Wang,Xin Gong,Jie Gui*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出在线零样本时序动作定位（OZ-TAL）新任务，并设计了一种无需训练的框架，利用现成的视觉-语言模型（VLMs）增强视觉表示、减少偏差，在THUMOS14和ActivityNet-1.3上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有在线时序动作定位（On-TAL）方法通常在特定领域训练，泛化能力有限，难以处理未见过的动作类别。为此，作者提出OZ-TAL新任务，旨在实现在线条件下检测未见过的动作。

Method: 提出一种无需训练的框架，利用现成的视觉-语言模型（VLMs），并引入额外机制增强视觉表示、缓解VLMs固有的偏差，无需重新训练即可实现零样本在线定位。

Result: 在THUMOS14和ActivityNet-1.3上建立新基准，实验表明该方法在离线和在线零样本设置下均大幅超越现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: OZ-TAL任务具有重要研究价值，所提训练-free框架有效结合VLMs能力，为在线零样本时序动作定位提供了新思路。

Abstract: Online Temporal Action Localization (On-TAL) aims to detect the occurrence time and category of actions in untrimmed streaming videos immediately upon their completion. Recent advancements in this field focus on developing more sophisticated frameworks, shifting from Online Action Detection (OAD)-based aggregation paradigm to instance-level understanding. However, existing approaches are typically trained on specific domains and often exhibit limited generalization capabilities when applied to arbitrary videos, particularly in the presence of previously unseen actions. In this paper, we introduce a new task called Online Zero-shot Temporal Action Localization (OZ-TAL), which aims to detect previously unseen actions in an online fashion. Furthermore, we propose a training-free framework that leverages off-the-shelf Vision-Language Models (VLMs) while introducing additional mechanisms to enhance visual representations and mitigate their inherent biases. We establish new benchmarks and representative baselines for OZ-TAL on THUMOS14 and ActivityNet-1.3, and extensive experiments demonstrate that our method substantially outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches under both offline and online zero-shot settings.

</details>


### [220] [INFANiTE: Implicit Neural representation for high-resolution Fetal brain spatio-temporal Atlas learNing from clinical Thick-slicE MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09977)
*Xiaotian Hu,Mingxuan Liu,Hongjia Yang,Juncheng Zhu,Yijin Li,Yifei Chen,Haoxiang Li,Tongxi Song,Zihan Li,Yingqi Hao,Ziyu Li,Yujin Zhang,Gang Ning,Yi Liao,Haibo Qu,Qiyuan Tian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: INFANiTE提出了一种基于隐式神经表示（INR）的框架，用于从临床厚层MRI扫描中直接学习高分辨率胎儿脑时空图谱，完全跳过了昂贵的切片到体积重建（SVR）和迭代非刚性配准步骤，将处理时间从数天缩短到数小时。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有胎儿脑图谱构建流程需要数天进行切片到体积重建（SVR），再需要数天进行迭代体积配准，导致大规模队列图谱构建不切实际。

Method: 提出INFANiTE框架，利用隐式神经表示（INR）直接从临床厚层MRI扫描中学习高分辨率胎儿脑时空图谱，完全绕过SVR和迭代非刚性配准步骤。

Result: INFANiTE在主体一致性、参考保真度、内在质量和生物学合理性上均优于现有基线，尤其在稀疏数据场景下表现突出；端到端处理时间从数天缩短至数小时。

Conclusion: INFANiTE显著加速了胎儿脑时空图谱构建，为大规模人群水平的胎儿脑分析提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Spatio-temporal fetal brain atlases are important for characterizing normative neurodevelopment and identifying congenital anomalies. However, existing atlas construction pipelines necessitate days for slice-to-volume reconstruction (SVR) to generate high-resolution 3D brain volumes and several additional days for iterative volume registration, thereby rendering atlas construction from large-scale cohorts prohibitively impractical. We address these limitations with INFANiTE, an Implicit Neural Representation (INR) framework for high-resolution Fetal brain spatio-temporal Atlas learNing from clinical Thick-slicE MRI scans, bypassing both the costly SVR and the iterative non-rigid registration steps entirely, thereby substantially accelerating atlas construction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that INFANiTE outperforms existing baselines in subject consistency, reference fidelity, intrinsic quality and biological plausibility, even under challenging sparse-data settings. Additionally, INFANiTE reduces the end-to-end processing time (i.e., from raw scans to the final atlas) from days to hours compared to the traditional 3D volume-based pipeline (e.g., SyGN), facilitating large-scale population-level fetal brain analysis. Our code is publicly available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/INFANiTE-5D74

</details>


### [221] [ERASE: Eliminating Redundant Visual Tokens via Adaptive Two-Stage Token Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09982)
*Yuna Lee,Kyoungho Min,Yulhwa Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ERASE框架，通过两阶段视觉token剪枝策略，在85%剪枝率下保留89.46%的原始准确率，显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM在处理高分辨率图像时产生大量视觉token导致计算开销巨大，而当前剪枝方法依赖模型内部语义特征，缺乏根据图像复杂度自适应调整的策略。

Method: 提出ERASE两阶段视觉token剪枝框架，第一阶段识别显著token，第二阶段通过自适应图像复杂度的剪枝策略保留关键token。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上，85%剪枝率下保留89.46%原始准确率，而最佳先前方法仅保留78.1%。

Conclusion: ERASE能显著减少视觉token数量同时保持模型精度，验证了自适应剪枝策略的有效性。

Abstract: Recent advancements in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable large language models (LLMs) to process high-resolution images, significantly improving real-world multimodal understanding. However, this capability introduces a large number of vision tokens, resulting in substantial computational overhead. To mitigate this issue, various vision token pruning methods have been proposed. Nevertheless, existing approaches predominantly rely on learned semantic features within the model to capture visual redundancy. Moreover, they lack adaptive mechanisms to adjust pruning strategies according to the complexity of the input image. In this paper, we propose ERASE, a two-stage vision token pruning framework that identifies and retains salient tokens through pruning strategies adaptive to image complexity. Experiment results demonstrate that ERASE significantly reduces vision tokens while preserving accuracy. For Qwen2.5-VL-7B, at a token pruning ratio of 85\%, ERASE retains 89.46% of the original model accuracy, whereas the best prior method retains only 78.1%. Our code is available at https://github.com/Tuna-Luna/ERASE.

</details>


### [222] [Geometric 4D Stitching for Grounded 4D Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09984)
*Sunwoo Park,Taesung Kwon,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Geometric 4D Stitching框架，通过显式识别缺失几何区域并补充几何一致的4D补丁，在10分钟内完成场景扩展，同时提升几何一致性，并支持4D网格迭代扩展和场景编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有4D生成方法存在几何不一致问题，且基于辐射场的重建需要昂贵的优化，辐射表示还会将几何不一致吸收到视点依赖特性中，无法强制执行几何一致性。

Method: 显式识别缺失的几何区域，用几何上一致的4D补丁（stitches）进行补充，构建显式的4D场景表示，避免辐射场优化的弊端。

Result: 在单张NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU上，每步场景扩展耗时不到10分钟，同时提升了几何一致性；支持4D网格的迭代扩展和4D场景编辑。

Conclusion: Geometric 4D Stitching通过显式几何补丁有效解决了4D生成中的几何不一致问题，效率高且支持编辑，是优于辐射场方法的方案。

Abstract: Recent 4D generation methods complete scene-level missing information using generative models and reconstruct the scene into radiance-based representations. However, these pipelines often present geometric inconsistencies in the generated content, and the radiance-based reconstruction requires expensive optimization. Furthermore, radiance-based representations often absorb these geometric inconsistencies into their view-dependent nature, failing to enforce the grounded geometric consistency. To address these issues, we propose Geometric 4D Stitching, an efficient framework that explicitly identifies missing geometric regions and complements them with geometrically grounded 4D stitches. As a result, our method constructs 4D scene representations in under 10 minutes on a single NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU per one-step scene expansion, while improving geometric consistency. Moreover, we demonstrate that our explicit 4D stitching supports interative expansion of 4D mesh as well as 4D scene editing.

</details>


### [223] [Omni-Persona: Systematic Benchmarking and Improving Omnimodal Personalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09996)
*Yeongtak Oh,Dongwook Lee,Sangkwon Park,Heeseung Kim,Sungroh Yoon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Omni-Persona基准，首个全面覆盖文本、图像、音频的全模态个性化评测框架，通过校准精度(Cal)诊断发现开源模型存在音频-视觉鸿沟、SFT存在标注瓶颈、RLVR虽泛化更好但趋向保守。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有个性化研究主要集中在视觉-语言领域，缺乏统一覆盖文本、图像、音频的全模态基准，且缺乏对无人物查询场景的系统性接地研究和方法论严谨性。

Method: 形式化为跨模态路由的Persona Modality Graph，包含4个任务组、18个细粒度任务、约750项；提出Calibrated Accuracy (Cal)统一评估正确接地与合理拒答。

Result: 三个诊断发现：(i)开源模型存在音频-视觉接地鸿沟，RLVR通过密集规则监督部分缩小；(ii)高可答召回与大模型规模不能保证高Cal，校准是独立评测维度；(iii)SFT受限于大规模标注困难，RLVR泛化更一致但趋向保守且生成质量下降。

Conclusion: Omni-Persona作为诊断框架揭示全模态个性化陷阱，指导未来后训练与奖励设计。

Abstract: While multimodal large language models have advanced across text, image, and audio, personalization research has remained primarily vision-language, with unified omnimodal benchmarking that jointly covers text, image, and audio still limited, and lacking the methodological rigor to account for absent-persona scenarios or systematic grounding studies. We introduce Omni-Persona, the first comprehensive benchmark for omnimodal personalization. We formalize the task as cross-modal routing over the \emph{Persona Modality Graph}, encompassing 4 task groups and 18 fine-grained tasks across ${\sim}750$ items. To rigorously diagnose grounding behavior, we propose \emph{Calibrated Accuracy ($\mathrm{Cal}$)}, which jointly rewards correct grounding and appropriate abstention, incorporating absent-persona queries within a unified evaluation framework. On our dedicated experiments, three diagnostic findings emerge: (i) open-source models show a consistent audio-vs-visual grounding gap that RLVR partially narrows via dense rule-based supervision; (ii) answerable recall and parameter scale are incomplete diagnostics, since strong recall can coexist with absent-persona hallucination and larger models do not always achieve higher $\mathrm{Cal}$, exposing calibration as a separate evaluation axis; and (iii) SFT is bounded by the difficulty of constructing annotated ground-truth supervision at scale, while RLVR generalizes more consistently through outcome-level verifiable feedback yet drifts toward conservative behavior and lower generation quality under our reward design. Omni-Persona thus serves as a diagnostic framework that surfaces the pitfalls of omnimodal personalization, guiding future post-training and reward design.

</details>


### [224] [Med-StepBench: A Hierarchical Reasoning Framework for Evaluating Hallucinations in Medical Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10002)
*Minh Khoi Nguyen,Dai Lam Le,Amir Reza Jafari,Tuan Dung Nguyen,Mai Hong Son,Mai Huy Thong,Quang Huy Nguyen,Thanh Trung Nguyen,Reza Farahbakhsh,Noel Crespi,Phi Le Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Med-StepBench，首个针对3D肿瘤PET/CT影像的分步幻觉检测基准，包含12,000+图像和1,000,000+图文对，揭示当前VLM在多步临床推理中的系统性失效模式，并发现对抗性中间解释会显著放大幻觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医疗幻觉基准主要针对2D影像和一次性诊断问题，无法检测模型在定位和异常识别上的错误，导致看似正确的诊断背后隐藏关键推理错误。亟需一个能评估多步临床推理过程的基准。

Method: 构建Med-StepBench，包含12,000+张3D PET/CT图像和1,000,000+图像-陈述对，覆盖体积和多视图2D数据；将临床推理分解为四个专家设计的诊断阶段；使用临床医生验证的标注进行逐步骤评估。

Result: 通用和医疗VLM在步骤级评估中暴露出被聚合准确率掩盖的系统性失败模式；当前VLM极易受到看似合理但具有对抗性的中间解释影响，即使存在矛盾视觉证据，幻觉仍被显著放大。

Conclusion: Med-StepBench揭示了多步临床推理中根本性的grounding局限，为开发更安全可靠的医疗VLM提供了严格的基准测试平台。

Abstract: Large vision-language models (VLMs) demonstrate strong performance in medical image understanding, but frequently generate clinically plausible yet incorrect statements, raising significant safety concerns. Existing medical hallucination benchmarks primarily focus on 2D imaging with one-shot diagnostic questions, offering limited insight into whether predictions are grounded in correct localization and abnormality identification, allowing critical reasoning errors to remain hidden behind seemingly correct diagnoses. We introduce Med-StepBench, the first large-scale benchmark for step-wise hallucination detection in 3D oncological PET/CT, comprising over 12,000 images and more than 1,000,000 image-statement pairs across volumetric and multi-view 2D data, which decomposes clinical reasoning into four expert-designed diagnostic stages. Using clinician-verified annotations, we perform the first step-level evaluation of general-purpose and medical VLMs, revealing systematic failure modes obscured by aggregate accuracy metrics. Furthermore, we show that current VLMs are highly susceptible to adversarial yet clinically plausible intermediate explanations, which significantly amplify hallucinations despite contradictory visual evidence. Together, our findings highlight fundamental limitations in grounding multi-step clinical reasoning and establish Med-StepBench as a rigorous benchmark for developing safer and more reliable medical VLMs.

</details>


### [225] [Hystar: Hypernetwork-driven Style-adaptive Retrieval via Dynamic SVD Modulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10009)
*Yujia Cai,Boxuan Li,Chenghao Xu,Jiexi Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Hystar框架，通过超网络动态生成注意力层的奇异值扰动（ΔS），并结合MLP层的静态奇异值偏移，实现查询自适应检索；同时设计StyleNCE损失函数，利用最优传输加权对比学习处理跨风格语义混淆，在多风格检索任务中达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLRM（如CLIP）在处理草图、艺术作品、低分辨率预览等多样化的查询风格时存在分布偏移问题，导致检索性能下降。

Method: 提出Hystar框架：1）超网络为注意力层生成奇异值扰动ΔS实现动态适应；2）MLP层使用静态奇异值偏移保持跨风格稳定性；3）设计StyleNCE损失函数，通过最优传输加权对比学习强化难跨风格负样本的学习。

Result: 在多风格检索和跨风格分类基准上，Hystar一致优于强基线方法，达到SOTA性能，且参数量高效、跨风格稳定。

Conclusion: Hystar通过轻量级的动态权重适应机制有效解决了查询风格多样性带来的分布偏移问题，在保持参数效率的同时显著提升了跨风格检索性能。

Abstract: Query-based image retrieval (QBIR) requires retrieving relevant images given diverse and often stylistically heterogeneous queries, such as sketches, artworks, or low-resolution previews. While large-scale vision--language representation models (VLRMs) like CLIP offer strong zero-shot retrieval performance, they struggle with distribution shifts caused by unseen query styles. In this paper, we propose the Hypernetwork-driven Style-adaptive Retrieval (Hystar), a lightweight framework that dynamically adapts model weights to each query's style. Hystar employs a hypernetwork to generate singular-value perturbations ($ΔS$) for attention layers, enabling flexible per-input adaptation, while static singular-value offsets on MLP layers ensure cross-style stability. To better handle semantic confusions across styles, we design StyleNCE as part of Hystar, an optimal-transport-weighted contrastive loss that emphasizes hard cross-style negatives. Extensive experiments on multi-style retrieval and cross-style classification benchmarks demonstrate that Hystar consistently outperforms strong baselines, achieving state-of-the-art performance while being parameter-efficient and stable across styles.

</details>


### [226] [MUSDA: Multi-source Multi-modality Unsupervised Domain Adaptive 3D Object Detection for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10026)
*Xiaohu Lu,Hamed Khatounabadi,Hayder Radha*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种多源、多模态无监督域适应框架，用于自动驾驶中的3D目标检测。该框架通过分层空间条件域分类器对齐相机和LiDAR特征，并利用原型图加权融合策略聚合多源检测结果，在Waymo、nuScenes、Lyft数据集上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有域适应方法多局限于单一源域或单一模态，无法有效利用多源多模态数据，而自动驾驶场景中已有丰富的多模态标注数据集，因此需要一种能同时跨模态、跨源域适应的3D目标检测方法。

Method: 提出分层空间条件域分类器（HSC），在两种粒度上联合对齐相机和LiDAR特征；构建原型图（Prototype Graph），并基于此设计原型图加权融合策略（PGW），聚合多个源域的检测头预测结果。

Result: 在Waymo、nuScenes、Lyft三个数据集上的实验表明，该方法有效整合了多模态和多源域信息，一致优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: 多源多模态的域适应能显著提升3D目标检测在无标注目标域上的性能，原型图加权融合是高效利用多源信息的关键策略。

Abstract: With the advancement of autonomous driving, numerous annotated multi-modality datasets have become available. This presents an opportunity to develop domain-adaptive 3D object detectors for new environments without relying on labor-intensive manual annotations. However, traditional domain adaptation methods typically focus on a single source domain or a single modality, limiting their effectiveness in multi-source, multi-modality scenarios. In this paper, we propose a novel framework for multi-source, multi-modality unsupervised domain adaptation in 3D object detection for autonomous driving. Given multiple labeled source domains and one unlabeled target domain, our framework first introduces hierarchical spatially-conditioned (HSC) domain classifiers, which jointly align features from both camera and LiDAR modalities at two distinct levels for each source-target domain pair. To effectively leverage information from multiple source domains, we construct a prototype graph between each pair of domains. Based on this, we develop a prototype graph weighted (PGW) multi-source fusion strategy to aggregate predictions from multiple source detection heads. Experimental results on three widely used 3D object detection datasets - Waymo, nuScenes, and Lyft - demonstrate that our proposed framework effectively integrates information across both modalities and source domains, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [227] [Slum Detection and Density Mapping with AlphaEarth Foundations: A Representation Learning Evaluation Across 12 Global Cities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10029)
*Shuyang Hou,Ziqi Liu,Haoyue Jiao,Zhangyan Xu,Xiaopu Zhang,Lutong Xie,Yaxian Qing,Jianyuan Liang,Xuefeng Guan,Huayi Wua*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究系统评估了AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF) 10米分辨率全球地表嵌入向量在贫民窟分类与亚像素密度估计任务上的表现，覆盖12个城市69个城市-年样本，发现同城市跨年度训练最优（中位F1=0.616, R²=0.466），但模型在10米尺度内像素密度梯度建模能力有限，且POI特征对密度估计增益最大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有像素级贫民窟制图面临跨城市泛化能力差、缺乏连续密度估计以及全球可比性弱三大瓶颈。AEF作为全球一致的64维年度地表嵌入（10米分辨率），为轻量化贫民窟监测提供了新的分析基础，但其在贫民窟检测这一间接耦合任务（涉及建成形态与社会经济过程）中的适用性尚不明确，亟需系统评估。

Method: 使用GRAM伪掩码作为监督标签，在12个城市69个城市-年对（2017-2024）上评估AEF在贫民窟分类与亚像素密度估计任务中的表现。设计四种训练策略、两种协议（随机分割与3×3空间分块交叉验证）、六种辅助特征配置和五种基线模型，辅以PCA、SHAP等表示层分析及全AOI制图。

Result: (1)同城市跨年度训练最优（中位F1=0.616, R²=0.466），时间扩展优于跨城市迁移，表明存在城市尺度表示漂移；(2)回归R²主要由零/非零边界判别驱动，所有城市正像素R²均为负值，表明10米分辨率下对像素内密度梯度建模能力有限；(3)PC36在任务中一致排名最高，分类在k=32饱和，回归在k=64仍未饱和；(4)POI特征对密度估计增益最大（ΔR²=+0.064）；(5)6个城市满足双任务可用性阈值，2017-2024年全AOI推理保持贫民窟簇结构（平均SSIM=0.926）。

Conclusion: 本研究明确了基础模型嵌入在贫民窟监测中的能力边界与互补需求：AEF在同城市跨年度场景表现可靠，但跨城市迁移受限于表示漂移；10米分辨率本质上限制了亚像素密度梯度的精细建模；POI等辅助特征具有显著互补价值；未来需结合多源数据与更高分辨率嵌入以提升贫民窟监测的全局可比性与精度。

Abstract: Pixel-level slum mapping has long been constrained by limited cross-city generalisation, the absence of continuous density estimation, and weak global comparability. AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF), a globally consistent 64-dimensional annual surface embedding at 10 m, offers a new analysis-ready basis for lightweight slum monitoring, but its applicability to slum detection - an indirectly coupled task shaped by both built form and socio-economic processes - remains untested. We evaluate AEF on slum classification and sub-pixel density estimation across 12 cities and 69 city-year pairs (2017-2024), using GRAM pseudo-masks as supervisory labels. The evaluation spans four training strategies, two protocols (random split and 3x3 spatial block cross-validation), six auxiliary feature configurations, and five baseline models, complemented by representation-level analyses (PCA, SHAP) and full-AOI mapping. Five findings emerge. (1) Same-city cross-year training is optimal under both protocols (median spatial F1 = 0.616, R^2 = 0.466); temporal expansion outperforms cross-city transfer, indicating city-scale representational drift. (2) Regression R^2 is driven primarily by zero/non-zero boundary discrimination: positive-pixel R^2 is consistently negative across all cities, revealing limited capacity to model intra-pixel density gradients at 10 m. (3) PC36 is consistently top-ranked across tasks; classification saturates at k = 32 while regression remains unsaturated at k = 64. (4) POI features yield the largest density gain (Delta R^2 = +0.064). (5) For six cities meeting dual-task usability thresholds, full-AOI inference across 2017-2024 preserves slum cluster structure (mean SSIM = 0.926). The study delineates the capabilities and complementarity needs of foundation-model embeddings for slum monitoring.

</details>


### [228] [Only Train Once: Uncertainty-Aware One-Class Learning for Face Authenticity Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10040)
*Qingchao Jiang,Zhenxuan Hou,Zhiying Zhu,Zhenxing Qian,Xinpeng Zhang,Zaiwang Gu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出FADNet，将人脸伪造检测重新定义为单类分类任务，仅用真实人脸数据训练，通过证据深度学习和伪伪造图像生成器提升检测泛化能力，在DF40和ASFD基准上达到96.63%准确率和98.83%精确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法将人脸伪造检测视为全监督二分类问题，面对未见过的生成范式时性能严重下降；同时缺乏统一的通用检测框架，无法同时处理DeepFake和完全合成人脸。

Method: FADNet将问题重构为单类分类（OCC）任务，仅用真实人脸数据训练；引入证据深度学习（EDL）量化预测不确定性；设计即插即用的伪伪造图像生成器（PFIG）收紧真实数据的决策边界。

Result: 在DF40和ASFD基准上取得了96.63%的平均准确率和98.83%的平均精确率，显著优于现有SOTA方法。

Conclusion: 单类分类框架结合不确定性量化与伪伪造生成策略，能有效提升跨生成范式的人脸伪造检测泛化能力。

Abstract: The rapid evolution of generative paradigms has enabled the creation of highly realistic imagery, which escalating the risks of identity fraud and the dissemination of disinformation. Most existing approaches frame face forgery detection as a fully supervised binary classification problem. Consequently, these models typically exhibit significant performance decay when tasked with detecting forgeries from previously unseen generative paradigms. Furthermore, these methods focus exclusively on either DeepFakes or fully synthesized faces, thereby failing to provide a generalized framework for universal face forgery detection. In this paper, we address this challenge by introducing FADNet (Face Authenticity Detector Net),
  % a self-supervised framework that
  which reformulates face forgery detection as a one-class classification (OCC) task. By training exclusively on authentic facial data to capture their intrinsic representations, FADNet flags any image whose feature embedding deviates significantly from the learned distribution of real faces as a forgery. The framework incorporates Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) to quantify predictive uncertainty and utilizes a plug-and-play pseudo-forgery image generator (PFIG) to tighten decision boundaries around authentic data. Extensive experimental evaluations on the DF40 and ASFD benchmarks demonstrate that FADNet achieves superior performance and generalization capabilities. Specifically, FADNet substantially outperforms existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, yielding a remarkable average accuracy of 96.63\% and an average precision of 98.83\%.

</details>


### [229] [ExtraVAR: Stage-Aware RoPE Remapping for Resolution Extrapolation in Visual Autoregressive Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10045)
*Feihong Yan,Shaoyu Liu,Haixuan Wang,Shuai Lu,Linfeng Zhang,Huiqi Li,Xiangyang Ji*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对VAR模型在图像生成中无法直接外推更高分辨率的问题，提出Stage-Aware RoPE Remapping和Entropy-Driven Adaptive Attention Calibration两种训练-free方法，有效解决了全局重复、局部重复和细节退化三种失败模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VAR模型在图像生成中表现出色，但其固定训练分辨率限制了更高分辨率的直接生成。直接将LLM或扩散模型的训练-free外推方法迁移到VAR会导致三种失败模式：全局重复、局部重复和细节退化。

Method: 1. Stage-Aware RoPE Remapping：基于对VAR模型粗到细生成过程中各阶段由不同RoPE频带主导的观察，为每个频带分配阶段特定的重映射规则，联合抑制三种失败模式。2. Entropy-Driven Adaptive Attention Calibration：利用分辨率不变的正则化熵量化注意力分散程度，推导出闭式逐头缩放因子，将外推分辨率的注意力熵对齐到训练分辨率。

Result: 在结构连贯性和细节保真度方面，该方法一致优于先前的分辨率外推方法。

Conclusion: 提出的两种训练-free策略有效解决了VAR模型在高分辨率图像生成中的外推问题，为视觉自回归模型的实用化提供了重要改进。

Abstract: Visual Autoregressive (VAR) models have emerged as a strong alternative to diffusion for image synthesis, yet their fixed training resolution prevents direct generation at higher resolutions. Naively transferring training-free extrapolation methods from LLMs or diffusion models to VAR yields three characteristic failure modes: global repetition, local repetition, and detail degradation. We trace them to a unified band-stage mismatch: VAR generates images in a coarse-to-fine, scale-wise process where each stage is driven by a distinct dominant RoPE frequency band, and each failure mode emerges when the dominant band of a particular stage is disrupted. Building on this insight, we propose Stage-Aware RoPE Remapping, a training-free strategy that assigns each frequency band a stage-specific remapping rule, jointly suppressing all three failure modes. We further observe that attention becomes systematically dispersed as the image resolution increases. Existing methods typically depend on predefined attention scaling factors, which are neither adaptive to the target resolution nor capable of faithfully capturing the actual extent of attention dispersion. We therefore propose Entropy-Driven Adaptive Attention Calibration, which quantifies dispersion via a resolution-invariant normalized entropy and yields a closed-form per-head scaling factor that realigns the extrapolated-resolution attention entropy with its training-resolution counterpart. Extensive experiments show that our method consistently outperforms prior resolution-extrapolation methods in both structural coherence and fine-detail fidelity. Our code is available at https://github.com/feihongyan1/ExtraVAR.

</details>


### [230] [PixelFlowCast: Latent-Free Precipitation Nowcasting via Pixel Mean Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10046)
*Yufeng Zhu,Chunlei Shi,Yongchao Feng,Dan Niu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PixelFlowCast 是一个两阶段概率预报框架，通过无潜空间压缩的条件流匹配实现高效高保真的降水临近预报，在 SEVIR 数据集上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型生成能力强但推理慢，条件流匹配虽提升效率却因潜空间压缩丢失高频物理细节，亟需同时兼顾高效率和高质量的预报方案。

Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段用确定性模型生成粗粒度预报捕获全局趋势；第二阶段用KANCondNet提取时空特征作为条件，再通过无潜空间的x-预测机制（PMF）用少步生成高保真预测。

Result: 在SEVIR数据集上，PixelFlowCast在预测准确性和推理效率上均优于现有主流方法，尤其是在长序列预报中表现突出。

Conclusion: PixelFlowCast在无需潜空间压缩的条件下实现了高效高保真的降水临近预报，具备实际业务部署的潜力。

Abstract: Precipitation nowcasting aims to forecast short-term radar echo sequences for extreme weather warning, where both prediction fidelity and inference efficiency are critical for real-world deployment. However, diffusion-based models, despite their strong generative capability, suffer from slow inference due to multi-step sampling trajectories, limiting their practical usability. Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) improves efficiency via straightened trajectories, but relies on latent space compression, which inevitably discards high-frequency physical details and degrades fine-grained prediction quality. To address these limitations, we propose PixelFlowCast, a two-stage probabilistic forecasting framework that achieves both high-efficiency and high-fidelity prediction without latent compression. Specifically, in the first stage, a deterministic model first produces coarse forecasts to capture global evolution trends. In the subsequent stage, the proposed KANCondNet extracts deep spatiotemporal evolution features to provide accurate conditional guidance. Based on this, a latent-free, few-step Pixel Mean Flows (PMF) predictor employs an $x$-prediction mechanism to generate high-quality predictions, effectively preserving fine-grained structures while maintaining fast inference. Experiments on the publicly available SEVIR dataset demonstrate that PixelFlowCast outperforms existing mainstream methods in both prediction accuracy and inference efficiency, particularly for long sequence forecasting, highlighting its strong potential for real-world operational deployment.

</details>


### [231] [EchoPrune: Interpreting Redundancy as Temporal Echoes for Efficient VideoLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10050)
*Jiameng Li,Minye Wu,Jiezhang Cao,Aleksei Tiulpin,Matthew B. Blaschko*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EchoPrune是一种轻量级、免训练的token剪枝方法，通过“时序回音”概念（若当前帧token能被前帧重建则为冗余，否则为重要）结合查询引导跨模态相关性和时序重建误差来筛选视觉token，使VideoLLMs在固定token预算下处理多达20倍帧数，性能提升8.6%，推理加速5.6倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频理解中，密集帧采样带来大量视觉token，稀疏采样又易导致时序证据缺失和LLM幻觉，现有免训练token缩减方法要么将视频等同静态图像处理，要么依赖片段级合并启发式，削弱了细粒度时空建模并引入额外开销。

Method: EchoPrune通过两个评分维度筛选token：①查询引导的跨模态相关性（query-guided crossmodal relevance）；②时序重建误差（temporal reconstruction error），即通过连续帧间的对应匹配（correspondence matching）和回音匹配（echo matching）衡量token能否被前帧重建。

Result: 在LLaVA-OV、Qwen2.5VL和Qwen3VL三个模型上，覆盖六个视频理解基准，EchoPrune使模型在相同token预算下处理多达20倍帧数，在Qwen2.5VL-7B上性能提升8.6%，推理加速（预填充阶段）5.6倍。

Conclusion: EchoPrune通过识别并抑制时序冗余的“回音”token，在免训练条件下实现了长视频理解中视觉token的高效压缩，兼顾了细粒度时空建模与推理效率。

Abstract: Long-form video understanding remains challenging for Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs), as the dense frame sampling introduces massive visual tokens while sparse sampling risks missing critical temporal evidence and leading to LLM hallucination. Existing training-free token reduction methods either treat videos equally as static images or rely on segment-level merging heuristics, which weaken fine-grained spatiotemporal modeling and introduce additional overhead. In this paper, we propose EchoPrune, a lightweight and training-free token pruning method that improves temporal resolution under a fixed LLM-side visual token budget. Our core idea is to interpret redundant video tokens as temporal echoes: if a token is well reconstructed from the previous frame, it is merely a temporally redundant echo; otherwise, it may capture new events, motion, or query-relevant visual evidence. Based on this insight, EchoPrune scores visual tokens by (i) query-guided crossmodal relevance and (ii) temporal reconstruction error, measured by correspondence matching and echo matching across consecutive frames. The selected tokens preserve task-relevant cues and temporal novelty while suppressing predictable redundancy, allowing VideoLLMs to observe more frames without increasing the decoding budget. Extensive experiments on LLaVA-OV, Qwen2.5VL, and Qwen3VL across six video understanding benchmarks show that EchoPrune enables VideoLLMs to process up to 20x frames under the same token budget, yielding improved performance (+8.6%) and inference speedup (5.6x for prefilling) on Qwen2.5VL-7B.

</details>


### [232] [Explanation-Aware Learning for Enhanced Interpretability in Biomedical Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10054)
*Zubair Faruqui,Rahul Dubey*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出在医学图像诊断模型的训练目标中引入解释损失（explanation loss），通过监督模型注意力聚焦于临床相关区域，提升模型的可解释性和可信度。实验表明，该方法在保持预测精度的同时显著改善了解释的空间忠实度，但解释质量与损失系数之间存在权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络在医学图像诊断中常依赖虚假或临床无关的视觉线索，现有事后解释方法无法影响模型训练过程，导致非因果特征持续存在。因此，需要将解释监督直接融入训练目标，引导模型关注临床有意义的区域。

Method: 提出将解释损失（explanation loss）系统性地整合到模型训练目标中，分析不同的解释损失设计和监督强度对预测性能与解释空间忠实度的影响。同时引入两个互补的量化指标——注释覆盖率和显著性精度，用于严格评估可解释性。

Result: 解释质量与损失系数之间存在明确的权衡；引入解释损失后，解释对齐度持续改善，同时保持了可比的预测精度。实验基于标注的胸部X光数据集，但框架可推广至其他生物医学影像模态。

Conclusion: 解释监督并非单一的设计选择，本文为在带有噪声的临床注释下将解释损失融入训练目标提供了实用指导。

Abstract: Deep neural networks for medical image diagnosis often achieve high predictive accuracy while relying on spurious or clinically irrelevant visual cues, limiting their trustworthiness in practice. Post-hoc explanation methods are widely used to visualize model decisions in the form of saliency maps; however, these explanations do not influence how models learn during training, allowing non-causal or confounding features to persist. This motivates the incorporation of explanation supervision directly into the training objective to guide model attention toward clinically meaningful regions and promote clinically grounded decision-making. This paper presents a systematic approach to integrate explanation loss into model training and analyzes how different explanation loss designs and supervision strengths influence both predictive performance and spatial faithfulness of explanations. To quantitatively assess interpretability, two complementary explanation performance metrics-annotation coverage and saliency precision-are introduced, enabling rigorous evaluation beyond qualitative visualization. Our experimental results reveal a clear trade-off between explanation quality and explanation loss coefficients. Furthermore, quantitative statistical analysis yields consistently improved explanation alignment while maintaining comparable accuracy. Experiments were conducted on annotated chest X-ray datasets; however, the proposed framework is applicable to a broad range of annotated biomedical imaging modalities. Overall, these findings demonstrate that explanation supervision is not a monolithic design choice and provide practical guidance for incorporating explanation loss into training objectives under noisy clinical annotations.

</details>


### [233] [MFVLR: Multi-domain Fine-grained Vision-Language Reconstruction for Generalizable Diffusion Face Forgery Detection and Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10071)
*Yaning Zhang,Tianyi Wang,Zan Gao,Yibo Zhao,Chunjie Ma,Meng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MFVLR模型，通过多模态（视觉+语言）学习通用伪造痕迹，解决了现有方法在扩散模型生成的人脸伪造检测与定位上泛化能力不足的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有伪造检测方法多依赖单一图像模态，忽略细粒度文本信息，且主要在GAN生成图像上有效，难以泛化到扩散模型生成的伪造人脸。

Method: 提出MFVLR模型：1）细粒度语言Transformer学习通用语言嵌入；2）多域视觉编码器在图像域和残差域捕获互补伪造模式；3）视觉解码器重构图像并定位伪造区域；4）即插即用的视觉注入模块增强视觉-语言交互。

Result: 在跨生成器、跨伪造类型、跨数据集等多种设置下，MFVLR均达到SOTA性能。

Conclusion: 引入语言模态指导视觉伪造表征学习，可显著提升扩散模型合成人脸的伪造检测与定位的泛化能力。

Abstract: The swift advancement in photo-realistic face generation technology has sparked considerable concerns across society and academia, emphasizing the requirement of generalizable face forgery detection and localization methods. Prior works tend to capture face forgery patterns across multiple domains using image modality, other modalities like fine-grained texts are not comprehensively investigated, which restricts the generalization capability of models. Besides, they usually analyze facial images created by GAN, but struggle to identify and localize those synthesized by diffusion. To solve the problems, in this paper, we devise a novel multi-domain fine-grained vision-language reconstruction (MFVLR) model, which explores comprehensive and diverse visual forgery traces via language-guided face forgery representation learning, to achieve generalizable diffusion-synthesized face forgery detection and localization (DFFDL). Specifically, we devise a fine-grained language transformer that studies general fine-grained language embeddings using language reconstruction. We propose a multi-domain vision encoder to capture general and complementary visual forgery patterns across the image and residual domains. A vision decoder is designed to reconstruct image appearance and achieve forgery localization. Besides, we propose an innovative plug-and-play vision injection module to enhance the interaction between the vision and language embeddings. Extensive experiments and visualizations demonstrate that our network outperforms the state of the art on different settings like cross-generator, cross-forgery, and cross-dataset evaluations.

</details>


### [234] [SocialDirector: Training-Free Social Interaction Control for Multi-Person Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10079)
*Liangyang Ouyang,Ruicong Liu,Caixin Kang,Yifei Huang,Yoichi Sato*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SocialDirector是一个无需训练的视频生成交互控制器，通过调节交叉注意力图，利用社交角色掩码和方向性重加权两个模块，实现多人视频中准确的社交互动控制（如谁对谁做什么动作），显著提升交互保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型能生成逼真视频，但缺乏对多人社交互动（如对话、手势、协调动作）的显式控制，导致角色-动作不匹配、社交动态混乱、动作目标错误等问题。

Method: 提出SocialDirector，包含两个模块：(1) Social Actor Masking：通过时空掩码约束每个人物视觉token只关注自己的文本描述，避免角色-动作不匹配；(2) Directional Reweighting：增强对方向性词汇（如"向左"）的注意力，引导动作朝向正确目标。无需额外训练，直接调节生成模型的交叉注意力图。

Result: 在多个视频生成模型上的实验表明，SocialDirector显著提升了交互保真度，接近真实视频的上限。

Conclusion: SocialDirector通过无需训练的方式有效解决了视频生成中多人社交互动的控制问题，为电影制作和社交机器人等应用提供了实用方案。

Abstract: Video generation has advanced rapidly, producing photorealistic videos from text or image prompts. Meanwhile, film production and social robotics increasingly demand multi-person videos with rich social interactions, including conversations, gestures, and coordinated actions. However, existing models offer no explicit control over interactions, such as who performs which action, when it occurs, and toward whom it is directed. This often results in wrong person performing unintended actions (actor-action mismatch), disordered social dynamics, and wrong action targets. To address these challenges, we present SocialDirector, a training-free interaction controller that enhances the generation model by modulating cross-attention maps. SocialDirector contains two modules: Social Actor Masking and Directional Reweighting. Social Actor Masking constrains each person's visual tokens to attend only to their own textual descriptions via a spatiotemporal mask, avoiding actor-action mismatch and disordered social dynamics. Directional Reweighting amplifies attention to directional words (e.g., "leftward", "right"), leading each action towards its intended target. To evaluate generated social interactions, we annotate existing datasets with interaction descriptions and build a fully automated evaluation pipeline powered by open-source VLMs. Experiments on different video generation models show that SocialDirector significantly improves interaction fidelity and approaches the upper bound set by real videos.

</details>


### [235] [Rethinking Temporal Consistency in Video Object-Centric Learning: From Prediction to Correspondence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.03650)
*Zhiyuan Li,Rongzhen Zhao,Wenyan Yang,Wenshuai Zhao,Pekka Marttinen,Joni Pajarinen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Grounded Correspondence框架，用确定性二分图匹配替代传统视频目标中心学习中的学习型时序预测模块，利用预训练自监督骨干网络的特征实现零参数时序建模，在多个数据集上取得 competitive 性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频目标中心学习方法通过学习动力学模块来预测未来目标表征（slots），但这类方法复杂度高且本质上是离散对应问题的昂贵近似。作者希望利用现代自监督视觉骨干网络已有的实例判别能力来简化时序建模。

Method: 1) 从冻结的骨干网络特征中基于显著区域初始化slots；2) 帧间身份维持通过slot表征上的匈牙利匹配（确定性二分图匹配）实现；3) 完全无需可学习的时序建模参数。

Result: 在MOVi-D、MOVi-E、YouTube-VIS三个数据集上取得了与现有方法竞争的性能。

Conclusion: 学习型时序预测模块是不必要的，利用预训练自监督特征+确定性匹配即可高效实现视频中的目标中心时序一致性。

Abstract: The de facto approach in video object-centric learning maintains temporal consistency through learned dynamics modules that predict future object representations, called slots. We demonstrate that these predictors function as expensive approximations of discrete correspondence problems. Modern self-supervised vision backbones already encode instance-discriminative features that distinguish objects reliably. Exploiting these features eliminates the need for learned temporal prediction. We introduce Grounded Correspondence, a framework that replaces learned transition functions with deterministic bipartite matching. Slots initialize from salient regions in frozen backbone features. Frame-to-frame identity is maintained through Hungarian matching on slot representations. The approach requires zero learnable parameters for temporal modeling yet achieves competitive performance on MOVi-D, MOVi-E, and YouTube-VIS. Project page: https://magenta-sherbet-85b101.netlify.app/

</details>


### [236] [Initiation of Interaction Detection Framework using a Nonverbal Cue for Human-Robot Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10087)
*Guhnoo Yun,Juhan Yoo,Kijung Kim,Dong Hwan Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种无需关键词的基于音频和视觉传感器融合的人机交互启动检测框架，通过语音方向定位、人脸朝向判断和长时间注视检测三种方式识别交互意图，并在ROS环境下验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在家庭环境中，传统的人机交互依赖关键词唤醒，不够自然。本文旨在实现一种更符合人类日常交流习惯的、无需关键词的交互启动检测方式。

Method: 融合机器人自身音频传感器（声源定位）和视觉传感器（人脸检测与朝向判断），并结合外部视觉传感器进行人体跟踪。检测方式包括：1）用户说话且面向机器人时检测交互启动；2）用户长时间注视机器人（超过预设时间）时检测交互启动。设计了状态转移模型，并在ROS环境下实现集成。

Result: 通过移动机器人实验验证了所提出的状态转移模型的有效性。

Conclusion: 该框架能够在无关键词条件下，通过多模态传感器融合自然检测人机交互启动意图，适用于家庭环境中的移动机器人。

Abstract: This paper describes an initiation of interaction(IoI) detection framework without keywords for human-robot interaction(HRI) based on audio and vision sensor fusion in a domestic environment. In the proposed framework, the robot has its own audio and vision sensors, and can employ external vision sensor for stable human detection and tracking. When the user starts to speak while looking at the robot, the robot can localize his or her position by its sound source localization together with human tracking information. Then the robot can detect the IoI if it perceives the face of the speaker faces the robot. In case that the user does not speak directly, the robot can also detect the IoI if he or she looks at the robot for more than predefined periods of time. A state transition model for the proposed IoI detection framework is designed and verified by experiments with a mobile robot. In order to implement and associate our model in a robot architecture, all the components are implemented and integrated in the Robot Operating System(ROS) environment.

</details>


### [237] [HYPERPOSE: Hyperbolic Kinematic Phase-Space Attention for 3D Human Pose Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10100)
*Vinduja T.,Ashish M.,Ajay Waghumbare,Upasna Singh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HYPERPOSE是一个在双曲空间中进行3D人体姿态估计的框架，通过双曲运动学相空间注意力和多尺度窗口化双曲注意力机制，保留了人体骨骼的树状层级拓扑结构，在Human3.6M和MPI-INF-3DHP数据集上达到了SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D姿态估计方法（Transformer、GCN）在欧氏空间中建模人体姿态，但欧氏空间与人体骨骼固有的树状层级结构不匹配，导致指数级体积失真和结构连贯性丢失。作者希望摆脱平坦空间，利用双曲空间的几何特性来原生保持人体骨骼的层级拓扑。

Method: 提出了HYPERPOSE框架，核心包括：(1) 双曲运动学相空间注意力（HKPSA），在双曲空间中无失真地嵌入复杂关节关系；(2) 多尺度窗口化双曲注意力机制，以O(TW)复杂度高效建模时间动态；(3) 黎曼损失套件和不确定性加权课程学习，强制实施骨长和速度一致性等物理测地约束。

Result: 在Human3.6M和MPI-INF-3DHP数据集上，HYPERPOSE在结构连贯性和时间连贯性上达到SOTA，显著降低了体积失真和速度误差，并在整体位置精度上建立了新的SOTA基准。

Conclusion: 在双曲空间中建模人体姿态是有效的，能够原生保留人体骨骼的树状层级结构，避免欧氏空间带来的体积失真问题，同时通过精心设计的损失和训练策略克服了非欧流形训练不稳定的难题。

Abstract: We introduce HYPERPOSE, a novel 3D human pose estimation framework that performs spatio-temporal reasoning entirely within the Lorentz model of hyperbolic space $\mathbb{H}^d$ to natively preserve the hierarchical tree topology of the human skeleton. Current state-of-the-art pose estimators aim to capture complex joint dynamics by relying on transformers and graph convolutional networks. Since these architectures operate exclusively in Euclidean space which fundamentally mismatches the inherent tree structure of the human body, these methods inevitably suffer from exponential volume distortion and struggle to maintain structural coherence. To this end, we depart from flat spaces and aim to improve geometric fidelity with Hyperbolic Kinematic Phase-Space Attention (HKPSA), natively embedding complex joint relationships without distortion, alongside a multi-scale windowed hyperbolic attention mechanism that efficiently models temporal dynamics in $O(TW)$ complexity. Furthermore, to overcome the well-known instability of training non-Euclidean manifolds, HYPERPOSE introduces a novel Riemannian loss suite and an uncertainty-weighted curriculum, enforcing physical geodesic constraints like bone length and velocity consistency. Extensive evaluations on the Human3.6M and MPI-INF-3DHP datasets demonstrate that HYPERPOSE achieves state-of-the-art structural and temporal coherence, significantly reducing both volume distortion and velocity error, while establishing new state-of-the-art benchmarks in overall positional accuracy.

</details>


### [238] [ViSRA: A Video-based Spatial Reasoning Agent for Multi-modal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10106)
*Tingshu Mou,Jiabo He,Renying Wang,Ce Liu,Hao Yang,Tiehua Zhang,Jingjing Chen,Xingjun Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ViSRA是一种无需训练的视频空间推理智能体框架，通过模块化方式调用专家模型的空间信息，提升多模态大语言模型在3D空间推理任务上的表现，无需后训练或人工标注数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLM在3D空间智能方面的进展主要依赖于在特定基准上的后训练，而推理阶段的方法探索不足。本文希望探索一种无需训练的、即插即用的推理框架。

Method: 提出ViSRA框架，采用训练自由（training-free）视角，通过模块化可扩展的方式，利用专家模型提供的显式空间信息来激发MLLM的空间推理能力，实现即插即用的灵活范式。

Result: 在多个MLLM上，ViSRA在现有基准上提升高达15.6%，在未见过的3D空间推理任务上提升高达28.9%。

Conclusion: ViSRA能有效提升MLLM的3D空间推理能力，具有人类对齐、可迁移、无需后训练开销等优势，是一种有前景的推理增强范式。

Abstract: Recent advances in Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) target 3D spatial intelligence, yet the progress has been largely driven by post-training on curated benchmarks, leaving the inference-time approach relatively underexplored. In this paper, we take a training-free perspective and introduce ViSRA, a human-aligned Video-based Spatial Reasoning Agent, as a framework to probe the spatial reasoning mechanism of MLLMs. ViSRA elicits spatial reasoning in a modular and extensible manner by leveraging explicit spatial information from expert models, enabling a plug-and-play flexible paradigm. ViSRA offers two key advantages: (1) human-aligned and transferable 3D understanding rather than task-specific overfitting; and (2) no post-training computational cost along with heavy manual curation of spatial reasoning datasets. Experimental results demonstrate consistent improvement across a set of MLLMs on both existing benchmarks and unseen 3D spatial reasoning tasks, with ViSRA outperforming baselines by up to a 15.6% and 28.9% absolute margin respectively.

</details>


### [239] [Think as Needed: Geometry-Driven Adaptive Perception for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10117)
*Donghyun Kim,Jaehyoung Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Enhanced HOPE，一种自适应感知架构，通过几何复杂度估计动态选择处理路径、线性时间子空间网络替代二次注意力、以及持久时序记忆模块，在自动驾驶3D检测中实现简单场景38%延迟降低、长尾场景2.7 mAP提升，并支持>5秒的遮挡跟踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D检测模型对所有帧使用固定计算预算，在简单场景浪费资源、复杂场景能力不足；Transformer交互模型随目标数量二次增长；帧级处理导致遮挡目标立即被遗忘。

Method: 1) 无监督统计估计器测量每帧几何复杂度，动态路由到浅层或深层处理路径；2) 线性时间子空间网络将邻近目标聚类后联合处理，替代二次注意力；3) 持久时序记忆模块跨帧保留检测目标和交通规则，支持遮挡目标回忆。

Result: 在nuScenes和CARLA上：简单场景延迟降低38%且无精度损失；长尾场景mAP提升2.7点；遮挡跟踪超过5秒，所有基线方法均失败。

Conclusion: Enhanced HOPE通过自适应计算分配和高效时序记忆，在保持精度的同时大幅提升效率，并在遮挡跟踪等关键挑战上显著超越现有方法。

Abstract: Autonomous driving scenes range from empty highways to dense intersections with dozens of interacting road users, yet current 3D detection models apply a fixed computation budget to every frame, wasting resources on simple scenes while lacking capacity for complex ones. Existing approaches compound this problem: Transformer-based interaction models scale quadratically with the number of detected objects, and frame-by-frame processing causes the system to immediately forget objects the moment they become occluded. We propose Enhanced HOPE, an adaptive perception architecture that measures the geometric complexity of each incoming LiDAR frame using an unsupervised statistical estimator and routes it through a shallow or deep processing path accordingly, requiring no manual scene labels. To keep interaction modeling efficient, we replace quadratic pairwise attention with a linear-time subspace-based network that groups nearby objects into clusters and processes them jointly. The computational savings from these two mechanisms free up resources for a persistent temporal memory module that retains previously detected objects and traffic rules across frames, enabling the system to recall occluded objects seconds after they disappear from view. On the nuScenes and CARLA benchmarks, Enhanced HOPE reduces latency by 38% on simple scenes with no accuracy loss, improves mean Average Precision by 2.7 points on rare long-tail scenarios, and tracks objects through occlusions lasting over 5 seconds, where all tested baselines fail.

</details>


### [240] [MicroWorld: Empowering Multimodal Large Language Models to Bridge the Microscopic Domain Gap with Multimodal Attribute Graph](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10120)
*Manyu Li,Ruian He,Chenxi Ma,Weimin Tan,Bo Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MicroWorld 是一个无需领域微调、通过构建多模态属性知识图谱（MAPG）来增强多模态大模型在显微图像推理任务中性能的框架，在 MicroVQA 基准上将 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 的性能提升了 37.5%，超越 GPT-5 达到新 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大模型在科学推理方面潜力巨大，但在显微镜等专业领域表现受限，主要由于缺乏领域特定的训练数据以及难以将细粒度的专家知识编码到模型参数中。

Method: 1) 从大规模科学图像-文本语料库构建多模态属性属性图（MAPG），包含约 111K 节点和 346K 边；2) 通过 scispaCy 或基于 LLM 的三元组挖掘提取生物医学实体与关系；3) 使用 Qwen3-VL-Embedding 对齐图像和实体的嵌入空间；4) 推理时通过图增强检索流水线将结构化知识注入 MLLM 提示中。

Result: 在 MicroVQA 基准上，将 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 的推理性能提升 37.5%，超越 GPT-5 13.0% 达到新 SOTA；在 MicroBench 基准上获得 6.0% 的性能提升。

Conclusion: MicroWorld 通过外部知识图谱增强推理的方式有效提升了 MLLM 在显微镜领域的泛化能力，无需领域微调即可取得显著性能提升，同时为未来研究指明了改进方向。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) show remarkable potential for scientific reasoning, yet their performance in specialized domains such as microscopy remains limited by the scarcity of domain-specific training data and the difficulty of encoding fine-grained expert knowledge into model parameters. To bridge the gap, we introduce MicroWorld, a framework that constructs a multimodal attributed property graph (MAPG) from large-scale scientific image--caption corpora and leverages it to augment MLLM reasoning at inference time without any domain-specific fine-tuning. MicroWorld extracts biomedical entities and relations via scispaCy or LLM-based triplet mining, aligns images and entities in a shared embedding space using Qwen3-VL-Embedding, and assembles a knowledge graph comprising approximately 111K nodes and 346K typed edges spanning eight relation categories. At inference time, a graph-augmented retrieval pipeline matches query entities to the MAPG and injects structured knowledge context into the MLLM prompt. On the MicroVQA benchmark, MicroWorld improves the reasoning performance of Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct by 37.5%, outperforming GPT-5 by 13.0% to achieve a new state-of-the-art. Furthermore, it yields a 6.0% performance gain on the MicroBench benchmark. Extensive experiments demonstrate the enhanced generalization capability introduced by MicroWorld. A qualitative case study further reveals both the mechanisms through which structured knowledge improves reasoning and the failure modes that point to promising future directions. Code and data are available at https://github.com/ieellee/MicroWorld.

</details>


### [241] [Fashion130K: An E-commerce Fashion Dataset for Outfit Generation with Unified Multi-modal Condition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10127)
*Yu He,Ting Zhu,Yichun Liu,Lichen Ma,Xinyuan Shan,Jingling Fu,Yu Shi,Junshi Huang,Yan Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出名为Fashion130k的电商数据集，并设计了统一多模态条件（UMC）框架，通过嵌入精炼器和融合Transformer对齐文本与视觉提示，实现服装的视觉一致性生成，效果优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时尚服装生成研究主要依赖参考图像和文本提示来提升视觉一致性，但缺乏全面的电商数据集，且对多模态条件的利用不够充分。

Method: 1) 构建Fashion130k电商数据集，包含多种场合、模特和服装类型；2) 提出UMC框架，通过嵌入精炼器提取多模态提示的统一嵌入；3) 设计融合Transformer调整文本与图像之间的模态差距；4) 重新设计生成模型中的注意力机制，增强提示与噪声图像之间的相关性。

Result: 在真实应用和基准测试上的大量实验表明，UMC在视觉一致性方面取得了优于最先进方法的效果。

Conclusion: 提出的数据集和框架为多模态提示在生成模型中的应用提供了通用且细致的探索路径。

Abstract: Recent research work on fashion outfit generation focuses on promoting visual consistency of garments by leveraging key information from reference image and text prompt. However, the potential of outfit generation remains underexplored, requiring comprehensive e-commercial dataset and elaborative utilization of multi-modal condition. In this paper, we propose a brand-new e-commerce dataset, named Fashion130k, with various occasions, models, and garment types. For the consistent generation of garment, we design a framework with Unified Multi-modal Condition (UMC) to align and integrate the text and visual prompts into generation model. Specifically, we explore an embedding refiner to extract the unified embeddings of multi-modal prompts, within which a Fusion Transformer is proposed to align the multi-modal embeddings by adjusting the modality gap between text and image. Based on unified embeddings, the attention in generation model is redesigned to emphasis the correlations between prompts and noise image, inducing that the noise image can select the pivotal tokens of prompts for consistent outfit generation. Our dataset and proposed framework offer a general and nuanced exploration of multi-modal prompts for generation models. Extensive experiments on real-world applications and benchmark demonstrate the effectiveness of UMC in visual consistency, achieving promising result than that of SoTA methods.

</details>


### [242] [Thermal-Det: Language-Guided Cross-Modal Distillation for Open-Vocabulary Thermal Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10130)
*Yasiru Ranasinghe,Elim Schenck,Florence Yellin,Shuowen Hu,Christopher Funk,Vishal M. Patel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Thermal-Det是首个基于大语言模型监督的热成像开放词汇检测器，通过合成热域数据集和跨模态蒸馏，在公共基准上实现2-4%的AP提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开放词汇检测器仅适用于RGB图像，无法推广到热成像领域，因为热图像的低纹理和发射率变化挑战了RGB语义的泛化能力。

Method: 1) 将GroundingCap-1M转换为热域并过滤RGB特定术语，构建大规模热对齐数据集；2) 联合优化检测、描述和跨模态蒸馏目标；3) 冻结的RGB教师模型为未标记的RGB-热配对数据提供伪监督；4) 引入热-文本对齐头进行文本校准，以及模态融合交叉注意力模块实现双模态推理。

Result: 在公共基准上，相比现有开放词汇检测器，持续获得2-4%的AP提升。

Conclusion: Thermal-Det通过全微调内化热对比模式同时保持语言对齐，为可扩展的、语言驱动的热感知建立了坚实基础。

Abstract: Existing open-vocabulary detectors focus on RGB images and fail to generalize to thermal imagery, where low texture and emissivity variations challenge RGB-based semantics. We present Thermal-Det, the first large language model (LLM) supervised open-vocabulary detector tailored for thermal images. To enable large-scale training, we develop a synthetic dataset by converting GroundingCap-1M into the thermal domain and filtering captions to remove RGB-specific terms, yielding over one million thermally aligned samples with bounding boxes, grounding texts, and detailed captions. Thermal-Det jointly optimizes detection, captioning, and cross-modal distillation objectives. A frozen RGB teacher provides geometric and semantic pseudo-supervision for paired but unlabeled RGB-thermal data, transferring open-vocabulary knowledge without manual annotation. The model further employs a Thermal-Text Alignment Head for text calibration and a Modality-Fused Cross-Attention module for dual-modality reasoning. Unlike prior domain-adaptation methods, the detector is fully fine-tuned to internalize thermal contrast patterns while preserving language alignment. Experiments on public benchmarks show consistent 2-4% AP gains over existing open-vocabulary detectors, establishing a strong foundation for scalable, language-driven thermal perception.

</details>


### [243] [Scaling Vision Models Does Not Consistently Improve Localisation-Based Explanation Quality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10142)
*Mateusz Cedro,Marcin Chlebus*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过评估11个计算机视觉模型（ResNet、DenseNet、Vision Transformer系列）在三个数据集上的后验解释质量，发现更大的模型（更深、参数更多）并不必然产生更高质量的解释，小模型有时表现更好；预测性能高不代表解释质量高，解释性应在模型选择时被明确评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究大规模AI模型在提升预测精度的同时，是否也能提升后验解释（post-hoc explanations）的质量，以澄清"模型越大解释越好"这一隐含假设。

Method: 选取11个具有不同深度和复杂度的视觉模型（ResNet、DenseNet、Vision Transformer），在三个带真实分割掩码的图像数据集上，使用5种后验可解释AI方法生成解释，并通过Relevance Rank Accuracy和新提出的Dual-Polarity Precision两个定位指标量化掩码对齐程度。

Result: 大多数统计比较中，增加架构深度和参数量并未提升解释质量，小模型往往持平或超越大模型。预训练可提升预测性能，但未一致提升定位分数。部分模型预测性能很高但定位精度接近零，说明性能指标无法反映解释质量。

Conclusion: 更大的模型并不可靠地提供更高质量的解释，在安全关键场景的模型选择中，应明确评估可解释性，而非仅依赖预测性能。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence models are increasingly scaled to improve predictive accuracy, yet it remains unclear whether scale improves the quality of post-hoc explanations. We investigate this relationship by evaluating 11 computer vision models representing increasing levels of depth and complexity within the ResNet, DenseNet, and Vision Transformer families, trained from scratch or pretrained, across three image datasets with ground-truth segmentation masks. For each model, we generate explanations using five post-hoc explainable AI methods and quantify mask alignment using two localisation metrics: Relevance Rank Accuracy (Arras et al., 2022) and the proposed Dual-Polarity Precision, which measures positive attributions inside the class mask and negative attributions outside it. Across datasets and methods, increasing architectural depth and parameter count does not improve explanation quality in most statistical comparisons, and smaller models often match or exceed deeper variants. While pretraining typically improves predictive performance and increases the dependence of explanations on learned weights, it does not consistently increase localisation scores. We also observe scenarios in which models achieve strong predictive performance while localisation precision is near zero, suggesting that performance metrics alone may not indicate whether predictions are based on the annotated regions. These results indicate that larger models do not reliably provide higher-quality explanations, and that explainability should therefore be assessed explicitly during model selection for safety-sensitive deployments.

</details>


### [244] [MicroViTv2: Beyond the FLOPS for Edge Energy-Friendly Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10148)
*Novendra Setyawan,Chi-Chia Sun,Mao-Hsiu Hsu,Wen-Kai Kuo,Jun-Wei Hsieh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MicroViTv2是一种轻量级Vision Transformer，通过重参数化设计（RepEmbed、RepDW）和单深度可分离转置注意力（SDTA），在保持快速推理和高能效的同时，比前代和MobileViTv2等模型提升了最多0.5%的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Vision Transformer在视觉任务中准确率高，但计算成本高，难以部署在边缘设备上。现有轻量级方案效率仍不够，需要兼顾精度与硬件效率。

Method: 基于MicroViT进行改进，提出三种关键技术：1) 重参数化补丁嵌入（RepEmbed）加速推理；2) 重参数化深度可分离卷积混合器（RepDW）；3) 单深度可分离转置注意力（SDTA）捕捉长距离依赖并减少冗余。

Result: 在ImageNet-1K和COCO上，MicroViTv2比前代准确率提升约0.5%，超越MobileViTv2、EdgeNeXt、EfficientViT；在Jetson AGX Orin上推理速度快、能效高。

Conclusion: 硬件感知设计与结构重参数化是实现高精度与低能耗的关键，评估效率不能只看FLOPs，还需考虑实际硬件性能。

Abstract: The Vision Transformer (ViT) achieves remarkable accuracy across visual tasks but remains computationally expensive for edge deployment. This paper presents MicroViTv2, a lightweight Vision Transformer optimized for real-device efficiency. Built upon the original MicroViT, the proposed model is designed based on reparameterized design, specifically Reparameterized Patch Embedding (RepEmbed) and Reparameterized Depth-Wise convolution mixer (RepDW) for faster inference, and introduces the Single Depth-Wise Transposed Attention (SDTA) to capture long-range dependencies with minimal redundancy. Despite slightly higher FLOPs, MicroViTv2 improves accuracy up to 0.5% compared to its predecessor and surpassing MobileViTv2, EdgeNeXt, and EfficientViT while maintaining fast inference and high energy efficiency on Jetson AGX Orin. Experiments on ImageNet-1K and COCO demonstrate that hardware-aware design and structural re-parameterization are key to achieving high accuracy and low energy consumption, validating the need to evaluate efficiency beyond FLOPs. Code is available at https://github.com/novendrastywn/MicroViT.

</details>


### [245] [Improving Temporal Action Segmentation via Constraint-Aware Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10149)
*Yeo Keat Ee,Debaditya Roy,Chen Li,Hao Zhang,Basura Fernando*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种轻量级的基于约束的修正框架CAD，通过将统计结构先验（如转移置信度、动作边界集、每类时长）集成到改进的Viterbi解码算法中，在不重新训练或增加模型复杂度的情况下，提升全监督和半监督时间动作分割（TAS）模型的性能，有效修正结构性预测错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间动作分割方法面临动作变异性大、边界模糊、标注成本高等挑战，基于语法的方法虽能引入结构先验但依赖复杂解析、扩展性差，因此需要一种轻量、可扩展且不增加模型复杂度的修正方法。

Method: 提出约束修正框架CAD：从标注数据中提取统计结构先验（转移置信度、动作边界集、每类时长），将其集成到改进的Viterbi解码算法中，在推理阶段对模型预测进行修正，无需重新训练或增加模型复杂度。

Result: 该方法在多个数据集上有效提升了全监督和半监督TAS模型的性能，尤其能修正结构性预测错误，同时保持高效率。

Conclusion: 提出的轻量级约束修正框架能够在无需重新训练的情况下提升TAS模型性能，具有良好的扩展性和实用性，代码已开源。

Abstract: Temporal action segmentation (TAS) divides untrimmed videos into labeled action segments. While fully supervised methods have advanced the field, challenges such as action variability, ambiguous boundaries, and high annotation costs remain, especially in new or low-resource domains. Grammar-based approaches improve segmentation with structural priors but rely on complex parsing limiting scalability. In this work, we propose a lightweight, constraint-based refinement framework that enhances TAS predictions by integrating statistical structural priors such as transition confidence, action boundary sets, and per-class duration, that can be directly extracted from annotated data. These constraints are integrated into a modified Viterbi decoding algorithm, allowing inference-time refinement without retraining or added model complexity. Our approach improves both fully and semi-supervised TAS models by correcting structural prediction errors while maintaining high efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/LUNAProject22/CAD

</details>


### [246] [MolSight: Molecular Property Prediction with Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10157)
*Aaditya Baranwal,Akshaj Gupta,Shruti Vyas,Yogesh S Rawat*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MolSight系统性地研究了基于视觉的分子性质预测（MPP），使用10种视觉架构、7种预训练策略和200万张分子图像，在10个下游任务上评估性能。提出化学信息课程学习策略，仅凭分子二维结构图像即可实现竞争性预测，在5/10个基准上达到最优，计算量仅为最接近的多模态竞品的1/80。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子二维骨架图是普适存在的分子表示形式，但在现代性质预测中被分子图、3D构象或大语言模型所忽视，这些方法都带来了额外的计算和数据工程开销。作者希望探索仅凭视觉信息（二维分子图像）是否足以进行有效的分子性质预测。

Method: 系统性地使用10种视觉架构、7种预训练策略，在200万张分子图像上训练。提出化学信息课程学习：使用5种结构复杂度描述符将语料库划分为5个难度层级进行课程训练。在10个下游任务（物理性质回归、药物发现分类、量子化学预测）上评估。

Result: 课程训练的最佳配置在10个基准中的5个上取得最优结果，在所有10个基准上均进入前两名。计算量仅为最接近的多模态竞品的1/80。

Conclusion: 单张渲染的二维分子键线图经视觉编码器处理，足以实现具有竞争力的分子性质预测，即"化学洞察来自视觉本身"（chemical insight from sight alone）。

Abstract: Every molecule ever synthesised can be drawn as a 2D skeletal diagram, yet in modern property prediction this universally available representation has received less focus in favour of molecular graphs, 3D conformers, or billion-parameter language models, each imposing its own computational and data-engineering overhead. We present $\textbf{MolSight}$, the first systematic large-scale study of vision-based Molecular Property Prediction (MPP). Using 10 vision architectures, 7 pre-training strategies, and $2\,M$ molecule images, we evaluate performance across 10 downstream tasks spanning physical-property regression, drug-discovery classification, and quantum-chemistry prediction. To account for the wide variation in structural complexity across pre-training molecules, we further propose a $\textbf{chemistry-informed curriculum}$: five structural complexity descriptors partition the corpus into five tiers of increasing chemical difficulty, consistently outperforming non-curriculum baselines. We show that a single rendered bond-line image, processed by a vision encoder, is sufficient for competitive molecular property prediction, i.e. $\textit{chemical insight from sight alone}$. The best curriculum-trained configuration achieves the top result on $\textbf{5 of 10}$ benchmarks and top two on $\textbf{all 10}$, at $\textbf{$\textit{80$\times$ lower}$}$ FLOPs than the nearest multi-modal competitor.

</details>


### [247] [Active-SAOOD: Active Sparsely Annotated Oriented Object Detection in Remote Sensing Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10162)
*Yu Lin,Jianghang Lin,Kai Ye,Shengchuan Zhang,Liujuan Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Active-SAOOD，一种基于主动学习的稀疏标注有向目标检测方法，通过联合考虑方向、分类、定位不确定性和类间类内多样性，在仅1%标注比例下实现9%的性能提升，解决了稀疏标注依赖类别采样和缺乏对稀疏样本特性深入研究的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遥感图像中有向目标检测的标注成本高，现有稀疏标注方法存在两个问题：(1)依赖类别采样的数据选择方式不够灵活；(2)缺乏对稀疏样本特性的深入探究，限制了其发展。

Method: 提出Active-SAOOD方法，核心是模型状态观测模块，在实例级别主动选择对当前模型状态最有价值的稀疏样本，联合考虑方向不确定性、分类不确定性、定位不确定性以及类间和类内多样性。

Result: 在多个数据集上，Active-SAOOD在不同随机稀疏标注下显著提升了现有SAOOD方法的性能和稳定性。仅用1%标注比例，比基线方法提升9%的性能。

Conclusion: Active-SAOOD能够在完全随机初始化的稀疏标注下稳定运行，扩展了稀疏标注有向目标检测在真实场景中的适用性，提高了其实用价值。

Abstract: Reducing the annotation cost of oriented object detection in remote sensing remains a major challenge. Recently, sparse annotation has gained attention for effectively reducing annotation redundancy in densely remote sensing scenes. However, (1) the sparse data reliance on class-dependent sampling, and (2) the lack of in-depth investigation into the characteristics of sparse samples hinders its further development. This paper proposes an active learning-based sparsely annotated oriented object detection (SAOOD) method, termed Active-SAOOD. Based on a model state observation module, Active-SAOOD actively selects the most valuable sparse samples at the instance level that are best suited to the current model state, by jointly considering orientation, classification, and localization uncertainty, as well as inter- and intra-class diversity. This design enables SAOOD to operate stably under completely randomly initialized sparse annotations and extends its applicability to broader real-world. Experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that Active-SAOOD significantly improves both performance and stability of existing SAOOD methods under various random sparse annotation. In particular, with only 1\% annotated ratios, it achieves a 9\% performance gain over the baseline, further enhancing the practical value of SAOOD in remote sensing. The code will be public.

</details>


### [248] [Task-Agnostic Noisy Label Detection via Standardized Loss Aggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10165)
*Inhyuk Park,Doohyun Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为SLA（标准化损失聚合）的通用框架，通过聚合多次交叉验证中的标准化折叠验证损失，实现在样本级别检测噪声标签，并在眼底数据集上优于硬计数基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模医学影像数据集中的噪声标签普遍存在（由观察者间变异性和模糊病例导致），需要一种统计上稳健、任务无关的样本级噪声标签检测方法。

Method: SLA框架：在重复交叉验证中聚合标准化的折叠验证损失，将离散的硬计数方案泛化为连续估计器，同时捕捉性能偏差的频率和幅度，生成可解释且统计稳定的噪声分数。

Result: 在公开眼底数据集上，SLA在所有噪声水平下均一致优于硬计数基线，尤其在低噪声比下收敛速度显著更快。

Conclusion: SLA分数高的样本指示潜在模糊或错误标签案例，可指导高效重新标注并提升数据集可靠性，适用于任何分类任务。

Abstract: Noisy labels are common in large-scale medical imaging datasets due to inter-observer variability and ambiguous cases. We propose a statistically grounded and task-agnostic framework, Standardized Loss Aggregation (SLA), for detecting noisy labels at the sample level. SLA quantifies label reliability by aggregating standardized fold-level validation losses across repeated cross-validation runs. This formulation generalizes discrete hard-counting schemes into a continuous estimator that captures both the frequency and magnitude of performance deviations, yielding interpretable and statistically stable noisiness scores. Experiments on a public fundus dataset demonstrate that SLA consistently outperforms the hard-counting baseline across all noise levels and converges substantially faster, especially under low noise ratios where subtle loss variations are informative. Samples with high SLA scores indicate potentially ambiguous or mislabeled cases, guiding efficient re-annotation and improving dataset reliability for any classification task.

</details>


### [249] [V-ABS: Action-Observer Driven Beam Search for Dynamic Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10172)
*Zhiwei Ning,Xuanang Gao,Jiaxi Cao,Gengming Zhang,Shengnan Ma,Wenwen Tong,Hanming Deng,Jie Yang,Wei Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: V-ABS提出了一种基于行动-观测驱动的波束搜索框架，通过思考者-行动者-观测者的迭代机制和熵权自适应加权算法，有效缓解多模态大语言模型在多步视觉推理中的想象-行动-观测(IAO)偏差，在8个基准测试中平均提升19.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLM在多步视觉推理中存在IAO偏差（想象与观测反馈之间的失调），导致推理不稳定且次优，亟需一种能够有效利用执行反馈的推理框架。

Method: 1）提出V-ABS行动-观测驱动波束搜索框架，包含思考者(Thinker)-行动者(Actor)-观测者(Observer)的迭代循环；2）设计基于熵的自适应加权算法，动态平衡策略先验与观测反馈的置信度得分以缓解IAO偏差；3）构建超80k样本的大规模SFT数据集，引导模型为正确行动路径赋予更高先验置信度。

Result: 在8个多样化基准测试上达到SOTA性能，在Qwen3-VL-8B基线上平均提升19.7%，且对开源和闭源模型均有稳定提升。

Conclusion: V-ABS通过显式建模行动-观测反馈循环并自适应平衡先验与观测，有效解决了多步视觉推理中的IAO偏差，是一种通用且有效的推理增强框架。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable success in general perception, yet complex multi-step visual reasoning remains a persistent challenge. Although recent agentic approaches incorporate tool use, they often neglect critical execution feedback. Consequently, they suffer from the imagination-action-observer (IAO) bias, a misalignment between prior imagination and observer feedback that undermines reasoning stability and optimality. To bridge this gap, we introduce V-ABS, an action-observer driven beam search framework that enables deliberate reasoning through thinker-actor-observer iterations. We also propose an entropy-based adaptive weighting algorithm to mitigate the IAO bias by dynamically balancing the confidence scores between the policy priors and the observational feedback. Moreover, we construct a large-scale supervised fine-tuning (SFT) dataset comprising over 80k samples to guide the model to assign higher prior confidence to correct action paths. Extensive experiments across eight diverse benchmarks show that V-ABS achieves state-of-the-art performance, delivering an average improvement of 19.7% on the Qwen3-VL-8B baseline and consistent gains across both open-source and proprietary models.

</details>


### [250] [BathyFacto: Refraction-Aware Two-Media Neural Radiance Fields for Bathymetry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10174)
*Markus Brezovsky,Anatol Günthner,Frederik Schulte,Lukas Winiwarter,Boris Jutzi,Gottfried Mandlburger*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出BathyFacto，一种基于NeRF的折射感知双介质浅水测深方法，通过Snell定律修正空气-水界面的光线折射，在模拟数据集上将点云精度从0.52 m（基线）提升至0.06 m，完整度从29%提升至87%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机影像的水下摄影测量受空气-水界面折射影响，传统SfM和MVS方法基于直线光线假设，导致系统性深度偏差，无法获得高精度水下点云。

Method: 基于Nerfstudio框架，扩展Nerfacto为双介质版本：(1) 共享哈希网格密度场 + 介质条件颜色头（空气/水标记）；(2) 光线分段追踪：空气段直线+水段斯涅尔定律折射；(3) 虚拟直线采样+扭结密度包装器处理跨界面样本；(4) 数据适配管线：估计水平面、生成逐像素介质掩膜；(5) 折射校正的点云反投影与坐标变换。

Result: 在模拟双介质场景上，BathyFacto的云到网格平均距离为0.06 m，完整度87%；Nerfacto基线为0.52 m/29%，传统MVS为0.36 m/21%。

Conclusion: 折射感知的神经渲染方法可显著提升水下点云度量和完整度，为浅水测深提供了高精度替代方案。

Abstract: Through-water photogrammetry based on UAV imagery enables shallow-water bathymetry, but refraction at the air-water interface violates the straight-ray assumption of Structure-from-Motion and causes systematic depth bias. We present BathyFacto, a refraction-aware two-media extension of Nerfacto integrated into Nerfstudio that targets metrically precise underwater point clouds. BathyFacto uses a shared hash-grid-based density field with a medium-conditioned color head that receives a one-bit medium flag (air or water) and traces each camera ray as two segments: a straight segment in air up to a planar water surface and a refracted segment in water computed via Snell's law with known refractive indices. To allocate samples efficiently across the air-water boundary, we employ a single proposal-network sampler that operates on a virtual straight ray spanning both media, combined with a kinked density wrapper that transparently corrects water-segment positions along the refracted direction before density evaluation. A data adaptation pipeline converts photogrammetric reconstructions to a Nerfstudio-compatible format, estimates the water plane from boundary markers, and provides per-pixel medium masks to gate refraction. We also extend the point cloud export with refraction-corrected backprojection and reversible coordinate transforms to world and global frames. On a simulated two-media scene with known ground truth, BathyFacto with refraction achieves a Cloud-to-Mesh mean distance of 0.06 m and 87 % completeness, compared to 0.52 m / 29 % for the Nerfacto baseline and 0.36 m / 21% for conventional MVS without refraction correction.

</details>


### [251] [What Concepts Lie Within? Detecting and Suppressing Risky Content in Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10180)
*Chenyu Zhang,Lanjun Wang,Yueyang Cheng,Ruidong Chen,Wenhui Li,An-an Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出AHV-D&S，一种无需训练、推理时生效的安全防护方法，通过分析Diffusion Transformer中注意力头对语义概念的特异性敏感度，检测并抑制文本到图像模型生成色情、暴力、版权等风险内容，同时保持生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有风险概念消除方法主要针对早期U-Net架构设计，无法有效保护基于Diffusion Transformer（DiT）的最先进T2I模型，因为DiT通过联合注意力机制将语义注入与视觉合成紧密耦合，难以隔离和擦除风险内容。

Method: 提出AHV-D&S方法：(1) 将每个文本token在所有注意力头上的敏感度量化为注意力头向量(AHV)，作为检测风险生成倾向的判别性签名；(2) 在推理阶段，采用基于动量的策略动态追踪去噪步骤中token级别的AHV；(3) 基于头特定风险分数，对识别出的风险token进行敏感度引导的自适应注意力权重抑制。

Result: 实验表明，AHV-D&S能有效抑制色情、版权风格及各类有害内容的生成，同时保持视觉质量，并对对抗性提示表现出强鲁棒性，且在不同DiT-based T2I模型间具有可迁移性。

Conclusion: 本文发现DiT中注意力头具有概念特异性敏感度，并基于此设计了无需训练、即插即用的推理时安全防护方法，弥补了DiT架构T2I模型在风险内容抑制方面的空白。

Abstract: The rise of text-to-image (T2I) models has increasingly raised concerns regarding the generation of risky content, such as sexual, violent, and copyright-protected images, highlighting the need for effective safeguards within the models themselves. Although existing methods have been proposed to eliminate risky concepts from T2I models, they are primarily developed for earlier U-Net architectures, leaving the state-of-the-art Diffusion-Transformer-based T2I models inadequately protected. This gap stems from a fundamental architectural shift: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) entangle semantic injection and visual synthesis via joint attention, which makes it difficult to isolate and erase risky content within the generation. To bridge this gap, we investigate how semantic concepts are represented in DiTs and discover that attention heads exhibit concept-specific sensitivity. This property enables both the detection and suppression of risky content. Building on this discovery, we propose AHV-D\&S, a training-free inference-time safeguard for image generation in DiTs. Specifically, AHV-D\&S quantifies each textual token's sensitivity across all attention heads as an Attention Head Vector (AHV), which serves as a discriminative signature for detecting risky generation tendencies. In the inference stage, we propose a momentum-based strategy to dynamically track token-wise AHVs across denoising steps, and a sensitivity-guided adaptive suppression strategy that suppresses the attention weights of identified risky tokens based on head-specific risk scores. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AHV-D\&S effectively suppresses sexual, copyrighted-style, and various harmful content while preserving visual quality, and further exhibits strong robustness against adversarial prompts and transferability across different DiT-based T2I models.

</details>


### [252] [A Comparative Study of Machine Learning and Deep Learning for Out-of-Distribution Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10181)
*Jihyeon Baek,Seunghoon Lee,Gitaek Kwon,Doohyun Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文比较了传统机器学习（ML）与深度学习（DL）在医学图像分布外（OOD）检测任务中的表现。在超过60,000张眼底和非眼底图像上，两种方法均达到AUROC 1.000和准确率0.999-1.000，但ML方法在保持同等精度的同时显著降低了端到端延迟，表明在视觉复杂度有限的OOD检测任务中，轻量级ML方法可以以更低计算成本实现DL级别的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管深度学习通常被认为优于传统机器学习，但医学影像数据采集于标准化协议下，图像变异性相对受限，因此有必要在OOD检测任务中对这两种方法进行直接比较。

Method: 在包含超过60,000张眼底和非眼底图像、多种分辨率的公开数据集上，分别使用ML和DL两种方法进行OOD检测，并在内部和外部验证集上评估性能。

Result: 两种方法在内部和外部验证集上均达到AUROC 1.000和准确率0.999-1.000，检测性能相当。但ML方法在保持同等精度的同时，端到端延迟显著更低，计算效率更高。

Conclusion: 对于视觉复杂度有限的OOD检测任务，轻量级ML方法可以以显著更低的计算成本达到DL级别的性能，更适合实际部署。

Abstract: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is essential for building reliable AI systems, as models that produce outputs for invalid inputs cannot be trusted. Although deep learning (DL) is often assumed to outperform traditional machine learning (ML), medical imaging data are typically acquired under standardized protocols, leading to relatively constrained image variability in OOD detection tasks. This motivates a direct comparison between ML and DL approaches in this setting. The two approaches are evaluated on open datasets comprising over 60,000 fundus and non-fundus images across multiple resolutions. Both approaches achieved an AUROC of 1.000 and accuracies between 0.999 and 1.000 on internal and external validation sets, showing comparable detection performance. The ML approach, however, exhibited substantially lower end-to-end latency while maintaining equivalent accuracy, indicating greater computational efficiency. These results suggest that for OOD detection tasks of limited visual complexity, lightweight ML approaches can achieve DL-level performance with significantly reduced computational cost, supporting practical real-world deployment.

</details>


### [253] [Developing a foundation model for high-resolution remote sensing data of the Netherlands](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10184)
*Paul Vermeeren,Heysem Kaya*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文基于荷兰120万张高分辨率卫星影像，通过CNN与Vision Transformer混合架构及时间序列数据建模，构建了一个遥感基础模型。该模型在荷兰本土植被监测任务中表现优异，并在全球基准测试中以更小参数量取得与SOTA相当的竞争力。代码和模型已开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有遥感基础模型通常依赖大规模全球数据和庞大参数量，训练成本高。作者希望探索能否利用有限区域（荷兰）的高分辨率数据，结合时间维度信息，学习出具有良好泛化能力且更高效的遥感表征模型。

Method: (1) 数据：120万张荷兰高分辨率卫星影像；(2) 架构：CNN + Vision Transformer混合模型，CNN捕获低频细节（纹理、边缘、小物体），ViT捕获高频结构（地形、地貌、土地利用）；(3) 时间建模：将时序数据作为输入，学习地形变化、土地覆盖动态和季节变化等时间依赖关系，减少特征模糊性。

Result: (1) 在荷兰植被监测数据集上，引入时间信息后性能显著优于单时相方法；(2) 在全球基准测试中，尽管模型规模更小、预训练数据仅限荷兰，仍取得与SOTA相当的竞争性结果；(3) 证明了从有限数据中可学到丰富且泛化的表征。

Conclusion: 该工作表明：(1) 结合CNN与ViT的混合架构能有效捕捉遥感影像中多尺度特征；(2) 时间维度的信息可以显著提升表征学习质量并减少标注需求；(3) 区域级别的预训练数据在精心设计下也能产生具有全球泛化能力的基础模型，为低成本遥感基础模型研发提供了新思路。

Abstract: We develop a foundation model using 1.2m high resolution satellite images of the Netherlands. By combining a Convolutional Neural Network and a Vision Transformer, the model captures both low- and high-frequency landscape features, such as fine textures, edges, and small objects as well as large terrain structures, elevation patterns, and land-cover distributions. Leveraging temporal data as input, the model learns from broader contextual information across time, allowing the model to exploit the temporal dependencies, such as topographic features, land-cover changes, and seasonal dynamics. These additional constraints reduce feature ambiguity, improve representation learning, and enable better generalization with fewer labeled samples. The foundation model is evaluated on multiple downstream tasks, ranging from use cases within the Netherlands to global benchmarking datasets. On the vegetation monitoring dataset of the Netherlands, the model shows clear performance improvements by incorporating temporal information instead of relying on a single time point. Despite using a smaller model and less pretraining data limited to the Netherlands, it achieves competitive results on global benchmarks when compared to state-of-the-art models. These results demonstrate that the model can learn rich, generalizable representations from limited data, achieving competitive performance on global benchmarks while using a fraction of the parameters of larger state-of-the-art remote sensing models. To maximize reproducibility and reuse, we made the scripts and the model accessible on GitHub.

</details>


### [254] [DynGhost: Temporally-Modelled Transformer for Dynamic Ghost Imaging with Quantum Detectors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10185)
*Vittorio Palladino,Ahmet Enis Cetin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DynGhost，一种基于Transformer的动态鬼成像架构，通过时空注意力块和量子感知训练框架解决现有方法无法处理动态场景和真实光子统计噪声的问题，在动态和光子匮乏场景下表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习鬼成像方法存在两个关键局限：一是无法利用帧间时间相关性处理动态场景，二是假设加性高斯噪声模型，不符合单光子硬件的真实泊松统计特性。

Method: 提出DynGhost（动态鬼成像Transformer），采用交替的空间和时间注意力块；量子感知训练框架基于物理精确的探测器模拟（SNSPDs、SPADs、SiPMs）和Anscombe方差稳定归一化，解决分布偏移问题。

Result: 在多个基准测试中，DynGhost在动态和光子匮乏场景下显著优于传统重建方法和现有深度学习架构。

Conclusion: 通过时空注意力机制和量子感知训练，DynGhost有效推动了动态鬼成像在真实硬件约束下的实际应用。

Abstract: Ghost imaging reconstructs spatial information from a single-pixel bucket detector by correlating structured illumination patterns with scalar intensity measurements. While deep learning approaches have achieved promising results on static scenes, two critical limitations remain unaddressed: existing architectures fail to exploit temporal coherence across frames, leaving dynamic ghost imaging largely unsolved, and they assume additive Gaussian noise models that do not reflect the true Poissonian statistics of real single-photon hardware. We present DynGhost (Dynamic Ghost Imaging Transformer), a transformer architecture that addresses both limitations through alternating spatial and temporal attention blocks. Our quantum-aware training framework, based on physically accurate detector simulations (SNSPDs, SPADs, SiPMs) and Anscombe variance-stabilizing normalization, resolves the distribution shift that causes classical models to fail under realistic hardware constraints. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that DynGhost outperforms both traditional reconstruction methods and existing deep learning architectures, with particular gains in dynamic and photon-starved settings.

</details>


### [255] [SciVQR: A Multidisciplinary Multimodal Benchmark for Advanced Scientific Reasoning Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10187)
*Longteng Guo,Xuanxu Lin,Dongze Hao,Tongtian Yue,Pengkang Huo,Jiatong Ma,Yuchen Liu,Jing Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SciVQR，一个覆盖数学、物理、化学、地理、天文学和生物学54个子领域的多模态基准测试，用于评估多模态大模型在科学推理任务中的表现，包含专业视觉内容（公式、图表等）和推理过程分析，实验表明现有模型在复杂多步推理和跨学科知识整合方面存在显著局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLM基准难以捕捉科学推理所需的复杂性和可追溯性，缺乏对推理过程的严格评估，因此需构建一个覆盖多学科、包含领域特定视觉内容且支持推理过程分析的评测基准。

Method: 构建涵盖数学、物理、化学、地理、天文学和生物学54个子领域的SciVQR基准，包含领域特定的视觉元素（公式、图表、图示），任务从基础事实回忆到复杂多步推理，其中46%包含专家撰写的解决方案，评估不仅考察最终答案还分析推理过程。

Result: 对主流MLLM（包括开源和闭源模型）的评估显示，现有模型在处理复杂多模态推理任务时存在显著局限，尤其在多步推理和跨学科知识整合方面表现不佳。

Conclusion: 需要改进多步推理能力和跨学科知识整合，以推动MLLM向真正的科学智能发展。
