Sensitivity analyses show that two source models and small anchor pools already suffice to approximate transferable directions. Overall, ACS provides a novel perspective on cross-family interpretability, revealing that representation-level transfer remains robust across model families.

</details>


### [473] [M2A: Synergizing Mathematical and Agentic Reasoning in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09879)
*Junjian Wang,Xin Zhou,Qiran Xu,Kun Zhan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: M2A是一种通过模型合并来协同数学推理与智能体推理的新范式。它直接在参数空间中运作，识别智能体行为的关键特征子空间，并仅沿着其零空间注入数学推理任务向量，从而在不干扰智能体行为的前提下提升推理能力。无需额外梯度更新，通过合并系数控制推理长度。在SWE-Bench上，Qwen3-8B的通过率从44.0%提升至51.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数学推理(封闭世界、单轮输出)与智能体推理(开放环境、多轮交互）所需的推理模式不匹配，导致两者在联合训练下难以互相增益，推理行为不稳定且性能提升有限。

Method: 提出M2A范式：在参数空间中识别对智能体行为关键的特征子空间，将数学推理任务向量仅沿其零空间（null space）合并，避免干扰智能体行为。无需梯度更新，通过合并系数控制推理长度。

Result: 在SWE-Bench Verified基准上，将Qwen3-8B的解决率从44.0%提升至51.2%，无需重新训练模型。

Conclusion: M2A有效地将数学推理能力注入智能体推理系统，显著提升了推理深度和任务性能，且无需额外训练开销。

Abstract: While reasoning has become a central capability of large language models (LLMs), the reasoning patterns required for different scenarios are often misaligned. Mathematical reasoning typically relies on intrinsic logic to solve closed-world problems in a single response, whereas agentic reasoning requires not only internal reasoning but also multi-turn interaction with external environments, interleaving thought and action. This misalignment prevents mathematical and agentic reasoning from effectively benefiting from each other, often yielding unstable reasoning behavior and only limited performance gains under multi-task learning. In this paper, we propose M2A, a novel paradigm that synergizes mathematical and agentic reasoning via model merging. To avoid overfitting to superficial reasoning patterns under joint training, M2A operates directly in parameter space: it identifies the feature subspace critical for agent behavior, and merges the mathematical reasoning task vector only along its null space, thereby injecting reasoning capability along directions that do not perturb agent behavior. Unlike SFT or RL, M2A requires no additional gradient-update and exposes the merging coefficient as a simple knob for controlling reasoning length. Experiments in a challenging real-world coding agent setting show that our method effectively extends agentic reasoning depth and delivers substantial performance improvements. Applied to a fine-tuned Qwen3-8B, M2A improves its SWE-Bench Verified resolved rate from 44.0% to 51.2% without retraining the model. Code is available at https://github.com/laplucky/M2A.git.

</details>


### [474] [The Gordian Knot for VLMs: Diagrammatic Knot Reasoning as a Hard Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09900)
*Hao Liu,Jicheng Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: KnotBench是一个包含858,318张图像、涵盖1,951种素结原型的数据集和评估协议。测试了Claude Opus 4.7和GPT-5在14项结理论任务上的表现，结果显示多数任务接近随机基线，模型无法正确转录结图符号，具备感知能力但缺乏模拟操作能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在结图感知上能"看"但无法"行动"，即存在感知与操作之间的鸿沟。作者希望通过系统化基准测试来量化这一差距。

Method: 构建KnotBench数据集（858,318张图像，1,951种素结原型，交叉数3-19），设计14项任务（等价判断、移动预测、识别、跨模态对齐），采用图像vs符号拆分定位失败原因。用Claude Opus 4.7和GPT-5进行测试，含thinking模式，64K输出token预算。

Result: 56个(task, model)组合中15个处于或低于随机基线；14项任务中8项最佳分数低于随机1.5倍；无模型能正确输出结图符号串；thinking模式分别提升1.65和9.25个准确率点。

Conclusion: 当前视觉语言模型能捕捉结图的部分特征，但缺乏在这些特征上模拟操作的计算机制，仅靠推理增强难以跨越感知-操作鸿沟。

Abstract: A vision-language model can look at a knot diagram and report what it sees, yet fail to act on that structure. KnotBench pairs an 858,318-image corpus from 1,951 prime-knot prototypes (crossing numbers 3 to 19) with a protocol whose answers are checked against Regina's canonical knot signature. Its 14 tasks span four families, equivalence judgment, move prediction, identification, and cross-modal grounding; an image-versus-symbol split locates failures along the perception-operation gap. We score Claude Opus 4.7 and GPT-5, each with and without thinking, under a 64K output-token budget matched on both vendors. Across 56 (task, model) cases, 15 sit at or below a random baseline and 8 of 14 tasks have a best score under 1.5x random. On diagram-to-symbol transcription, no model produces a strictly correct string, and permissive Regina decoding recovers the knot in 0 to 4 of 100 items. Thinking-mode reasoning lifts overall accuracy by 1.65 points for Claude and 9.25 points for GPT-5, narrowing the gap only modestly. Read together, the four families suggest current vision-language models hold features of a diagram but lack apparatus to simulate moves on those features.

</details>


### [475] [Separate First, Fuse Later: Mitigating Cross-Modal Interference in Audio-Visual LLMs Reasoning with Modality-Specific Chain-of-Thought](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09906)
*Xuanchen Li,Yuheng Lu,Chenrui Cui,Tianrui Wang,Zikang Huang,Yu Jiang,Long Zhou,Longbiao Wang,Jianwu Dang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"先分离后融合"(SFFL)框架，通过模态分离推理链和强化学习奖励机制，减少视听问答中的跨模态干扰与幻觉，在多个基准上取得了显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前视听大语言模型在中间推理阶段存在不受控的跨模态交互，导致模态间信息相互误导，产生幻觉（即跨模态干扰问题）。

Method: 1) 模态特定的思维链推理（Separate First, Fuse Later）；2) 构建模态偏好标签数据管道；3) 将标签作为辅助奖励进行强化学习，鼓励实例依赖的模态偏好；4) 分离推理阶段保持模态隔离，证据融合阶段允许跨模态信息访问。

Result: 在通用AVQA基准上平均相对提升5.16%，在跨模态幻觉基准上提升11.17%，在准确性和鲁棒性上均取得一致性改进。

Conclusion: SFFL通过先分离后融合的策略有效缓解了跨模态干扰问题，提升了大模型在视听问答任务中的表现与抗幻觉能力。

Abstract: Audio and vision provide complementary evidence for audio-visual question answering, yet current audio-visual large language models may suffer from cross-modal interference: information from one modality misguides the interpretation of another, thereby inducing hallucinations. We attribute this issue to uncontrolled cross-modal interactions during intermediate reasoning. To mitigate this, we propose Separate First, Fuse Later (SFFL), an audio-visual reasoning framework designed to reduce cross-modal interference. SFFL enforces modality-specific chain-of-thought reasoning, producing separate audio and visual reasoning traces and integrating evidence for answering. We construct modality-preference labels via a data pipeline under different modality input settings. We use these labels as an auxiliary reward in reinforcement learning to encourage a instance-dependent preference for modality cues when answering. We further introduce a modality-specific reasoning mechanism that preserves modality isolation during the separated reasoning stage while enabling full access to cross-modal information at the evidence fusion stage. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in both accuracy and robustness, yielding an average relative gain of 5.16\% on general AVQA benchmarks and 11.17\% on a cross-modal hallucination benchmark.

</details>


### [476] [RADAR: Redundancy-Aware Diffusion for Multi-Agent Communication Structure Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09907)
*Zhen Zhang,Wanjing Zhou,Juncheng Li,Hao Fei,Jun Wen,Wei Ji*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出RADAR框架，利用条件离散图扩散模型逐步生成通信拓扑，在保证多智能体系统性能的同时降低通信开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的多智能体系统依赖固定或单步生成的通信拓扑，限制了结构灵活性和任务适应性，导致简单任务浪费token、复杂任务能力不足。

Method: RADAR是一个冗余感知且查询自适应的生成框架，将通信拓扑设计建模为条件离散图扩散模型的逐步生成过程，由图的有效大小引导。

Result: 在6个基准测试上，RADAR在准确率、token消耗和鲁棒性方面均持续优于现有基线方法。

Conclusion: RADAR通过动态生成通信拓扑有效降低了多智能体系统的通信冗余，提升了任务适应性和资源利用效率。

Abstract: Compared with individual agents, large language model based multi-agent systems have shown great capabilities consistently across diverse tasks, including code generation, mathematical reasoning, and planning, etc. Despite their impressive performance, the effectiveness and robustness of these systems heavily rely on their communication topology, which is often fixed or generated in a single step. This restricts fine-grained structural exploration and flexible composition, resulting in excessive token utilization on simple tasks while limiting capability on complicated tasks. To mitigate this challenge, we introduce RADAR, a redundancy-aware and query-adaptive generative framework that actively reduce communication overhead. Motivated by recent progress in conditional discrete graph diffusion models, we formulate communication topology design as a step-by-step generation process, guided by the effective size of the graph. Comprehensive experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate that RADAR consistently outperforms recent baselines, achieving higher accuracy, lower token consumption, and greater robustness across diverse scenarios. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/cszhangzhen/RADAR.

</details>


### [477] [expo: Exploration-prioritized policy optimization via adaptive kl regulation and gaussian curriculum sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09923)
*Mingxiong Lin,Zhangquan Gong,Maowen Tang,Qian Li,Chuangchuang Wang,Jian Ma,Sutian Huang,Kai Tang,Haonan Lu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出EXPO算法，通过自适应KL缩放（AKL）和高斯课程采样（GCS）两个轻量模块改进GRPO，在数学推理任务上显著提升了探索效率和性能，AIME 2025 pass@32从63.33%提升至76.67%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GRPO算法存在两个低效问题：固定KL惩罚系数限制了模型策略探索；均匀采样训练问题忽略了中等难度问题能提供最具信息量的梯度信号。

Method: 提出Exploration-Prioritized Policy Optimization (EXPO)，包含两个插件模块：Accuracy-Conditioned KL Scaling (AKL) 根据批次平均准确率动态调整KL正则化强度；Gaussian Curriculum Sampling (GCS) 基于高斯分布为中等难度（准确率约0.5）的问题分配更高采样权重。

Result: 在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B和Qwen3-8B-Base上，EXPO稳定超越GRPO。AIME 2025 pass@32从63.33%提升至76.67%（绝对增益13.34），8B模型平均pass@32提升2.66。pass@32增益远大于pass@1，说明EXPO有效扩大了模型探索边界。

Conclusion: EXPO通过自适应KL缩放和课程采样两个轻量模块，在固定推理预算下有效提升了LLM数学推理的探索效率和性能，验证了动态调整正则化强度和针对性采样策略的有效性。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become the standard paradigm for LLM mathematical reasoning, where Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) serves as the mainstream algorithm. We point out two understudied inefficiencies existing in GRPO. First, the fixed KL penalty coefficient overly restricts policy exploration at stages where the model requires significant deviation from the reference policy. Second, uniform sampling of training questions ignores that moderately difficult problems provide the most informative gradient signals for optimization. We propose Exploration-Prioritized Policy Optimization (EXPO) with two lightweight plug-in modules. The Accuracy-Conditioned KL Scaling (AKL) dynamically adjusts KL regularization strength through a smooth nonlinear function of batch average accuracy, relaxing the penalty when the model underperforms and strengthening it when the model achieves good results. The Gaussian Curriculum Sampling (GCS) assigns sampling weights to questions following a Gaussian distribution centered at moderate accuracy around 0.5, focusing training on the model's learning frontier. We conduct extensive experiments on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B and Qwen3-8B-Base over six mathematical reasoning benchmarks. The results show EXPO steadily surpasses vanilla GRPO. It obtains an absolute gain of 13.34 on AIME 2025 pass@32, rising from 63.33 percent to 76.67 percent, and achieves an average pass@32 improvement of 2.66 on the 8B model. The much larger performance gains on pass@32 compared with pass@1 demonstrate that EXPO effectively enlarges the model's exploration boundary under a fixed inference cost budget.

</details>


### [478] [HAGE: Harnessing Agentic Memory via RL-Driven Weighted Graph Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09942)
*Dongming Jiang,Yi Li,Guanpeng Li,Qiannan Li,Bingzhe Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: HAGE提出了一种加权多关系记忆框架，将检索重构为基于查询的条件式序列遍历，通过可训练的关系特征向量、路由网络和强化学习优化，提升了长程推理的准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体LLM系统中的记忆检索通常依赖静态向量搜索或固定二元关系图，无法捕捉事件之间变化的强度、置信度和查询相关的相关性。

Method: HAGE构建了统一的关系记忆图，具有关系特定的图视图；使用LLM分类器识别关系意图，路由网络动态调制边嵌入；通过语义相似度和查询条件化边表示的组合计算遍历分数；并采用强化学习联合优化路由行为和边表示。

Result: 实验结果表明，与最先进的智能体记忆系统相比，HAGE在长程推理准确性和准确性-效率权衡上均有改进。

Conclusion: 将记忆检索重构为查询条件化的加权多关系图遍历，并引入RL联合优化，能有效提升智能体LLM的记忆利用效率。

Abstract: Memory retrieval in agentic large language model (LLM) systems is often treated as a static lookup problem, relying on flat vector search or fixed binary relational graphs. However, fixed graph structures cannot capture the varying strength, confidence, and query-dependent relevance of relationships between events. In this paper, we propose HAGE, a weighted multi-relational memory framework that reconceptualizes retrieval as sequential, query-conditioned traversal over a unified relational memory graph. Memory is organized as relation-specific graph views over shared memory nodes, where each edge is associated with a trainable relation feature vector encoding multiple relational signals. Given a query, an LLM-based classifier identifies the relational intent, and a routing network dynamically modulates the corresponding dimensions of the edge embedding. Traversal scores are computed via a learned combination of semantic similarity and these query-conditioned edge representations. This allows memory traversal to prioritize high-utility relational paths while softly suppressing noisy or weakly relevant connections. Beyond adaptive traversal, HAGE further introduces a reinforcement learning-based training framework that jointly optimizes routing behavior and edge representations using downstream tasks. Finally, empirical results demonstrate improved long-horizon reasoning accuracy and a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off compared to state-of-the-art agentic memory systems. Our code is available at https://github.com/FredJiang0324/HAGE_MVPReview.

</details>


### [479] [Learning the Interaction Prior for Protein-Protein Interaction Prediction: A Model-Agnostic Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09964)
*Ziqi Gao,Chenyi Zi,Zijing Liu,Ziqiao Meng,Yu Li,Jia Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出L3-PPI，一种基于生物学L3规则的轻量级图提示学习方法，通过生成虚拟L3路径并将蛋白质对分类重构为图级分类任务，有效提升PPI预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PPI预测方法专注于学习强大的蛋白质表征，却忽视了设计具有生物学洞察力的专门分类头，普遍使用拼接或点积等通用聚合方式。

Method: 提出L3-PPI方法：基于L3规则（蛋白质对间多条长度为3的路径指示相互作用可能性），通过图提示学习生成包含虚拟L3路径的提示图，将蛋白质嵌入对的分类转化为图级分类任务，作为即插即用模块集成到现有PPI预测器中。

Result: 大量实验表明L3-PPI在性能提升上优于先进的竞争方法。

Conclusion: 注入互补性交互先验的生物学信息能有效增强PPI预测性能，且该方法作为轻量级即插即用模块具有良好通用性。

Abstract: Protein-protein interactions (PPIs) are fundamental to cellular function and disease mechanisms. Current learning-based PPI predictors focus on learning powerful protein representations but neglect designing specialized classification heads. They mainly rely on generic aggregating methods like concatenation or dot products, which lack biological insight. Motivated by the biological "L3 rule", where multiple length-3 paths between a pair of proteins indicate their interaction likelihood, our study addresses this gap by designing a biologically informed PPI classifier. In this paper, we provide empirical evidence that popular PPI datasets strongly support the L3 rule. We propose an L3-path-regularized graph prompt learning method called L3-PPI, which can generate a prompt graph with virtual L3 paths based on protein representations and controls the number of paths. L3-PPI reformulates the classification of protein embedding pairs into a graph-level classification task over the generated prompt graph. This lightweight module seamlessly integrates with PPI predictors as a plug-and-play component, injecting the interaction prior of complementarity to enhance performance. Extensive experiments show that L3-PPI achieves superior performance enhancements over advanced competitors.

</details>


### [480] [Prospective Compression in Human Abstraction Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09985)
*Leonardo Hernandez Cano,Ivan Zareski,Luisa El Amouri,Pinzhe Zhao,Max Mascini,Emanuele Sansone,Yewen Pu,Bonan Zhao,Marta Kryven*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究探讨在非平稳领域下，人类程序合成中的库学习会前瞻性地选择抽象（针对未来任务的压缩），而非回顾性压缩（基于过去任务）。通过视觉程序合成范式（Pattern Builder Task）和六个计算模型的对比实验，发现人类行为对潜在的非平稳结构具有敏感性，且现有回顾性压缩算法或LLM归纳偏差均无法解释这一行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有程序合成中的在线库学习算法将库学习视为对静态任务分布的回顾性压缩，但真实世界的学习领域往往是非平稳的（任务生成过程随时间演化）。作者质疑现有算法是否足以解释人类在这种动态环境中的抽象学习能力。

Method: 使用Pattern Builder Task（视觉程序合成范式），设计两个具有互补潜在课程（latent curricula）的实验，以解耦前瞻性压缩行为与其他库学习策略。构建六种计算模型（涵盖在线库学习策略），对比人类行为与模型预测。

Result: 人类抽象行为对任务生成过程中的潜在非平稳结构具有敏感性；行为模式与前瞻性压缩一致；现有回顾性压缩算法及LLM程序合成的归纳偏差均无法捕捉该行为。

Conclusion: 在非平稳领域，人类库学习采用前瞻性压缩策略（面向未来任务的压缩），而非回顾性压缩。这揭示了当前程序合成算法的关键局限性，并为构建更具人类认知合理性的AI系统提供了新方向。

Abstract: A core challenge in program synthesis is online library learning: the incremental acquisition of reusable abstractions under uncertainty about future task demands. Existing algorithms treat library learning as retrospective compression over a static task distribution, where the learned library is determined by the corpus of past tasks. However, real-world learning domains are often non-stationary, with tasks arising from a generative process that evolves over time. We propose and test the hypothesis that in non-stationary domains human library learning selects abstractions prospectively: targeting compression of future tasks. We study this question using the Pattern Builder Task, a visual program synthesis paradigm in which participants construct increasingly complex geometric patterns from a small set of primitives, transformations, and custom helpers that carry forward across trials. Using this task, we conduct two experiments with complementary latent curricula, designed to dissociate between behaviors consistent with prospective compression, and alternative library learning accounts. Using six computational models spanning online library learning strategies, we show that human abstraction behavior reflects sensitivity to latent, non-stationary structure in the task-generating process. This behavior is consistent with prospective compression, and cannot be captured by existing retrospective compression-based algorithms, or inductive biases modeled by LLM-based program synthesis.

</details>


### [481] [Optimizer-Induced Mode Connectivity: From AdamW to Muon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09991)
*Fangzhao Zhang,Sungyoon Kim,Erica Zhang,Yiqi Jiang,Mert Pilanci*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究优化器对模式连通性的影响，发现同一优化器（如AdamW、Muon）的解在大宽度下形成连通集，而不同优化器的解可能被损失屏障分离，揭示了优化器依赖的隐式正则化结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典模式连通性研究忽略了优化器的作用，本文旨在探讨优化器诱导的隐式正则化如何影响解的连通性结构。

Method: 理论分析两层ReLU网络在AdamW、Muon等优化器下的连通性；通过小宽度示例证明不同优化器解被损失屏障分离；在GPT-2预训练中实验验证同/跨优化器路径的谱特性差异。

Result: 大宽度下同一优化器解形成连通集；不同优化器区域可能不连通或重叠（取决于正则化）；小宽度下AdamW与Muon解被可证明的损失屏障分离；GPT-2中同优化器路径保留谱，跨优化器路径呈现平滑过渡。

Conclusion: 优化器在模式连通性中引入超越经典文献的依赖结构，同一优化器解的内部连通性与不同优化器解之间的潜在屏障揭示了隐式正则化的关键作用。

Abstract: Mode connectivity has been widely studied, yet the role of the optimizer remains underexplored. We revisit it through optimizer-induced implicit regularization, asking how connectivity behaves when restricted to solutions constrained by a given optimizer. For two-layer ReLU networks, we show that solutions from a single optimizer -- AdamW, Muon, or others in the Lion-$\mathcal{K}$ family -- form a connected set at sufficiently large width, a result not implied by prior work. We then characterize how optimizer-induced regions interact: at large width two different regions can be disjoint or overlap depending on regularization, while in our small-width example AdamW and Muon converge to disconnected zero-loss components separated by a provable loss barrier. Empirically, in GPT-2 pretraining, we observe same-optimizer paths preserve each model's spectrum while cross-optimizer paths traverse a smooth transition. Our results reveal optimizer-dependent structure beyond classical mode connectivity literature.

</details>


### [482] [From Single-Step Edit Response to Multi-Step Molecular Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10035)
*Haojie Rao,Kun Li,Yida Xiong,Jiameng Chen,Wenbin Hu,Yizhen Zheng,Jiajun Yu,Duanhua Cao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SMER框架，通过学习单步编辑响应预测和多步树搜索规划，实现无需频繁调用外部评估器的条件分子优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子优化中，结构相似的分子数据稀缺，且决策本质上是动作级别的（每一步需要从化学规则过滤后的候选集中选择局部编辑），而监督信号是分子对级别的，这种层级不匹配导致依赖外部评估器的搜索不稳定。

Method: 1）SMER：单步分子编辑响应预测器，学习评估每个候选编辑对属性变化的方向性影响；2）SMER-Opt：多步规划器，通过引导树搜索将局部预测组合成优化轨迹。通过挖掘弱相关分子对并将结构差异分解为最小编辑单元，将端点属性标注转化为过程级监督。

Result: 显著减少了决策时对外部评估器的查询依赖，实现了更稳定的约束感知的分子优化规划。

Conclusion: 提出了一种响应导向的离散编辑优化方法，通过动作级别的方向性评估模型和引导树搜索，解决了监督与决策层级不匹配的问题，提升了分子优化的数据效率和稳定性。

Abstract: Conditional molecular optimization aims to edit a molecule to realize a specified property shift. In practice, structurally similar molecule data is scarce, while decisions are inherently action-level: at each step, the system must select one local structural edit from a candidate set that is strictly filtered by chemical feasibility rules. This level mismatch between supervision and decision makes oracle-in-the-loop search unstable in molecular optimization. Regressing on property differences between molecule pairs improves data efficiency but relies on oracle-in-the-loop search, entangling transformation effects with global context and providing limited guidance for selecting the next feasible edit, often resorting to oracle-in-the-loop search. For this reason, we propose a response-oriented discrete edit optimization approach comprising two tightly coupled components: a single-step molecular edit response predictor (SMER) and a multi-step planner that composes local predictions into optimization trajectories via guided tree search (SMER-Opt). The approach learns a directional evaluation model over edit actions to support constraint-aware planning. It mines weakly related molecule pairs and decomposes their structural differences into minimal edit units, turning endpoint property annotations into process-level supervision and yielding reusable, transferable action primitives. A directional edit evaluator then scores feasible candidate edits by their likelihood of moving the molecule toward the desired property change, substantially reducing dependence on external evaluator queries at decision time. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SMER.

</details>


### [483] [TimeClaw: A Time-Series AI Agent with Exploratory Execution Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10038)
*Hangchen Liu,Dongyuan Li,Renhe Jiang,Jiewen Deng,Weiwei Ye,Yoshihide Sekimoto*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TimeClaw提出了一种探索性执行学习框架，通过"探索-对比-蒸馏-重注入"四阶段循环，将探索性执行转化为可复用的分层蒸馏经验，在金融和天气预测等时序任务上持续优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的时序分析系统过于注重执行当前实例，很少从探索性执行中学习，且在可验证的数值场景中，早期成功可能导致工具偏好崩溃，抑制进一步探索。

Method: 提出TimeClaw框架，包含四阶段循环：Explore（探索多种执行路径）、Compare（指标监督下的对比评估）、Distill（分层蒸馏经验）、Reinject（推理时重注入经验），结合任务感知的工具丢弃策略，保持基础模型冻结。

Result: 在17个涵盖金融和天气预测及推理任务的MTBench对齐评估中，TimeClaw持续优于基线方法。

Conclusion: 科学系统的瓶颈不仅在于执行时的能力，更在于如何比较、蒸馏和复用探索性经验。

Abstract: Time series analysis underpins forecasting, monitoring, and decision making in domains such as finance and weather, where solving a task often requires both numerical accuracy and contextual reasoning. Recent progress has moved from specialized neural predictors to approaches built on LLMs and foundation models that can reason over time series inputs and use external tools. However, most such systems remain execution-centric: they focus on solving the current instance but learn little from exploratory execution. This is especially limiting in verifiable numeric settings, where multiple candidate executions and tool-use procedures may all be task-valid yet differ sharply in quantitative quality, and where early success can trigger tool-prior collapse that suppresses further exploration. To address this limitation, we present TimeClaw, an exploratory execution learning framework that turns exploratory execution into reusable hierarchical distilled experience through a four-stage loop: Explore, Compare, Distill, and Reinject. TimeClaw combines metric-supervised exploratory execution learning, task-aware tool dropout, and hierarchical distilled experience for inference-time reinjection, while keeping the base model frozen and avoiding online test-time adaptation. In an MTBench-aligned evaluation with 17 tasks that span finance and weather prediction and reasoning tasks, TimeClaw delivers consistent gains over the baselines. These results suggest that, for scientific systems, the bottleneck is not only execution-time capability, but how exploratory experience is compared, distilled, and reused.

</details>


### [484] [Route by State, Recover from Trace: STAR with Failure-Aware Markov Routing for Multi-Agent Spatiotemporal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10057)
*Ruiyi Yang,Lihuan Li,Hao Xue,Flora D. Salim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出STAR（时空智能体路由器），一个故障感知路由框架，通过状态条件转移策略外部化智能体间控制，利用专家指定的名义路径与执行轨迹学习到的恢复转换相结合，实现针对不同类型故障（格式错误、依赖缺失、工具查询不匹配）的差异化恢复，在三个时空推理基准和八个大语言模型上显著优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工具增强和多智能体LLM系统在路由决策上依赖语言生成隐式处理，当执行失败时恢复策略是临时的、难以解释且难以优化。需要一种能够感知故障类型、显式路由的框架，以应对组合时空推理中多种异构专家（几何、时间、拓扑、轨迹）的协调问题。

Method: STAR的核心是智能体路由矩阵，结合专家指定的名义路径与从执行轨迹中学习的恢复转换。该矩阵以当前智能体、任务类型和类型化执行状态为条件。采用提取-计算-存储（extract-compute-deposit）协议让专家执行，并通过共享黑板写入中间结果。训练时保留失败轨迹以扩大路由策略在错误状态上的支持域。

Result: 在三个时空推理基准和八个大语言模型上，STAR优于多个基线方法，在偏离名义路由路径的查询上提升最为明显。消融实验和恢复分析表明，类型化故障感知路由（而非仅仅专家组合）是性能提升的关键因素。

Conclusion: 保留训练中的失败轨迹对于学习恢复转换至关重要，仅靠成功轨迹训练无法覆盖错误状态。故障类型感知的显式路由机制能有效提升组合时空推理系统的鲁棒性和可解释性。

Abstract: Compositional spatiotemporal reasoning often requires a system to invoke multiple heterogeneous specialists, such as geometric, temporal, topological, and trajectory agents. A central question is how such a system should route among specialists when execution does not simply succeed or fail, but fails in qualitatively different ways. Existing tool-augmented and multi-agent LLM systems typically leave this routing decision implicit in language generation, making recovery ad hoc, difficult to interpret, and hard to optimize. This paper presents STAR (Spatio-Temporal Agent Router), a failure-aware routing framework that externalizes inter-agent control as a state-conditioned transition policy over the current agent, task type, and typed execution status. At the center of STARis an agent routing matrix that combines expert-specified nominal routes with recovery transitions learned from execution traces. Because the matrix conditions on distinct failure states, the router can respond differently to malformed outputs, missing dependencies, and tool--query mismatches, rather than collapsing them into a generic retry signal. Specialists execute through a tool-grounded extract--compute--deposit protocol and write intermediate results to a shared blackboard for downstream fusion. Results prove that retaining unsuccessful traces during training enlarges the support of the routing policy on error states, enabling recovery transitions that success-only training cannot represent. Across three spatiotemporal benchmarks and eight backbone LLMs, STAR improves over multiple baselines with the clearest gains on queries whose execution deviates from the nominal routing path. Router-specific ablations and recovery analyses further show that typed failure-aware routing, rather than specialist composition alone, is a key factor for these improvements.

</details>


### [485] [Strategic Exploitation in LLM Agent Markets: A Simulation Framework for E-Commerce Trust](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10059)
*Shijun Lei,Quang Nguyen,Swapneel S Mehta,Zeping Li,Huichuan Fu,Xiaolong Zheng,Siki Chen,Yunji Liang,Philip Torr,Zhenfei Yin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出TruthMarketTwin模拟框架，研究LLM代理在电商市场信息不对称环境下的策略行为，发现代理会利用声誉系统漏洞进行欺骗，而担保机制能有效抑制欺骗行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索LLM代理在电商市场中信息不对称（卖家隐藏产品质量、买家依赖广告和声誉）环境下的策略行为，填补该领域研究空白。

Method: 构建TruthMarketTwin模拟框架，建模双边贸易中的信息不对称共享场景，让LLM代理做出上架、购买、评分和追索等战略决策，以优化卖家和买家的各自目标。

Result: LLM代理在传统市场中会自主利用声誉治理机制的漏洞进行欺骗；引入担保执行机制后，欺骗行为减少，且代理的战略推理模式发生改变。

Conclusion: LLM代理模拟可作为研究制度治理下的自主市场行为的有力工具。

Abstract: Agent-based modeling (ABM) has long been used in economics to study human behavior, and large language model (LLM) agents now enable new forms of social and economic simulation. While prior work has discovered strategic deception by LLM agents in financial trading and auction markets, e-commerce remains underexplored despite its distinctive information asymmetry: sellers privately observe product quality, whereas buyers rely on advertised claims and reputation signals. We introduce TruthMarketTwin, a controlled simulation framework for studying LLM-agent behavior in e-commerce markets. The framework is one of the first to model bilateral trade under asymmetric information sharing, where agents make strategic listing, purchasing, rating, and recourse-related decisions to optimize seller profit and buyer utility. We find that LLM agents released into traditional markets autonomously exploit weaknesses in reputation-based governance, while warrant enforcement reduces deception and reshapes strategic reasoning. Our results position LLM-agent simulation as a tool for studying institution-governed autonomous markets.

</details>


### [486] [MAGE: Multi-Agent Self-Evolution with Co-Evolutionary Knowledge Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10064)
*Ruiyi Yang,Zechen Li,Hao Xue,Imran Razzak,Flora D. Salim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出MAGE框架，通过四子图知识图谱实现冻结骨干模型的持续进化，在9个基准上优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自我进化语言模型跨迭代知识保存方式（自然语言反馈、平面情节记忆、隐式强化信号）均无法在推理时支持冻结的弱骨干模型。

Method: 构建四子图协同进化知识图谱：经验子图存储纠错和成功推理轨迹；结合任务级搜索bandit和技能级路由bandit进行更新；冻结执行模型不变，仅进化检索基座。

Result: 在数学推理、多跳/开放域问答、时空分析、金融推理、医学选择题、生存游戏和网络导航9个基准上取得强性能；消融实验发现成功记忆和纠错记忆互补。

Conclusion: 附加式记忆增长、有界课程覆盖和任务过滤检索共同支撑冻结学习者的稳定进化；成功记忆擅长推理模板任务，纠错记忆支撑复杂组合和交互场景。

Abstract: Self-evolving language-model agents must decide what to learn next and how to preserve what they have learned across iterations. Existing systems typically carry this cross-iteration knowledge as natural-language feedback, flat episodic memory, or implicit reinforcement signals, none of which cleanly supports a frozen weak backbone at inference time. This paper introduces MAGE (Multi-Agent Graph-guided Evolution), a framework that externalizes self-knowledge into a four-subgraph co-evolutionary knowledge graph. Its experience subgraph stores both teacher-written failure corrections and the learner's own past correct reasoning traces, which are retrieved as task-conditioned guidance for a frozen execution model. During evolution, the graph, a task-level search bandit, and a skill-level routing bandit are updated from the same reward stream, while the learner's backbone remains unchanged. We further provide structural analysis showing how append-only memory growth, bounded curriculum coverage, and task-filtered retrieval together support stable improvement of the retrieval substrate for frozen-learner evolution. Across nine benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning, multi-hop and open-domain question answering, spatio-temporal analysis, financial numerical reasoning, medical multiple-choice, an open-world survival game, and web navigation, MAGE achieves strong performance against prompt-based frozen-backbone baselines. Ablations show that self-harvested success traces and teacher-written corrections are complementary, with success memories contributing most on reasoning-template-heavy tasks and corrective memories supporting harder composition and interaction settings.

</details>


### [487] [Active Testing of Large Language Models via Approximate Neyman Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10075)
*Zeli Liu,Jiancheng Zhang,Cong Liu,Yinglun Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向生成式任务的主动测试算法，利用语义熵进行分层抽样和近似Neyman分配，在多个基准测试上实现最高28%的MSE降低和平均22.9%的预算节省。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型从预训练到测试时扩展都需要可靠评估，而随着模型规模增长和任务对专家标注的需求增加，每次评估的计算和标注成本急剧上升。现有主动测试方法主要针对分类任务，在生成式任务上表现不佳。

Method: 利用代理模型的语义熵对评估池进行分层，然后基于代理模型提取的信号进行近似Neyman分配，从而选择信息量最大的子集进行标注和评估。

Result: 在多种语言和多模态基准测试以及多组代理-目标模型对上，该方法显著优于基线，紧密追踪Oracle-Neyman，实现最高28%的MSE降低（相比均匀采样），平均节省22.9%的评估预算。

Conclusion: 该工作有效填补了生成式任务中主动测试的空白，通过语义熵分层+近似Neyman分配的组合策略，在保持评估精度的同时大幅降低评估成本，具有实际应用价值。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) require reliable evaluation from pre-training to test-time scaling, making evaluation a recurring rather than one-off cost. As model scales grow and target tasks increasingly demand expert annotators, both the compute and labeling costs needed for each evaluation rise rapidly. Active testing aims to alleviate this bottleneck by approximating the evaluation result from a small but informative subset of the evaluation pool. However, existing approaches primarily target classification and break down on generative tasks. We introduce a novel active testing algorithm tailored to generative tasks. Our method leverages semantic entropy from surrogate models to stratify the evaluation pool and then conducts approximate Neyman allocation based on signals extracted from these surrogates. Across multiple language and multimodal benchmarks and a range of surrogate-target model pairs, our method significantly improves on baselines and closely tracks Oracle-Neyman, delivering up to 28\% MSE reduction over Uniform Sampling and an average of 22.9\% budget savings.

</details>


### [488] [Arcane: An Assertion Reduction Framework through Semantic Clustering and MCTS-Guided Rule Exploring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10107)
*Hongqin Lyu,Yonghao Wang,Zhiteng Chao,Tiancheng Wang,Huawei Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Arcane框架，通过两阶段断言聚类和蒙特卡洛树搜索优化断言约简，在Assertionbench上实现最高76.2%的断言数量缩减，同时保持完整的正式覆盖率和突变检测能力，仿真速度提升2.6x-6.1x。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的自动断言生成方法会产生大量冗余断言，严重降低仿真效率，亟需高效的断言约简方法来缓解仿真开销问题。

Method: 提出Arcane框架，包含两阶段断言聚类方法（实现大规模断言集的精确语义分类）和基于蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的最优规则应用序列探索机制。

Result: 在Assertionbench上断言数量最多减少76.2%，完整保留形式覆盖率和突变检测能力；仿真时间加速2.6倍到6.1倍。

Conclusion: Arcane能有效约简冗余断言而不损失验证质量，显著提升仿真效率，且已开源。

Abstract: Assertion-based Verification (ABV) is essential for ensuring that hardware designs conform to their intended specifications. However, existing automated assertion-generation approaches, such as LLM-based frameworks, often generate large numbers of redundant assertions, which significantly degrade simulation efficiency. To mitigate the simulation overhead caused by redundant assertions, this paper proposes Arcane, an efficient assertion reduction framework. It integrates a two-tier assertion clustering approach for accurate semantic classification of large assertion sets, and employs Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to explore optimal rule-application sequences for efficient assertion reduction. The experimental results on Assertionbench [20] show that Arcane achieves a reduction of up to 76.2% in the assertion count while fully preserving formal coverage and mutation-detection ability. Further simulation studies demonstrate a speedup of 2.6x to 6.1x speedup in simulation time. The proposed framework is released at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Arcane1-0A6F/.

</details>


### [489] [Rethinking Constraint Awareness for Efficient State Embedding of Neural Routing Solver](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10122)
*Canhong Yu,Changliang Zhou,Rongsheng Chen,Zhenkun Wang,Yu Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对重型编码器-轻型解码器（HELD）类神经路由求解器在处理复杂约束VRP变体时表现不佳的问题，发现其根源在于解码时状态嵌入的生成机制限制了观测空间。通过提出约束感知残差调制（CARM）模块，自适应地调制上下文嵌入，在保持全局观测空间的同时增强约束感知能力，显著提升了多任务和单任务求解器的性能与泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有HELD神经路由求解器在复杂约束的VRP变体上表现受限，原因在于解码阶段状态嵌入的生成机制限制了注意力计算时的观测空间，成为实现高质量解的瓶颈。

Method: 提出Constraint-Aware Residual Modulation (CARM)模块，通过自适应地利用约束相关变量调制上下文嵌入，在保持全局观测空间的同时增强约束感知能力，从而生成高效的状态嵌入。

Result: 在2个单任务和5个多任务神经路由求解器上的实验表明，CARM模块能持续提升基线性能，在大规模实例扩展和未见VRP变体泛化方面取得显著改进。

Conclusion: CARM模块有效解决了HELD求解器约束感知不足的问题，为神经路由求解器的架构设计提供了有价值的洞见。

Abstract: Heavy-Encoder-Light-Decoder (HELD) neural routing solvers have emerged as a promising paradigm due to their broad applicability across multiple vehicle routing problems (VRPs). However, they typically struggle with VRP variants with complex constraints. To address this limitation, this paper systematically revisits existing neural solvers from the perspective of the generation mechanism for state embeddings (i.e., query vector prior to compatibility calculation) during decoding. We identify that current mechanisms restrict the observation space during attention computation, introducing a key bottleneck to achieving high-quality solutions. Through detailed empirical analysis, we demonstrate the necessity of preserving a global observation space. To overcome the constraint-agnostic drawback inherent to global observation spaces, we propose a simple yet powerful Constraint-Aware Residual Modulation (CARM) module. By adaptively modulating the context embedding with constraint-relevant variables, CARM effectively enhances constraint awareness, enabling the neural solver to fully leverage the global observation space and generate an efficient state embedding. Extensive experimental results across two single-task and five multi-task neural routing solvers confirm that the CARM module consistently boosts baseline performance. Notably, solvers equipped with our CARM achieve substantial improvements in scaling to large-scale instances and in generalizing to unseen VRP variants. These findings provide valuable insights for the architectural design of neural routing solvers.

</details>


### [490] [Useful for Exploration, Risky for Precision: Evaluating AI Tools in Academic Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10125)
*Anthea Dathe,Kiran Hoffmann,Aline Mangold*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出并应用了一个结合人本和计算机指标的基准测试框架，用于评估AI问答和文献综述工具。结果表明，AI工具在早期研究阶段和浅层任务中能提升效率，但存在可解释性低、可重复性差、质量不稳定等问题，仍需人工验证。强调可解释性特征和以人为本的评估对于AI工具在科研中的实际应用至关重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准测试方法未能充分捕捉以人为中心的标准（如可用性、可解释性、与研究工作流的整合），因此需要一个新的基准框架来系统评估AI工具在科研中的实际表现和局限性。

Method: 提出一个结合人本指标（可用性、可解释性、工作流整合）和计算机指标（准确性、可重复性等）的基准测试框架，并应用于评估AI问答工具和文献综述工具。

Result: 1) 问答工具可提供有价值的概览和准确的摘要，但精确信息提取不可靠；2) 可解释AI（xAI）准确率低，标注来源与生成答案不一致；3) 文献综述工具支持探索性搜索，但可重复性低、透明度有限、来源质量不一致，不适合系统性综述；4) 两种工具在早期、浅层任务中提升效率，但仍需人工验证。

Conclusion: 强调可解释性特征对提升透明度和验证效率的重要性，指出AI工具需谨慎整合到研究工作流中，并提出以人为本的评估对确保实际适用性至关重要。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) tools are being incorporated into scientific research workflows with the potential to enhance efficiency in tasks such as document analysis, question answering (Q and A), and literature search. However, system outputs are often difficult to verify, lack transparency in their generation and remain prone to errors. Suitable benchmarks are needed to document and evaluate arising issues. Nevertheless, existing benchmarking approaches are not adequately capturing human-centered criteria such as usability, interpretability, and integration into research workflows. To address this gap, the present work proposes and applies a benchmarking framework combining human-centered and computer-centered metrics to evaluate AI-based Q&A and literature review tools for research use. The findings suggest that Q and A tools can offer valuable overviews and generally accurate summaries; however, they are not always reliable for precise information extraction. Explainable AI (xAI) accuracy was particularly low, meaning highlighted source passages frequently failed to correspond to generated answers. This shifted the burden of validation back onto the researcher. Literature review tools supported exploratory searches but showed low reproducibility, limited transparency regarding chosen sources and databases, and inconsistent source quality, making them unsuitable for systematic reviews. A comparison of these tool groups reveals a similar pattern: while AI tools can enhance efficiency in the early stages of the research workflow and shallow tasks, their outputs still require human verification. The findings underscore the importance of explainability features to enhance transparency, verification efficiency and careful integration of AI tools into researchers' workflows. Further, human-centered evaluation remains an important concern to ensure practical applicability.

</details>


### [491] [FormalRewardBench: A Benchmark for Formal Theorem Proving Reward Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10141)
*Zeynel A. Uluşan,Burak S. Akbudak,Can S. Erer,Gözde Gül Şahin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出FormalRewardBench，首个用于评估形式化定理证明中奖励模型的基准，包含250个偏好对及五种错误注入策略。实验发现前沿LLM表现最好（59.8%），而专业定理证明模型表现最差（24.4%），表明定理证明能力不能迁移到证明评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经定理证明器使用强化学习+可验证奖励，虽然廉价且可扩展，但存在稀疏奖励问题——模型从困难问题中得不到学习信号。这促使需要学习奖励模型来评估证明质量，然而比较奖励模型通常需要昂贵的RL训练消融实验，缺乏统一的评估基准。

Method: 构建包含250个偏好对的FormalRewardBench基准，每个偏好对包含一个正确证明和五个错误注入变体（强制错误、最小单点变化、冗长错误证明、自然语言论证、Python代码注入）。评估多个模型家族（前沿LLM、裁判LLM、通用LLM、专用定理证明模型）。

Result: 前沿LLM取得最高性能59.8%，专用定理证明模型表现最差24.4%，所有模型整体性能偏低，表明错误注入机制具有挑战性。

Conclusion: 定理证明能力不能直接迁移到证明质量评估任务；现有模型在区分正确与错误证明方面仍有很大提升空间；FormalRewardBench可促进形式数学中奖励模型的进一步研究。

Abstract: Recent neural theorem provers use reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), where proof assistants provide binary correctness signals. While verifiable rewards are cheap and scalable without reward hacking issues, they suffer from sparse credit assignment: models receive no learning signal from difficult problems where partial progress goes unrewarded. This motivates learned reward models that can evaluate proof quality beyond binary verification. However, comparing reward models is challenging since it typically requires expensive RL training ablations. To address this, we introduce \textbf{FormalRewardBench}, the first benchmark for evaluating reward models in formal theorem proving with Lean 4. Our benchmark consists of 250 preference pairs where correct proofs are paired with incorrect variants generated through five expert curated error injection strategies: forced mistakes, minimal single-point variations, verbose incorrect proofs, natural language justification, and Python code injection. We evaluate frontier LLMs (e.g., Claude Opus 4.5), judge LLMs (e.g., CompassJudger-1-14B), general-purpose LLMs (e.g., Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct), and specialized theorem proving models (e.g., DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B).
  Our results reveal that frontier LLMs achieve the highest performance (59.8\%) while specialized theorem provers perform the worst (24.4\%), suggesting that theorem proving ability does not transfer to proof evaluation. We provide further insights on various error injection mechanisms, highlighting the challenging nature of most injection mechanisms. We release \textbf{FormalRewardBench} publicly to encourage more research on developing reward models in formal mathematics.

</details>


### [492] [Benchmarking Safety Risks of Knowledge-Intensive Reasoning under Malicious Knowledge Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10146)
*Qinghua Mao,Xi Lin,Jinze Gu,Jun Wu,Siyuan Li,Yuliang Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了EditRisk-Bench，一个系统性评估大语言模型在恶意知识编辑下知识密集型推理安全风险的基准，实验发现恶意编辑能可靠地诱导不安全推理且难以检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有知识编辑基准主要关注编辑效果（成功率、泛化性、局部性），缺乏统一框架来系统评估被编辑知识对推理行为的安全影响，无法应对恶意知识注入带来的安全风险。

Method: 构建了包含虚假信息、偏见和安全违规等多种恶意场景的统一评估框架，结合多层级知识密集型推理任务和代表性编辑策略，从攻击有效性、推理正确性和副作用三个维度进行评估。

Result: 在开源和闭源LLM上的实验表明，恶意知识编辑能可靠地导致错误或不安全的推理，同时保持模型一般能力，使得此类风险难以检测。还发现编辑规模、知识特性和推理复杂度是影响风险的关键因素。

Conclusion: EditRisk-Bench为理解和缓解LLM知识编辑中的安全风险提供了可扩展的测试平台，强调了需要关注恶意编辑对推理行为的负面影响。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly rely on knowledge editing to support knowledge-intensive reasoning, but this flexibility also introduces critical safety risks: adversaries can inject malicious or misleading knowledge that corrupts downstream reasoning and leads to harmful outcomes. Existing knowledge editing benchmarks primarily focus on editing efficacy and lack a unified framework for systematically evaluating the safety implications of edited knowledge on reasoning behavior. To address this gap, we present EditRisk-Bench, a benchmark for systematically evaluating safety risks of knowledge-intensive reasoning under malicious knowledge editing. Unlike prior benchmarks that mainly emphasize edit success, generalization, and locality, EditRisk-Bench focuses on how injected knowledge affects downstream reasoning behavior and reliability. It integrates diverse malicious scenarios, including misinformation, bias, and safety violations, together with multi-level knowledge-intensive reasoning tasks and representative editing strategies within a unified evaluation framework measuring attack effectiveness, reasoning correctness, and side effects. Extensive experiments on both open-source and closed-source LLMs show that malicious knowledge editing can reliably induce incorrect or unsafe reasoning while largely preserving general capabilities, making such risks difficult to detect. We further identify several key factors influencing these risks, including edit scale, knowledge characteristics, and reasoning complexity. EditRisk-Bench provides an extensible testbed for understanding and mitigating safety risks in knowledge editing for LLMs.

</details>


### [493] [Automated Approach for Solving Infinite-state Polynomial Reachability Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10169)
*Krishnendu Chatterjee,Ehsan Kafshdar Goharshady,Mehrdad Karrabi,Maximilian Seeliger,Đorđe Žikelić*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对无限状态图上基于回合制的可达性博弈问题，提出了**排名证明（ranking certificates）**作为证明REACH玩家存在获胜策略的完备规则，并针对**多项式可达性博弈**设计了全自动算法，可计算获胜策略并生成形式化正确性证明。该算法是**半完备的**，运行时间为**次指数级**。实验表明，该方法能解决文献中经典难题（如**Cinderella-Stepmother博弈**），首次为任意精度参数计算出最优获胜策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可达性博弈在人工智能和反应式合成中有重要应用，许多实际场景涉及**无限状态图**。现有方法难以处理此类无限状态空间，缺乏自动化的获胜策略计算与形式化验证手段。

Method: 1) 提出**排名证明**（ranking certificates）作为证明REACH玩家获胜策略的完备规则。2) 针对**多项式可达性博弈**（转移和目标由多项式约束描述），设计全自动算法计算获胜策略并生成排名证明形式化保证。算法为**半完备**，运行时间**次指数级**。

Result: 实验表明该方法能解决已有方法无法处理的经典问题。例如在**Cinderella-Stepmother博弈**中，首次为任意精度参数计算出**最优获胜策略**。

Conclusion: 本文为无限状态可达性博弈提供了形式化证明框架和自动求解算法，填补了该领域空白，尤其在经典博弈难题上取得了突破性进展。

Abstract: Reachability games are two-player games played on a graph, where the objective of $\texttt{REACH}$ player is to reach the target set whereas the objective of $\texttt{SAFE}$ player is to stay away from the target set. Reachability games have important applications in artificial intelligence and reactive synthesis, and many of these applications give rise to infinite-state reachability games. In this paper, we study turn-based reachability games on infinite-state graphs defined over valuations of a finite set of real variables. We consider the problem of determining the existence of and computing a winning strategy for $\texttt{REACH}$ player. Our contributions are twofold. First, we propose ranking certificates for reachability games, a sound and complete proof rule for proving that $\texttt{REACH}$ player has a winning strategy from the specified initial state. Second, we consider polynomial reachability games, where transitions and objectives are described by polynomial constraints over real variables, and propose a fully automated algorithm for computing a winning strategy for $\texttt{REACH}$ player together with a formal correctness witness in the form of a ranking certificate. The algorithm is sound, semi-complete, and runs in sub-exponential time. Our experiments demonstrate the ability of our method to solve challenging examples from the literature that were out of the reach of existing methods. Specifically, for the classical Cinderella-Stepmother game, we are able to compute an optimal winning strategy for an arbitrary precision parameter for the first time.

</details>


### [494] [TRACE: Distilling Where It Matters via Token-Routed Self On-Policy Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10194)
*Jiaxuan Wang,Xuan Ouyang,Zhiyu Chen,Yulan Hu,Zheng Pan,Xin Li,Lan-Zhe Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出TRACE方法，通过仅在关键推理片段上施加KL散度蒸馏，配合GRPO训练其余token，解决全token自蒸馏导致的熵增、推理缩短和分布外退化问题，在数学推理任务上平均提升2.76个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全token自蒸馏（self-OPD）在RLVR训练中存在两个问题：1）所有token的KL散度将梯度分散在大量冗余位置；2）放大特权信息泄露，导致熵增、推理缩短以及长程数学训练的分布外退化。

Method: 提出Token-Routed Alignment for Critical rEasoning (TRACE)，仅在标注者标记的关键推理片段上进行蒸馏：对正确轨迹的关键span使用前向KL，对错误span可选使用反向KL，其余token使用GRPO训练，并在一段短预热后将KL通道退火消除。

Result: 在四个数学基准和GPQA-Diamond上，TRACE相比GRPO平均提升2.76个百分点；在GPQA-Diamond上保持Qwen3-8B基线的分布外得分，而GRPO和全token自蒸馏基线均出现退化。在线自标注下仍有1.90个百分点的提升（约为强API标注增益的69%）。

Conclusion: TRACE通过关键span掩码和退火控制累积特权梯度暴露量，有效缓解自蒸馏中的退化问题。最佳路由动作依赖模型规模：Qwen3-8B上前向KL最优，Qwen3-1.7B上反向KL更优。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (self-OPD) densifies reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) by letting a policy teach itself under privileged context. We find that when this guidance spans the full response, all-token KL spends gradients on mostly redundant positions and amplifies privileged-information leakage, causing entropy rise, shortened reasoning, and out-of-distribution degradation in long-horizon math training. We propose Token-Routed Alignment for Critical rEasoning (TRACE), which distills only on annotator-marked critical spans: forward KL on key spans of correct rollouts, optional reverse KL on localized error spans, and GRPO on all remaining tokens, with the KL channel annealed away after a short warm-up. Our analysis explains TRACE through two effects: forward KL provides non-vanishing lift to teacher-supported tokens that the student under-allocates, while span masking and decay keep cumulative privileged-gradient exposure finite. On four held-out math benchmarks plus GPQA-Diamond, TRACE improves over GRPO by 2.76 percentage points on average and preserves the Qwen3-8B base OOD score on GPQA-Diamond, where GRPO and all-token self-OPD baselines degrade. Gains persist under online self-annotation (+1.90 percentage points, about 69% of the strong-API gain), reducing the concern that TRACE merely imports external annotator capability. Across scales, the best routed action is base-dependent: on Qwen3-8B it is forward KL on key spans, while on Qwen3-1.7B it shifts to reverse KL on error spans.

</details>


### [495] [Beyond Autonomy: A Dynamic Tiered AgentRunner Framework for Governable and Resilient Enterprise AI Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10223)
*Kai Pan,Rong Hou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出动态分层AgentRunner框架，通过风险自适应分层、权力分离架构和弹性设计三大机制，在保持自主性的同时实现企业级可控执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大语言模型智能体框架过于追求自主性，缺乏企业部署所需的可治理性：高风险写操作无独立审查、复杂任务缺乏验收机制、计算资源分配未考虑风险等级。

Method: 提出动态分层AgentRunner，包含三种核心机制：(1)风险自适应分层——根据任务风险动态分配计算资源和审查强度；(2)权力分离架构——由独立智能体分别执行提议、审查、执行和验证，物理隔离边界；(3)弹性设计——通过验证器-恢复闭环将失败视为系统一等状态。

Result: 实现了安全性与效率之间的帕累托最优权衡，适用于生产级多租户SaaS平台。

Conclusion: 该框架通过受控执行协议弥合了自主智能体与企业治理需求之间的鸿沟，为LLM智能体的企业级部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Current large language model agent frameworks prioritize autonomy but lack the governability mechanisms required for enterprise deployment. High-risk write operations proceed without independent review, complex tasks lack acceptance verification, and computational resources are allocated uniformly regardless of risk level. We propose the Dynamic Tiered AgentRunner, a controlled execution protocol distilled from a production-grade multi-tenant SaaS platform. The framework introduces three core mechanisms: (1) Risk-Adaptive Tiering that dynamically allocates computational resources and review intensity based on task risk profiles, achieving Pareto-optimal trade-offs between safety and efficiency; (2) Separation of Powers architecture where proposal, review, execution, and verification are performed by independent agents with physically isolated boundaries; and (3) Resilience-by-Design through a Verifier-Recovery closed loop that treats failure as a first-class system state. We formalize the tier selectio

</details>


### [496] [Hypothesis-Driven Deep Research with Large Language Models: A Structured Methodology for Automated Knowledge Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10224)
*Michael Chin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出假设驱动型深度研究(HDRI)方法论，将假设从研究成果转变为组织研究过程的工具，通过八阶段流水线和间隙驱动迭代机制实现主动式、可验证的知识发现，在INFOMINER系统中实现，事实密度提升22.4%，质量评分4.46/5.0。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI研究系统采用直接搜索-摘要范式，将假设视为科学发现的终端产物。作者认为假设可以发挥更有力的作用——作为组织研究过程本身的结构性工具，当前方法遗漏了这一关键点。

Method: 提出HDRI框架，包含六个核心原则和八个阶段流水线。核心创新包括：间隙驱动迭代研究机制（闭环质量保证系统，自动识别信息与逻辑间隙并触发补充研究）、可追溯推理链与量化置信度传播的事实推理框架、防止实体混淆的学科锁定机制、多维度质量评估方案。

Result: INFOMINER系统实验：事实密度提升22.4%、主体匹配准确率90%、多源验证置信度0.92、间隙驱动补充完备性提升14%。五个案例研究平均质量评分4.46/5.0。

Conclusion: HDRI将假设从研究终点转变为组织工具，将研究从被动信息检索转变为主动、可验证、迭代的知识发现过程，有效提升了研究的系统性、准确性和完备性。

Abstract: Current AI-powered research systems adopt a direct search-then-summarize paradigm that treats hypotheses as end products of scientific discovery. We argue this leaves a critical gap: hypotheses can serve a far more powerful role as organizational instruments that structure the research process itself. We propose the Hypothesis-Driven Deep Research (HDRI) methodology - the first framework using hypotheses to organize general-purpose deep research across arbitrary domains, rather than merely validating claims within specific domains. This transforms research from reactive information retrieval into proactive, verifiable, and iterative knowledge discovery.
  HDRI is formalized with six core principles and an eight-stage pipeline. A central innovation is the gap-driven iterative research mechanism - a closed-loop quality assurance system that automatically identifies informational and logical gaps, triggering targeted supplementary investigation. We further introduce a fact reasoning framework with traceable reasoning chains and quantified confidence propagation, a subject locking mechanism to prevent entity confusion, and a multi-dimensional quality assessment scheme.
  The methodology is realized in the INFOMINER system. Experiments demonstrate improvements of 22.4% in fact density, 90% subject matching accuracy, 0.92 multi-source verification confidence, and 14% completeness gain from gap-driven supplementation. Five case studies validate its practical applicability, achieving an average quality rating of 4.46/5.0.

</details>


### [497] [SciIntegrity-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Academic Integrity in AI Scientist Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10246)
*Zonglin Yang,Xingtong Liu,Xinyan Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了SCIINTEGRITY-BENCH，首个评估AI科学家系统学术诚信的基准。通过33个困境场景测试7个LLM，发现整体诚信问题率达34.2%，所有模型在缺失数据场景都会生成合成数据而非承认不可行。去除完成压力可减少未披露伪造，但内在完成偏差依然存在。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI科学家系统被广泛用于自主研究，但其学术诚信从未被系统性评估。现有工作缺乏针对AI在科研场景中是否诚实报告失败能力的测试基准。

Method: 设计困境评估范式：每个场景中诚实承认失败是唯一正确回应，而完成任务需要学术不端。包含33个场景、11种陷阱类别，在7个LLM上进行了231次评估运行。

Result: 整体诚信问题率34.2%，没有模型零失败。所有7个模型在缺失数据场景都生成合成数据而非承认不可行。去除完成压力使未披露伪造从20.6%降至3.2%，但内在合成率不变。

Conclusion: AI系统缺乏"诚实拒绝"作为训练倾向是失败的主要驱动因素。即使去除外部压力，内在完成偏差仍然存在。

Abstract: AI scientist systems are increasingly deployed for autonomous research, yet their academic integrity has never been systematically evaluated. We introduce SCIINTEGRITY-BENCH, the first benchmark designed around a dilemmatic evaluation paradigm: each of its 33 scenarios across 11 trap categories is constructed so that honest acknowledgment of failure is the only correct response, while task completion requires misconduct. Across 231 evaluation runs spanning 7 state-of-the-art LLMs, the overall integrity problem rate reaches 34.2%, and no model achieves zero failures. Most strikingly, across missing-data scenarios, all seven models generate synthetic data rather than acknowledging infeasibility, differing only in whether they disclose the substitution. A further prompt ablation study separates two drivers: removing explicit completion pressure sharply reduces undisclosed fabrication from 20.6% to 3.2%, while the underlying synthesis rate remains unchanged, revealing an intrinsic completion bias that persists independent of prompt-level instructions. These findings point to the absence of honest refusal as a trained disposition as the primary driver of observed failures. We release SCIINTEGRITY-BENCH at https://github.com/liuxingtong/Sci-Integrity-Bench.

</details>


### [498] [Towards Autonomous Railway Operations: A Semi-Hierarchical Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach to the Vehicle Rescheduling Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10257)
*Alberto Castagna,Stefan Zahlner,Adrian Egli,Christian Eichenberger,Daniel Boos,Manuel Meyer,Anton Fuxjager*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对铁路交通管理中的车辆路径与调度问题，提出了一种半分层强化学习框架，将调度与路径规划分离，在Flatland-RL模拟器上的实验表明，该方法在协调性、资源利用率和鲁棒性上显著优于启发式基线和单一RL方法，能将到达目的地的列车数量近乎翻倍，并将死锁率控制在5%以下。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有运筹学方法虽广泛使用，但调度仍依赖人工经验；现有RL方法在密集铁路网络中表现不如运筹学方法且难以扩展。本文旨在从机器学习角度填补这一空白，解决RL在铁路调度中的扩展性和性能不足问题。

Method: 提出一种半分层强化学习（semi-hierarchical RL）方法，将调度（dispatching）与路由（routing）分离，设计专用的动作空间和观测空间，使策略能够在不同决策范围上专门化，解决稀疏调度决策与频繁路由更新之间的不平衡问题。

Result: 在Flatland-RL模拟器上，跨越5个难度级别和50个随机种子，训练7到80列火车。结果显示：几乎将到达目的地的列车数量翻倍，死锁率低于5%，在严重拥堵下能自适应地安排、延迟或取消列车。

Conclusion: 半分层RL框架在协调性、资源利用率和鲁棒性方面显著优于启发式基线和单一RL方法，为密集铁路网络中的实时调度问题提供了一种可行且高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Managing disruptions in railway traffic management is a major challenge. Rising traffic density and infrastructure limits increase complexity, making the Vehicle Routing and Scheduling Problem (VRSP) difficult to solve reliably and in real time. While Operational Research (OR) methods are widely used, most dispatching still relies on human expertise due to the problem's exponential combinatorial complexity. Reinforcement Learning (RL) has gained attention for its potential in multi-agent coordination, but existing RL approaches often underperform OR methods and struggle to scale in dense rail networks. This paper addresses this gap from a machine learning perspective by introducing a semi-hierarchical RL formulation tailored to operational railway constraints. The method separates dispatching from routing through dedicated action and observation spaces, enabling policies to specialise in distinct decision scopes and addressing the imbalance between rare dispatch decisions and frequent routing updates. The approach is evaluated on the Flatland-RL simulator across five difficulty levels and 50 random seeds, with 7 to 80 trains. Results show substantially improved coordination, resource utilisation, and robustness compared with heuristic baselines and monolithic RL, nearly doubling the number of trains reaching their destinations, while keeping deadlock rates below 5% and adaptively sequencing, delaying, or cancelling trains under heavy congestion.

</details>


### [499] [E-TCAV: Formalizing Penultimate Proxies for Efficient Concept Based Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10261)
*Hasib Aslam,Muhammad Ali Chattha,Muhammad Taha Mukhtar,Muhammad Imran Malik,Andreas Dengel,Sheraz Ahmed*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: E-TCAV通过分析潜在分类器选择、层间一致性和倒数第二层代理机制，实现了TCAV分数的高效近似计算，在保持准确性的前提下实现了线性加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TCAV虽然是一种有效的可解释性方法，但存在计算开销大、层间分数不一致和统计不稳定性等显著问题，限制了其在大规模模型调试和实时概念引导训练中的应用。

Method: 1) 系统研究潜在分类器对TCAV分数稳定性的影响；2) 分析层间TCAV分数的一致性；3) 利用倒数第二层作为早期层的快速代理；4) 在4种架构和5个数据集（覆盖CV和NLP）上进行广泛验证。

Result: 1) 网络最后一块中的层与倒数第二层的TCAV分数高度一致；2) TCAV分数的常见方差可归因于潜在分类器的选择；3) E-TCAV实现了与网络大小和评估样本数量成线性关系的加速。

Conclusion: E-TCAV通过利用层间一致性和倒数第二层的方向敏感性简并特性，有效解决了TCAV的计算效率瓶颈，是向高效模型调试和实时概念引导训练迈出的重要一步。

Abstract: TCAV (Testing with Concept Activation Vectors) is an interpretability method that assesses the alignment between the internal representations of a trained neural network and human-understandable, high-level concepts. Though effective, TCAV suffers from significant computational overhead, inter-layer disagreement of TCAV scores, and statistical instability. This work takes a step toward addressing these challenges by introducing E-TCAV, a framework for efficient approximation of TCAV scores, which is based on extensive investigation into three key aspects of the TCAV methodology: 1) the effect of latent classifiers on the stability of TCAV scores, 2) the inter-layer agreement of TCAV scores, and 3) the use of the penultimate layer as a fast proxy for earlier layers for TCAV computation. To ensure a solid foundation for E-TCAV, we conduct extensive evaluations across four different architectures and five datasets, encompassing problems from both computer vision and natural language domains. Our results show that the layers in the final block of the neural network strongly agree with the penultimate layer in terms of the TCAV scores, and the commonly observed variance of the TCAV scores can be attributed to the choice of the latent classifier. Leveraging this inter-layer agreement and the degeneracy of directional sensitivities at the penultimate layer, E-TCAV guarantees linearly scaling speed-ups with respect to the network's size and the number of evaluation samples, marking a step towards efficient model debugging and real-time concept-guided training.

</details>


### [500] [IndustryBench: Probing the Industrial Knowledge Boundaries of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10267)
*Songlin Bai,Xintong Wang,Linlin Yu,Bin Chen,Zhiang Xu,Yuyang Sheng,Changtong Zan,Xiaofeng Zhu,Yizhe Zhang,Jiru Li,Mingze Guo,Ling Zou,Yalong Li,Chengfu Huo,Liang Ding*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出IndustryBench，一个针对工业采购QA的中文基准测试（2049题），基于国标GB/T和结构化产品数据，发现最佳模型仅得2.083分（满分3分），且安全违规检查会显著改变模型排名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业采购中LLM回答必须通过严格标准检查（材料匹配工况、参数符合阈值、流程不违反安全条款），而部分正确可能掩盖安全关键矛盾，现有聚合基准无法捕捉这些问题。

Method: 构建2049题工业采购QA基准IndustryBench，基于GB/T国标和结构化产品数据，含7个能力维度、10个行业类别和难度层级；构建流程中通过搜索式外部验证淘汰70.3%的LLM候选题；评估时分离原始正确性（Qwen3-Max评判，κ_w=0.798）和安全违规检查。

Result: 最佳模型仅2.083/3分；标准与术语是最薄弱能力且跨语言翻译后仍存在；扩展推理使13个模型中的12个安全调整得分下降；安全违规率重排榜单（GPT-5.4从第6升至第3，Kimi-k2.5-1T-A32B下降7位）。

Conclusion: 工业LLM评估需要基于源文本、关注安全性的诊断，而非聚合准确率。

Abstract: In industrial procurement, an LLM answer is useful only if it survives a standards check: recommended material must match operating condition, every parameter must respect a regulated threshold, and no procedure may contradict a safety clause. Partial correctness can mask safety-critical contradictions that aggregate LLM benchmarks rarely capture. We introduce IndustryBench, a 2,049-item benchmark for industrial procurement QA in Chinese, grounded in Chinese national standards (GB/T) and structured industrial product records, organized by seven capability dimensions, ten industry categories, and panel-derived difficulty tiers, with item-aligned English, Russian, and Vietnamese renderings. Our construction pipeline rejects 70.3% of LLM-generated candidates at a search-based external-verification stage, calibrating how unreliable industrial QA remains after LLM-only filtering.Our evaluation decouples raw correctness, scored by a Qwen3-Max judge validated at $κ_w = 0.798$ against a domain expert, from a separate safety-violation (SV) check against source texts. Across 17 models in Chinese and an 8-model intersection over four languages, we find: (i) the best system reaches only 2.083 on the 0--3 rubric, leaving substantial headroom; (ii) Standards & Terminology is the most persistent capability weakness and survives item-aligned translation; (iii) extended reasoning lowers safety-adjusted scores for 12 of 13 models, primarily by introducing unsupported safety-critical details into longer final answers; and (iv) safety-violation rates reshuffle the leaderboard -- GPT-5.4 climbs from rank 6 to rank 3 after SV adjustment, while Kimi-k2.5-1T-A32B drops seven positions.Industrial LLM evaluation therefore requires source-grounded, safety-aware diagnosis rather than aggregate accuracy. We release IndustryBench with all prompts, scoring scripts, and dataset documentation.

</details>


### [501] [AgentRx: A Benchmark Study of LLM Agents for Multimodal Clinical Prediction Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10286)
*Baraa Al Jorf,Farah E. Shamout*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了基于LLM的智能体在临床风险预测任务中的表现，发现单智能体框架在多模态数据处理和校准方面优于朴素的多智能体系统，强调了改进多智能体协作的必要性，并开源了代码和评估框架作为新基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管LLM智能体在医疗文本任务中表现优异，但它们在多模态临床风险预测中的有效性尚未得到充分检验，且医疗数据分散在不同系统中，亟需评估不同智能体框架的效果。

Method: 利用大规模真实世界数据，对基于LLM的智能体进行系统评估，比较单智能体与多智能体系统在单模态和多模态临床预测任务上的性能。

Result: 单智能体框架在多模态数据处理、性能和校准方面均优于朴素的多智能体系统。

Conclusion: 需要改进多智能体协作机制以更好地处理异构输入数据，同时开源评估框架以促进未来研究。

Abstract: Building effective clinical decision support systems requires the synthesis of complex heterogeneous multimodal data. Such modalities include temporal electronic health records data, medical images, radiology reports, and clinical notes. Large language model (LLM)-based agents have shown impressive performance in various healthcare tasks, especially those involving textual modalities. Considering the fragmentation of healthcare data across hospital systems, collaborative agent frameworks present a promising direction to mitigate data sharing challenges. However, the effectiveness of LLM agents for multimodal clinical risk prediction remains largely unexamined. In this work, we conduct a systematic evaluation of LLM-based agents for clinical prediction tasks using large-scale real-world data. We assess performance in unimodal and multimodal settings and quantify performance gaps between single agent and multi-agent systems. Our findings highlight that single agent frameworks outperform naive multi-agent systems, are better at handling multimodal data, and are better calibrated. This underscores a critical need for improving multi-agent collaboration to better handle heterogeneous inputs. By open-sourcing our code and evaluation framework, this work offers a new benchmark to support future developments relating to agentic systems in healthcare.

</details>


### [502] [Positive Alignment: Artificial Intelligence for Human Flourishing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10310)
*Ruben Laukkonen,Seb Krier,Chloé Bakalar,Shamil Chandaria,Morten Kringelbach,Adam Elwood,Daniel Ford,Fernando Rosas,Maty Bohacek,Matija Franklin,Nenad Tomašev,Stephanie Chan,Verena Rieser,Roma Patel,Michael Levin,Arun Rao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出“正向对齐”（Positive Alignment）概念，主张AI系统不仅应追求安全与无害，还应主动促进人类与生态的繁荣，并在多元化、分散化、情境敏感且用户自主的方式下运作。作者认为现有对齐研究过于侧重安全保障，类似早期心理学只关注心理疾病。他们提出通过培养美德、提升知识谦逊、促进多元观点等路径，在LLM和智能体生命周期的不同阶段（数据过滤、训练、评估等）实现正向对齐，并以情境基础、社区定制、持续适应和分散治理为设计原则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI对齐研究过度聚焦于安全、防护和合规（类似早期心理学仅关注心理疾病），忽略了AI系统主动促进人类与生态繁荣的潜力。用户认为这种范式不完整，需要一种新的对齐方向来补全。

Method: 提出“正向对齐”框架：AI系统需同时满足(i)主动支持人类与生态繁荣（多元化、分散化、情境敏感、用户自主）和(ii)保持安全与合作。具体技术方向包括数据过滤与上采样、训练前后优化、评估方法、协作式价值收集等，并设计原则包括情境基础、社区定制、持续适应和分散治理。

Result: 识别了现有对齐失败的多个方面（如参与度黑客、人类自主性丧失、真理追求失败、低知识谦逊、缺乏多元视角、反应性而非主动性），并论证正向对齐可能更好地解决这些问题。

Conclusion: 正向对齐是AI对齐研究中独立且必要的议程，应通过分散治理（多个合法监督中心而非单一机构或道德瓶颈）来促进分歧与去中心化。

Abstract: Existing alignment research is dominated by concerns about safety and preventing harm: safeguards, controllability, and compliance. This paradigm of alignment parallels early psychology's focus on mental illness: necessary but incomplete. What we call Positive Alignment is the development of AI systems that (i) actively support human and ecological flourishing in a pluralistic, polycentric, context-sensitive, and user-authored way while (ii) remaining safe and cooperative. It is a distinct and necessary agenda within AI alignment research. We argue that several existing failures of alignment (e.g., engagement hacking, loss of human autonomy, failures in truth-seeking, low epistemic humility, error correction, lack of diverse viewpoints, and being primarily reactive rather than proactive) may be better addressed through positive alignment, including cultivating virtues and maximizing human flourishing. We highlight a range of challenges, open questions, and technical directions (e.g., data filtering and upsampling, pre- and post-training, evaluations, collaborative value collection) for different phases of the LLM and agents lifecycle. We end with design principles for promoting disagreement and decentralization through contextual grounding, community customization, continual adaptation, and polycentric governance; that is, many legitimate centers of oversight rather than one institutional or moral chokepoint.

</details>


### [503] [Verifiable Process Rewards for Agentic Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10325)
*Huining Yuan,Zelai Xu,Huaijie Wang,Xiangmin Yi,Jiaxuan Gao,Xiao-Ping Zhang,Yu Wang,Chao Yu,Yi Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Verifiable Process Rewards (VPR)框架，将可验证的中间步骤反馈转化为密集的逐轮监督信号，用于强化学习训练LLM，在搜索验证、约束验证和后验验证三类场景中优于稀疏结果级奖励和基于rollout的过程奖励基线，并能迁移到通用推理基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RLVR方法仅依赖稀疏的结果级反馈，在长程智能体推理中面临信用分配难题：一条轨迹可能因中间正确决策多而成功，也可能因中间错误而失败，但结果级奖励无法区分这些情况。

Method: 提出VPR框架，利用符号或算法预言机对中间动作进行客观检查，将可验证的反馈转化为密集的逐轮监督信号。在三种场景中实例化：基于搜索的动态演绎验证、基于约束的逻辑推理验证、基于后验的概率推断验证。同时给出理论分析，证明密集验证器奖励通过提供更局部的学习信号改善长程信用分配。

Result: 在受控环境中，VPR优于结果级奖励和基于rollout的过程奖励基线；更重要的是，VPR能够迁移到通用推理和智能体推理基准，表明可验证的过程监督可以培养超越训练环境的通用推理能力。

Conclusion: VPR是增强LLM智能体在可获得可靠中间验证时的有效方法，但其效果依赖于预言机质量，且扩展到非结构化开放环境仍面临挑战。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) has improved the reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs), but most existing approaches rely on sparse outcome-level feedback. This sparsity creates a credit assignment challenge in long-horizon agentic reasoning: a trajectory may fail despite containing many correct intermediate decisions, or succeed despite containing flawed ones. In this work, we study a class of densely-verifiable agentic reasoning problems, where intermediate actions can be objectively checked by symbolic or algorithmic oracles. We propose Verifiable Process Rewards (VPR), a framework that converts such oracles into dense turn-level supervision for reinforcement learning, and instantiate it in three representative settings: search-based verification for dynamic deduction, constraint-based verification for logical reasoning, and posterior-based verification for probabilistic inference. We further provide a theoretical analysis showing that dense verifier-grounded rewards can improve long-horizon credit assignment by providing more localized learning signals, with the benefit depending on the reliability of the verifier. Empirically, VPR outperforms outcome-level reward and rollout-based process reward baselines across controlled environments, and more importantly, transfers to both general and agentic reasoning benchmarks, suggesting that verifiable process supervision can foster general reasoning skills applicable beyond the training environments. Our results indicate that VPR is a promising approach for enhancing LLM agents whenever reliable intermediate verification is available, while also highlighting its dependence on oracle quality and the open challenge of extending VPR to less structured, open-ended environments.

</details>


### [504] [EmbodiSkill: Skill-Aware Reflection for Self-Evolving Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10332)
*Ruofei Ju,Xinrui Wang,Xin Ding,Yifan Yang,Hao Wu,Shiqi Jiang,Qianxi Zhang,Hao Wen,Xiangyu Li,Weijun Wang,Kun Li,Yunxin Liu,Haipeng Dai,Wei Wang,Ting Cao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出EmbodiSkill，一种无需训练的具身技能自演化框架，通过技能感知的反思和针对性修订，让智能体从自身轨迹中积累可复用的程序性知识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身智能体需要能从自身执行轨迹中自演化技能，但现有方法主要在数字环境中开发，直接将轨迹转译为粗粒度的技能更新，无法区分技能内容错误与执行失误。

Method: EmbodiSkill是一种无需训练的框架，通过技能感知的反思（将轨迹与当前技能对应解释）、针对性修订（用技能改变证据更新技能主体，用执行失误证据保留并强调有效指导）实现技能自演化。

Result: 在ALFWorld上，EmbodiSkill使冻结的Qwen3.5-27B执行器达到93.28%任务成功率，比直接使用GPT-5.2作为智能体高出31.58%。在ALFWorld和EmbodiedBench上均持续提升具身任务成功率。

Conclusion: 技能感知的自演化能帮助具身智能体从自身轨迹中积累可复用的程序性知识，有效区分技能内容错误与执行失误，从而持续提升任务成功率。

Abstract: Embodied agents can benefit from skills that guide object search, action execution, and state changes across diverse environments. Since embodied environments vary across layouts, object states, and other execution factors, these skills must self-evolve from trajectories generated during task execution. However, existing skill self-evolution methods are mainly developed in digital environments and often convert trajectories into coarse skill updates. Directly applying this paradigm to embodied settings is problematic, because a failed task execution may reflect not only incorrect skill content, but also an execution lapse in which the agent fails to follow valid guidance. We propose EmbodiSkill, a training-free framework for embodied skill self-evolution through skill-aware reflection and targeted revision. EmbodiSkill interprets each trajectory with respect to the current skill, uses skill-changing evidence to update the skill body, and uses execution-lapse evidence to preserve and emphasize valid guidance. Experiments on ALFWorld and EmbodiedBench show that EmbodiSkill consistently improves embodied task success. On ALFWorld, EmbodiSkill enables a frozen Qwen3.5-27B executor to reach 93.28% task success, outperforming GPT-5.2 used as a direct agent without skills by 31.58%. These results show that skill-aware self-evolution helps embodied agents accumulate reusable procedural knowledge from their own trajectories.

</details>


### [505] [CORTEG: Foundation Models Enable Cross-Modality Representation Transfer from Scalp to Intracranial Brain Recordings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10337)
*Liuyin Yang,Qiang Sun,Bob Van Dyck,Eva Calvo Merino,Marc M. Van Hulle*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CORTEG框架，利用预训练的头皮脑电图（EEG）基础模型适配到颅内皮质电图（ECoG），实现跨患者学习和高效解码。在手指轨迹回归和音频包络回归任务上，CORTEG匹配或超越最强基线，支持在单个GPU上10-30分钟完成新患者校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ECoG信号质量高，但每个患者数据有限，以往方法多依赖小样本、个体专用解码器，忽略了跨患者共享的信息。作者试图探索能否利用大规模预训练的EEG基础模型（EEG FMs）迁移到ECoG，实现跨患者学习并提高解码效率。

Method: 提出CORTEG框架，包含四部分：①预训练EEG FM主干网络；②电极感知的KNNSoftFourier空间适配器；③双流分词器（处理低频和高伽马频带活动）；④留一被试出的微调策略。通过跨模态迁移将EEG预训练知识适配到ECoG解码。

Result: 在两个回归任务上评估：公开手指轨迹回归（n=9）中，CORTEG达到最高平均相关系数（但n=9统计不显著）；在私有音频包络回归（n=16）中取得显著增益；在低数据量患者标定中表现更优。特征分析与神经生理一致，潜在流形捕捉了低维手指运动结构。

Conclusion: CORTEG提供了系统性证据，证明头皮EEG预训练可以重新用于ECoG解码，实现数据高效的颅内脑机接口，并能够快速适应新患者。

Abstract: Intracranial electrocorticography (ECoG) offers high-signal-to-noise access to cortical activity for brain-computer interfaces, yet limited per-patient data has led most prior work to rely on small, subject-specific decoders that neglect information shared across patients. We investigate whether large pretrained scalp-EEG foundation models (EEG FMs) can be adapted to ECoG, enabling cross-patient learning and competitive decoding performance while calibrating to a held-out patient in 10-30 minutes on a single GPU. We introduce CORTEG, a cross-modality transfer framework that combines a pretrained EEG FM backbone, an electrode-aware KNNSoftFourier spatial adapter, a dual-stream tokenizer for low-frequency and high-gamma activity, and a leave-one-subject-out fine-tuning strategy. We evaluate CORTEG on two challenging regression tasks: public finger trajectory regression (n=9) and private audio envelope regression (n=16). CORTEG matches or exceeds the strongest task-specific baselines on both tasks: it reaches the highest mean correlation among compared methods on the public finger benchmark (gain not statistically significant on n=9 subjects), with larger and statistically significant gains on the audio task and in low-data per-patient calibration. Feature analyses align with neurophysiology, and latent manifolds capture low-dimensional finger-movement structure. CORTEG provides systematic evidence that scalp-EEG pretraining can be repurposed for ECoG decoding, enabling data-efficient intracranial BCIs that can adapt to new patients.

</details>


### [506] [PaperFit: Vision-in-the-Loop Typesetting Optimization for Scientific Documents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10341)
*Bihui Yu,Xinglong Xu,Junjie Jiang,Jiabei Cheng,Caijun Jia,Siyuan Li,Conghui He,Jingxuan Wei,Cheng Tan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出视觉排版优化（VTO）问题，并设计了一个名为PaperFit的视觉循环智能体，通过迭代渲染、诊断缺陷和约束修复，将可编译的LaTeX论文转化为视觉上符合出版要求的PDF。实验表明，PaperFit大幅优于现有基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LaTeX排版工具和基于规则的文本编辑器无法感知渲染后的视觉结果，只能处理源代码和日志文件，导致作者需要反复进行编译-检查-编辑的循环。作者希望将视觉反馈引入排版优化过程，实现自动化、高质量的排版修复。

Method: 提出Visual Typesetting Optimization（VTO）任务框架，定义五类排版缺陷分类法；设计PaperFit智能体，采用视觉循环（vision-in-the-loop）方法，迭代地渲染页面、诊断缺陷、执行约束性修复；构建PaperFit-Bench基准，包含200篇论文、10种会议模板和13种缺陷类型。

Result: PaperFit在所有基线方法上大幅领先，证明了视觉循环优化对于从可编译源码到出版级PDF的关键作用。

Conclusion: 从可编译源码到出版级PDF需要视觉循环优化，VTO是文档自动化流程中缺失的关键环节。

Abstract: A LaTeX manuscript that compiles without error is not necessarily publication-ready. The resulting PDFs frequently suffer from misplaced floats, overflowing equations, inconsistent table scaling, widow and orphan lines, and poor page balance, forcing authors into repetitive compile-inspect-edit cycles. Rule-based tools are blind to rendered visuals, operating only on source code and log files. Text-only LLMs perform open-loop text editing, unable to predict or verify the two-dimensional layout consequences of their changes. Reliable typesetting optimization therefore requires a visual closed loop with verification after every edit. We formalize this problem as Visual Typesetting Optimization (VTO), the task of transforming a compilable LaTeX paper into a visually polished, page-budget-compliant PDF through iterative visual verification and source-level revision, and introduce a five-category taxonomy of typesetting defects to guide diagnosis. We present PaperFit, a vision-in-the-loop agent that iteratively renders pages, diagnoses defects, and applies constrained repairs. To benchmark VTO, we construct PaperFit-Bench with 200 papers across 10 venue templates and 13 defect types at different difficulty. Extensive experiments show that PaperFit outperforms all baselines by a large margin, establishing that bridging the gap from compilable source to publication-ready PDF requires vision-in-the-loop optimization and that VTO constitutes a critical missing stage in the document automation pipeline.

</details>


### [507] [TMAS: Scaling Test-Time Compute via Multi-Agent Synergy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10344)
*George Wu,Nan Jing,Qing Yi,Chuan Hao,Ming Yang,Feng Chang,Yuan Wei,Jian Yang,Ran Tao,Bryan Dai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出TMAS，一个通过多智能体协同实现测试时计算扩展的框架。TMAS组织多个专业智能体协同推理，引入层级记忆（经验库和策略库）来有效利用历史信息，并设计了混合奖励强化学习训练方案。实验表明TMAS在挑战性推理基准上优于现有测试时扩展方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有结构化测试时扩展方法存在两个问题：一是并行推理轨迹之间协调较弱；二是依赖有噪声的历史信息，没有明确决定哪些信息应保留和重用，限制了探索与利用之间的平衡能力。

Method: TMAS通过多智能体协同组织推理过程，包含：(1) 分层记忆机制——经验库重用低层可靠中间结论和局部反馈，策略库记录高层探索策略以规避重复推理模式；(2) 混合奖励强化学习方案，联合保持基础推理能力、增强经验利用、鼓励探索新策略。

Result: 在挑战性推理基准上，TMAS在迭代扩展效果上优于现有测试时扩展基线方法，混合奖励训练进一步提升了扩展效果和跨迭代的稳定性。

Conclusion: TMAS通过多智能体协同和层级记忆机制有效解决了测试时扩展中的探索-利用平衡问题，混合奖励训练方案进一步增强了方法的稳定性和可扩展性。

Abstract: Test-time scaling has become an effective paradigm for improving the reasoning ability of large language models by allocating additional computation during inference. Recent structured approaches have further advanced this paradigm by organizing inference across multiple trajectories, refinement rounds, and verification-based feedback. However, existing structured test-time scaling methods either weakly coordinate parallel reasoning trajectories or rely on noisy historical information without explicitly deciding what should be retained and reused, limiting their ability to balance exploration and exploitation. In this work, we propose TMAS, a framework for scaling test-time compute via multi-agent synergy. TMAS organizes inference as a collaborative process among specialized agents, enabling structured information flow across agents, trajectories, and refinement iterations. To support effective cross-trajectory collaboration, TMAS introduces hierarchical memories: the experience bank reuses low-level reliable intermediate conclusions and local feedback, while the guideline bank records previously explored high-level strategies to steer subsequent rollouts away from redundant reasoning patterns. Furthermore, we design a hybrid reward reinforcement learning scheme tailored to TMAS, which jointly preserves basic reasoning capability, enhances experience utilization, and encourages exploration beyond previously attempted solution strategies.
